articleTitle: Impact Assessment and Mitigation Strategies for Plug-in Electric Vehicles on Distribution Networks: A Probabilistic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The rapid depletion of fossil fuel reserves coupled with the ever-increasing demand for electrical power has prompted the search for new energy sources. Electric vehicles (EVs) are one potential answer because of the technology that allows for more efficient transportation while simultaneously reducing fossil fuel usage and emissions of greenhouse chemicals. Depending on the power system’s capability, structure, and architecture, several studies have shown that the distribution network may be negatively affected by the widespread interconnection of electric vehicles. Consequently, it is important to determine the effects of this additional load on the network so that measures can be taken to prevent threats to the system’s stability, dependability, and security, especially because the Indian federal and state governments have introduced incentives to increase sales of this type of vehicle.

articleTitle: Predictive Weather Modelling Using Unmanned Aerial Systems and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One amazing benefit of science and technology is weather forecasting, which is essential to daily life. Predicting the weather is a challenging task because the environment is a continuous, multifaceted process. Various data-driven techniques are necessary for weather information collection and processing. These techniques can combine the relatively simple view of the sky with complex numerical models to produce the predictions. This paper presents different algorithms, which applied the concepts of Decision tree, KNN, Gradient Boost, Random Forest regressor, in order to forecast temperature variations, including high and low values as characteristics in a linear combination. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) can be used for prediction for weather in a remote area. The aim of this work is to develop a UAV that can stay in “flight mode” at a fixed altitude for a certain amount of time and measure the weather-related parameters at that geographical location and can send the measured data to the ground station. The primary parameters focused are the highest and lowest temperatures, average humidity levels, and rainfall level. A light sensor is used to determine the amount of daylight, and a sensor for measuring air pressure is also employed. Weather forecast can be predicted by machine learning using parameters such as altitude, humidity, temperature, rain, pressure.

articleTitle: Optimizing Crop Yield Prediction using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Agriculture serves as the backbone of many nations, including India, where it holds the second position globally in production. Contributing significantly to the country’s GDP, Indian agriculture’s vitality cannot be overstated. Early prediction of crop yields proves pivotal in enabling farmers to optimize production rates and strategize effectively. In our research, we employed Machine Learning (ML) & Deep Learning (DL) techniques to forecast crop yields for Bihar, India, leveraging publicly accessible datasets. Various algorithms were evaluated, including Random Forest, Linear Regression, K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Keras Nadam Optimization, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). Among these, LSTM emerged as the top performer, boasting a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.016, Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.086, and achieving an accuracy of up to 98.311%. The utilization of LSTM demonstrates its efficacy in capturing complex temporal relationships within the data, thereby facilitating highly accurate crop yield predictions. Such advancements in predictive modelling hold immense promise for enhancing agricultural outcomes and supporting the livelihoods of farmers.

articleTitle: Exploratory Data Analysis for Detecting of Iron Deficiency Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Iron deficiency, a prevalent issue in global health, impacts a large number of individuals and can result in symptoms such as weariness, difficulty breathing, and other incapacitating effects. Although blood tests are considered the most reliable method for diagnosis, they can be inconvenient and intrusive. This dissertation explores the promising possibilities of machine learning in providing a non-invasive method for detecting iron insufficiency.Anemia caused by insufficient iron levels is a widespread global health issue. Conventional techniques for detection sometimes entail intrusive procedures such as blood testing. This dissertation investigates the capacity of machine learning methods to identify iron deficiency without the need for intrusive procedures.The research will conduct a thorough examination of numerous data sources that may be associated with iron insufficiency using Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). This may include physiological data such as heart rate and oxygen saturation, in addition to any accessible blood test findings. In addition, the inquiry will examine the potential use of image analysis from easily accessible places such as fingernails, palm, or the conjunctiva of the eye.The dissertation will utilise the knowledge obtained from exploratory data analysis (EDA) to assess and evaluate the effectiveness of several machine learning algorithms in detecting iron deficiency. This comparison research aims to identify the best precise and user-friendly method for non-invasive detection.Multiple machine learning methods are being examined to determine their efficacy in detecting iron insufficiency. The dissertation evaluates the efficacy of different algorithms and determines the best viable method for precise and non-intrusive diagnosis of iron insufficiency. This study has the capacity to transform the process of identifying iron insufficiency. The findings might potentially lead to early diagnosis and therapies, which would improve patient health outcomes. This would be achieved by establishing a system that is cost-effective and accessible to a large number of people.

articleTitle: Evaluating Current Cloud Security Challenges and IAAS Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized the way organizations manage and utilize computing resources, offering flexibility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. The move to cloud settings has, however, also raised new security concerns that need to be taken into consideration. This research paper assesses the security risks that Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) cloud settings now face and investigates possible optimisation techniques to strengthen security posture. This paper explores a number of cloud security topics, such as network security, identity and access control, data protection, and compliance issues. It also examines at how dynamic communication protocols help strengthen security and reduce vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to offer useful insights and recommendations for organisations looking to optimise their IaaS security and maximise the advantages of cloud computing while minimising risks. It does this by analysing current industry trends, best practices, and cutting-edge technology.

articleTitle: Advancing Biomedical Imaging Through High-Resolution Image Segmentation and Computational Modelling Using Convolutional Nueral Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: High resolution image segmentation and computer modelling have greatly aided advancements in biomedical imaging, especially with the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). In order to improve the precision and accuracy of biological image processing, this work investigates the integration of CNNs. CNN-enabled high-resolution image segmentation provides better delineation of intricate anatomical structures a necessary step toward precise diagnosis and treatment planning. This study provides a thorough examination of CNN’s numerical analytical performance in comparison to cutting-edge techniques. According to the results, CNNs achieve $\mathbf{9 4 \%}$ segmentation accuracy, which is far higher than the average of 85% achieved by classical approaches. CNNs also provide a $\mathbf{3 0 \%}$ reduction in processing times. Furthermore, CNNs beat traditional methods with an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$, demonstrating a prediction accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2 \%}$ in computational modelling. The results highlight CNNs’ potential to transform biomedical imaging by improving picture quality and opening up complex modelling methods, which will lead to more effective and efficient healthcare solutions.

articleTitle: A Survey of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Classifying Dermatoscopic Images for Skin Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One of the most common and deadly types of cancer is skin cancer. It is becoming increasingly common in today’s environment as a result of our regular exposure to hazardous chemicals and radiation. Its early identification is vital given the rapid increase in human population. Many images processing methods, including those based on deep learning and machine learning, have been developed for the automated identification of skin cancer. The study offers an overview of several methods for categorizing dermatoscopic images that are employed in research. The methods are summed up in the study according to the classifier and feature sets that were employed. Tables have been used to present the results of a selection of high-quality publications for simple analysis and comprehension.

articleTitle: Paradigm Shift in E-Commerce by Applying Cognitive Multi-Agent System with Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) into the e-commerce realm has transformed business operations and customer interactions. In paper we elaborate the transformative impact of artificial intelligence in online marketing and focus on the key application and benefits. This overview explores the AI landscape within e-commerce, emphasizing crucial elements and progressions within this domain. The AI in e-commerce provide real-time customer support, enhancing the efficiency and responsiveness of service. The AI in e-commerce increase the fraud detection capabilities, secure transaction and also protecting the customer trust, from these advancement, data privacy concern, algorithm bias and integration complexities are remain challenges in e-market places.The objective of AI paradigm in e-commerce is to provide transformative shift towards intelligent automation, personalized experiences, data-driven insights, and enhanced customer engagement, driving growth and innovation in the e-commerce industry.

articleTitle: Biometric Identification using Periocular Images with ViT-DeepSort and YOLOv7-GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Advanced biometric identification techniques are becoming increasingly necessary in response to rising security requirements. The limits of conventional facial recognition systems have been further brought to light by the COVID-19 outbreak and its emphasis on mask-wearing. utilizing periocular pictures, this study proposes an integrated technique to improve gender categorization and biometric identification utilizing Vision Transformers (ViTs), YOLOv7, DeepSort, and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). Our findings indicate that the combined application of these technologies results in a system that is both robust and accurate, particularly in challenging environments. The proposed methodology demonstrates a notable improvement in identification accuracy, with a precision rate exceeding $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$. With this research, secure identification technologies will advance significantly, and non-intrusive, contactless biometric devices will continue to be developed. The findings suggest that the application of these cutting-edge techniques has the potential to completely transform security procedures in industries including public safety, healthcare, and finance.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Empowered Security in Smart Home Networks: A Fusion of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The main difficulty with smart home technology utilisation is that it frequently results in a number of security problems. The anticipated widespread development and adoption of the IoT technology poses obstacles for private and secure communications. Blockchain-based solutions make decentralised security and privacy possible. The suggested private blockchain-based smart home network architecture in this study uses the Fused Real-Time Sequential Deep Extreme Learning Machine (RTS-DELM) system model to decide intrusion detection. In order to search for any dangerous actions, this research investigates the RTS-DELM technique utilised in blockchain-based smart homes. This proposed approach takes connection, security, and authenticity into consideration while carefully evaluating the Smart Home Architecture based on Blockchain. Furthermore, we show through simulated results that our technique’s overheads are negligible considering the privacy and security it offers.

articleTitle: Construction Of Phylogenetic Tree Using UPGMA Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A phylogenetic tree is a graphical depiction that showcases the evolutionary connections among different species or other groups within a given dataset. In the context of a dataset focusing on mammalian infections due to virus, the phylogenetic tree provides crucial insights into the evolutionary pathways and relatedness of different infections that affect mammals. By mapping out these relationships, researchers can better understand how certain infections have evolved and spread among various mammalian hosts. This detailed depiction aids in identifying potential patterns of transmission, common ancestors of pathogens, and evolutionary pressures that have shaped the current landscape of corona virus. Such comprehensive analysis is instrumental in developing strategies for disease prevention, control, and treatment, as well as in enhancing our overall understanding of pathogen evolution and host-pathogen interactions.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Models: Combining Strengths of Supervised and Unsupervised Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research uses NSL-KDD to test hybrid machine learning models for network intrusion detection. The NSL-KDD dataset, a better version of KDD-99, is selected for its data quality and minimized duplication. It contains 147,907 entries with 42 properties for Attacks such as R2L, U2R, DoS, Probe, and normal. The dataset’s improvements fix bugs and improve testing. Data preparation removed duplicates, normalized values to $0-1$, and addressed class imbalance. The research tests supervised learning approaches like Random Forest and SVM. The Random Forest model has 97% accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-scores, whereas the SVM model had $95 \%$. The most accurate model was a hybrid CNN-LSTM model with $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$ accuracy. Random Forest with K-Means clustering and SVM classification were used for unsupervised learning. The Hybrid model using Autoencoders and Clustering outperformed other models with $\mathbf{9 9 . 8 \%}$ accuracy. This research demonstrates how hybrid machine learning techniques may categorize and handle diverse attack types while overcoming model constraints in network intrusion detection.

articleTitle: The Ethics of Machine Learning in Human Resources: Navigating Fairness and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Corporations can examine how they utilize and manage human resources, or HR, in novel approaches thanks to machine learning equipment, which will improve management. However, it also poses difficulties for HR professionals who are ill-prepared. While ethical issues centre on worker confidentiality and fairness, legal concerns involve possible breaches of US workplace bias statutes including the European General Privacy Regulation. Projects involving the examination of legal information may not always be acceptable and may even be harmful to staff members, resulting in poor performance or unproductive conduct. HR managers may use the suggestions provided in this article to determine if machine learning initiatives are acceptable.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Quality with Smoothing, Filtering, Fusion, and Compression Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Adaptive smoothing, selective filtering, multiscale fusion, and compression are all good ways to improve picture quality and get around this problem. Adaptive smoothing changes how much the picture is smoothed based on its local properties. This keeps important features and reduces noise. Sobel and bidirectional filters are examples of selective filtering. It improves features while keeping lines. The MultiScale Fusion and Compression (MSFC) method stores and mixes data better by combining wavelet transform-based fusion with JPEG compression. The suggested method works better than tried-and-true methods like wavelet fusion, JPEG compression, and HEVC. Results from the study show that this method is a good mix of compression, selected feature enhancement, and freedom, which makes it a good choice for many image-improving tasks.

articleTitle: A Multi-model Software Defect Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The proposed recommendation system has integrated data collection framework, which can collect repository source data and thus generate base dataset for machine learning and artificial neural network models. So proposed framework provides an end-to end solution for software defect recommendation on python projects in GitHub repository. Recommendation system is comprised of multiple components like data collection system, hybrid feature selection strategy, machine learning models and deep learning models, commit monitor. Framework has been validated on several projects from GitHub repository and outcome of recommendation is favourable for usage in real projects.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model Design for Blood Cancer Prediction through AI-Driven Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The study seeks to create and utilize sophisticated deep learning model namely Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) designed for image classification purposes. It’s a custom CNN architecture tailored for the task, to classify images of blood cells into eight distinct categories. It comprises several layers, starting with convolutional layers followed by max-pooling layers, and fully connected layers empowered by AI technique, aiming to precisely forecast different forms of blood cancer using a dataset comprising images of blood cells. Ensuring the consistency and quality of input data, especially in medical imaging datasets susceptible to variations affecting model performance, poses a significant challenge; improving the interpretability and explainability of deep learning models is crucial for their reliable incorporation into clinical decision-making processes for blood cancer prediction. Utilize sophisticated deep learning model design methodologies guided by Artificial Intelligence approaches, tailored to address the unique characteristics of the blood cell image dataset, in order to surmount the outlined challenges. The suggested system provides improved precision and effectiveness in predicting blood cancer by employing advanced deep learning models guided by customized Artificial Intelligence techniques. Throughout the span of 50 epochs, the model’s performance was assessed based on its training and validation accuracy, gradually enhancing until reaching final rates of about 90.31% for training and 90% for validation.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Approach on Temporal Contrastive learning for Human Activity Recognition Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition systems develop important values in healthcare monitoring, interactive gaming, and surveillance. Temporal Graph Contrastive Learning has emerged as one of the powerful approaches towards deep-learning-based technique. Provisionally, TCNs offer a very strong framework that elicits temporal suggestions and subtleties in sequential data without the problematic and training challenges associated with RNNs. By using contrastive learning, TGCL learns more discriminative temporal features from complex dynamic activity data. In this way, robustness is enhanced, and accuracy is improved in systems of human activity recognition. the performance by allowing distinguishing activities that are pretty similar in nature. The capability of TGCL to incorporate spatial and transient aspects into a coherent learning experience allows it to emerge as a promising solution to advance the state of the art in progressive HAR, in the most complex and dynamic scenarios.

articleTitle: A Methodological Approach Integrating Deep Learning Techniques to Detect and Classify Anthracnose Disease for Sustaining Mango Leaf Health
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Mango, a large, cultivated fruit crop in India is the recent research area where research in detecting diseases found in mango leaves, fruits or stems is widely done. This is done to protect it as around $\mathbf{4 0 \%}$ of crop gets destroyed due to pests and diseases. In this paper, study on one of the most popular mango leaf diseases, Anthracnose is done. The paper focuses on detecting the seriousness level of Anthracnose diseased mango leaf. These seriousness levels range from 1 to 10. A hybrid model consisting of fusion of CNN and Random Forest is proposed to extract the diseased part and classify it among seriousness level respectively. The suggested model is also distinguished with other pretrained models such as VGG16, CNN, ResNet50, and RNN to show its outstanding performance in predicting the seriousness level of Anthracnose. The efficiency at each seriousness level of the proposed method is evaluated through precision, recall and F1-score. The results indicated that precision ranges from $\mathbf{9 1. 1 2 \%}$ to $\mathbf{9 7. 8 3 \%}$, recall measures from $\mathbf{9 1. 3 2 \%}$ to $\mathbf{9 9. 2 7 \%}$ and F1-score measures from $92.63 \%$ to $96.64 \%$ when calculated over all the classes. These outcomes exhibit the competence of the proposed CNN+RF model to categorize the seriousness level of anthracnose disease in mango leaf.

articleTitle: Novel Approach for Brain Tumor Classification with CNN and MobileNet
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Brain cancer remains one of the deadliest illnesses today, boasting an alarming mortality rate. Brain tumors arise from abnormal proliferation of cells; categorizing their shape, orientation and location poses a formidable challenge to medical imaging technology; among the various methods used for analysis magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has proven especially successful. Regrettably, this method may lead to algorithmic execution errors and decrease overall algorithmic efficiency. A key component of its invention is the way it implements a CNN-Based multiscale feature extraction model, which is an end-to-end convolutional neural network made especially for the identification of brain tumors. By accurately and consistently classifying extracted features through lengthy training across several datasets, MobileNet-V2 models are capable of categorization. The advantage of this proposed approach gives more robust and accurate framework for classifying brain tumors with CNN-Based multiscale feature extraction model and the integration of the MobileNet-V2 model classification. This delivers promising improvements in medical imaging with regard to the analysis of brain tumors.

articleTitle: Dynamic Surface-enabled Air Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The current generation of 5G technology has reached its limitations in terms of both frequency and wavelength. There is no room for further increasing the frequency, nor can we decrease the wavelength any further. In light of this challenge, alternative solutions for signal transmission must be explored. One such promising avenue is the utilization of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS). RIS refers to a meta surface with the capability to dynamically alter its impedance, enabling efficient manipulation of signal reflection and steering. It holds significant potential for advancing beyond 5G towards the envisioned 6G era. This paper endeavours to delve into the behaviour of RIS through modelling, with a specific focus on its application in Remote Air Quality Monitoring.

articleTitle: Advanced Cross-Layer Protocol Architecture through Modified Ideal Link State Routing (MOLSR)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Due to both the growing need for communication capacity and the ineffective utilization of the currently available spectrum, there is a shortage of spectrum. By leveraging timeserving access to licensed bands, primary consumers can be enhanced without interfering with the unnecessary usage of the current spectrum. For activities like spectrum access and routing, cognitive settings provide a difficult environment since primary users make it difficult to access channels. The problem of routing in cognitive networks is primarily concerned with the job of establishing and preserving wireless multi-hop paths between nodes. Throughout this procedure, it is necessary to decide the frequency that will be used and the number of hops at each path node. In this work, we describe a cross-layer optimization method aimed at accomplishing the previously mentioned objective. For WSN, we proposed to use an adaptive cross-layer optimized subcarrier distribution technique to achieve low energy consumption and optimal performance. A method called the Advanced Cross-Layer Protocol Architecture through Modified Optimal Link Routing (MOLR) protocol was devised in order to accomplish this goal. To distribute the subcarriers to the sensors according to the channel conditions, we provide here a trustworthy scheduling algorithm and proportional algorithms. The study analyzes the performance of the suggested MOLR algorithm and draws conclusions by contrasting the bit error rate and throughput of the simulation results with those of a standard multicarrier (MC) system. First, the Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) and the current queue state are used to adjust each node’s data rate through the use of the congestion-aware routing algorithm. Additionally, we can conclude that the suggested protocol is a very energy-efficient way to perform stable multipath routing at optimal levels with comparatively little network congestion during data transmission.

articleTitle: Crop Health Monitoring: YOLACT Deep Learning Model and Histogram Equalization for Enhanced Leaf Blight Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Leaf blight, a widespread plant disease caused by diverse pathogens (fungi, bacteria, viruses), significantly reduces agricultural productivity through leaf browning, wilting, and decay. Early detection is critical to prevent yield loss, but manual methods are labour-intensive and error prone. This study proposes a novel deep learning approach for automated leaf blight detection and identification. We leverage the YOLACT model, demonstrating high precision in recognizing various plant diseases, including leaf blight. To address challenges like light variations, shadows, and overlapping leaves, we incorporate histogram equalization as a pre-processing step to enhance image contrast and detail. This combined approach, utilizing YOLACT and histogram equalization on camera-captured leaf images, achieves a detection accuracy of 98.94%. This innovative methodology offers an efficient solution for leaf blight detection, contributing to effective disease management and improved agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: IOT-Based Machine Learning for Crop Pattern Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The agricultural sector is grappling with a decline attributed to entrenched traditional practices, leading to low productivity and diminishing farmer morale, which in turn fuels youth migration abroad. Despite its portrayal as an agricultural hub, Agriculture sector faces challenges in enhancing productivity, emphasizing the need to optimize labor efficiency and boost arable land fertility. Smart agriculture, facilitated by IoT-based systems, emerges as a viable solution to address these issues, aiming to retain skilled youth and revitalize the sector. The study aimed to develop an IoT-driven monitoring system for arable land and utilize machine learning for crop prediction and recommendation. Through the integration of IoT and machine learning, farmers can access crucial insights for informed decision-making, potentially reversing the trend of youth emigration and fostering agricultural resurgence within Maharashtra.

articleTitle: Navigating and Transforming the Privacy and Security Challenges of EHRM Through BP Neural Network (BPNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Over the past few years, there has been a major shift in employee expectations because of growing digitalisation and remote work. The growing importance of artificial intelligence (AI) in human resources (HR) to create a better digital employee experience is highlighted by this study. This research describes of a number of common AI applications are given, including chatbots and virtual assistants for hiring, career development, and employee engagement. The study is focussing BP neural network algorithm and developing importance of Artificial Intelligence and EHRM Experience and enlist of the solution of data privacy and security issues in HRM. This study giving possible solution through the implementation of AI and BPNN Algorithms think about while implementing them within organisation, along with any associated risks and possible advantages using AI Algorithm using machine learning.

articleTitle: MEET: Advancing Mobility-Enhanced Edge Intelligence for Efficient and Sustainable 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A machine learning technique known as federated learning, or collaborative learning, allows edge devices to cooperatively integrate to a global model while retaining local copies of their data. The integration of edge AI, IoT, and communication technologies can be greatly improved via federated learning. Because of the abundance of devices, apps, and services available in the modern digital era, users have higher expectations and demands for quality of service (QoS) from network service providers. As a result, extensive deployment of base stations (BSs) overall edge servers (ESs) is required, which raises the cost of deployment and operation—particularly energy expenditures. In order to add flexibility to the creation of the traffic along with mobility management algorithms, the current work makes use of fuzzy logic. Enhancing the quality of service (QoS) of current mobility management solutions and making optimum use of available network resources are the main goals of the research project. In this study, we examine a novel architecture for the efficient and environmentally friendly 6G systems dubbed Mobility-Enhanced Edge inTelligence (MEET), that takes advantage of the detection, communication, computation, and automatic features of intelligent linked vehicles.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Image Clarity: Introducing L2R-SRGAN for Improved Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has seen the emergence of Generative Adversarial Networks or abbreviated as GANs, a promising technology that mimics the actual world inputs to generate synthetic data. This capacity is quite promising, especially in the field of biomedical imaging, where increasing the resolution of X-rays and other medical picture data may significantly enhance clinical procedures and diagnosis. However, because medical technology has limits, obtaining high-resolution pictures of medical conditions can be difficult. There are now proven super-resolution (SR) methods available to address this issue. Rebuilding high-resolution images from their low-resolution counterparts is one of these methods, which provides more detailed information necessary for precise target identification. Super-resolution’s primary objective is to raise the image’s perceived quality. Employing generative adversarial network (GAN) based high-resolution representation learning, more precisely the SRGAN model, this study offers a unique approach for SR or super-resolution of medical images. The suggested technique, called L2RSRGAN, improves upon previous models by utilizing GANs’ strengths in maintaining high-frequency picture information and recreating visual quality. Notably, L2 regularization is integrated into the generator’s residual block, which smoothest out artifacts and reduces overfitting to improve the visual quality of generated high-resolution pictures. Our studies’ findings demonstrate that our model is effective in generating high-quality super-resolved medical pictures, with a SSIM or Structural Similarity Index Measure of 0.2098 and PSNR or peak signal-to-noise ratio of 9.18.

Author Keywords: SSIM or Structural Similarity Index Measure

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Encoder-Decoder Model for Skin Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the medical field, identifying skin cancerous areas and characteristics in dermoscopy images enhances automatic skin cancer classification and diagnosis. However, due to an absence of training data, imbalanced classes, variances within classes, and a failure to concentrate on semantically significant lesion parts, accurately classifying MCS cancer is still challenging. To address these problems, the proposed novel UNet with MobileNet model has been utilized to divide skin cancer into seven different classes. The MobileNet approach is used as a classifier instead of a UNet decoder to avoid overfitting. Additionally, the expert learning framework based on specific domain functions is implemented by the classification model. The performance of test findings with a UNet-MobileNet across seven different Human Machine classes using $\mathbf{1 0, 0 0 0}$ training images (HAM10000) dataset. The overall performance of the HAM10000 dataset’s seven various classes is determined by UNet-MobileNet experiments. The accuracy, Dice, and recall evaluation matrices have been used to assess the proposed scheme. The proposed approach outperforms existing techniques on the skin lesion dataset.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning to Predict Brain Tumour Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The demand of AI is increasing day by day in the medical field. Machine Learning (ML) is subset of AI. ML has become popular tool and widely used to detect several medical diseases at higher accuracy. Promising accuracy of ML algorithms depend on training of digital images like CT, MRI, X-rays etc. In this paper, CNN model is proposed to classify brain tumour into malignant and non-malignant class and comparative study using diverse ML algorithm is conducted and their accuracy is compared. This paper explores role of ML in clinical diagnosis, accurate prediction and clinical analysis regarding brain tumour disease based on various brain tumour dataset like figshare, brats, Kaggle. Proposed CNN model has achieved 98 % promising accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Literary Exploration: A Machine Learning Approach to Book Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today’s era of rapid internet expansion, the need for efficient information retrieval tools is paramount. Recommendation systems serve as indispensable instruments, aiding users in navigating vast datasets swiftly and accessing relevant information. This paper presents a novel approach to book recommendation systems, offering readers a quick and intuitive method to discover their next read. Implementations encompass three algorithms: Popularity-based, Contentbased, and Collaborative-based recommendation systems. The primary focus lies in proposing a swift book idea system, facilitating users in promptly discovering fitting reading materials. By harnessing the power of these algorithms, readers can explore a diverse range of book options tailored to their preferences, enhancing their overall reading experience and satisfaction. Through this study, we aim to contribute to the advancement of recommendation systems, providing valuable insights and practical solutions for optimizing the book discovery process in the digital age.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis of Genetic Algorithms for Optimized Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The natural process of genetic development in living organisms is analogous to the growth of genetic algorithms, an intelligent bionic algorithm with tremendous potential for global optimization. The cornerstone of genetic algorithms is first explained in this publication, which is based on Darwin’s “survival of the fittest.” After that, it briefly goes into the main characteristics of the algorithm and its shortcomings. An extensive explanation of genetic algorithms, including their structure, is given in this paper. It also covers applications, genetic operators particular to a given application, and taxonomy. This review paper covers all facets of genetic algorithms, including the problems and difficulties that arise from them as well as their solutions.

articleTitle: Detection of Brain Tumor using CNN with PCA and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Brain tumours demonstrate a wide variety of visuals and possess many features with typical cells, making the removal of regions of tumour from images a difficult endeavour. Moreover, It requires exhaustive time and work to physically process a big amount of data. In order to train the CNN model, this study used transfer learning to create a model for identifying brain tumours from two-dimensional MRI scans. The study employed the Kaggle dataset, which contains tumours with numerous dimensions, sizes, and magnitudes. Unusual regions of tumour have been successfully eradicated from the brain using deep learning, amongst the most sophisticated specialized approaches for tumour categorization and identification. After extracting image features through deep learning, dimension reduction is accomplished using the PCA algorithm. In particular, to extract image features, we first use a deep convolutional neural network. Next, we introduce and apply the PCA algorithm to achieve dimension reduction. Following that, we used the Hyper Parameter Tuning process on CNN, and the accuracy significantly improved.

articleTitle: Evaluating Machine Learning Techniques for Stock Loss Forecasting: Hypothesis Testing and Model Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Comparative Study is a technique that provides deep insights into the context via provisioning various methodologies and optimizing to get the final conclusion. In this paper, a hypothesis is proposed “Different firms, at different locations influence the stock prices of one another”. In this paper, a comparative analysis is performed to ensure the reliability of the model and prove the hypothesis. Various classical machine learning models like Linear Regression, Lasso and Ridge Regression, Support Vector machines (SVMs), Decision Trees, Random Forests and XGBoost are used to interpret the agenda of the paper uniquely. Prior studies include proposing different models for different firms, but in this paper instead of relying on intuition, a scientific method of testing and documentation in order to arrive at a relationship between independent features. The relationship is proposed in the results section, along with a prediction accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 9 8 7 \%}$.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Economic Forecasting: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Economic experts investigate links between economic entities by analyzing large volumes of data. Econometrics is the process of using statistical methods on economic data to find these links through independent observations. Conventional econometric techniques evaluate economic data using only mathematical and statistical concepts. Conversely, applied econometrics concentrates on real-world observations, like economic results, market price swings, and forecasts. In recent years, Machine Learning models have become increasingly popular across numerous fields, including economics. When compared to typical econometric models, these models provide more accurate analysis of economic data and have shown to be more efficient in tasks like classification. This study examines some machine learning techniques are especially utilized with economic data. It also explores metrics for econometric model analysis and supervised machine learning techniques. The paper explores the possible future uses of the machine learning models that Economic experts find most appealing.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach for License Plate Recognition for Non-Helmeted Motorcycle Riders
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: To protect motorcycle riders, it is now required to detect license plates while they are not wearing helmets. This research uses the real-time object detector YOLOv10 to demonstrate the real time detection of License plate for helmetless motorcyclists. And, a single convolutional neural network was used in the suggested method to automatically identify a non- helmeted motorcyclist’s License Plate from the video stream. Moreover, the false positive caused by the helmeted rider leaving the video frames was removed using the centroid tracking approach and a horizontal reference line. $\mathbf{9 8. 5 2 \%}$ of all License Plate were detected overall.

articleTitle: Digital Entrepreneurship Ecosystem: An Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the enriching technological space day by day, digital entrepreneurship has been competing at newer heights. Different bodies such as entrepreneurial hubs, incubations centres and hatcheries are instrumental in weaving this complex yet very productive network in order to extract synergistic performances. Efforts are budding up but how far we have reach? have ecosystem related discussions won the interest of researchers? is the‘Digital Entrepreneurship Ecosystem (DEE)’ visible as an emerging pattern in the scientific literature? What are the factors affecting the growth of DEE? To find answers to these questions this article explores the development happened so far, for the DEE. For the purpose, the methodology used is the content analysis. The study identifies key parameters affecting the evolution of DEE by examining the extant literature published over these years.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Signal and Image Processing: State-of-the-Art and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized signal and image processing by enabling the creation of complex algorithms with many applications. This study examines deep learning signal and image processing optimization and hardware acceleration strategies. Experimentally evaluating stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and Adam optimization algorithms determines their convergence speed and effectiveness. We also examine how GPUs may accelerate model execution and deep learning inference. Our study reveals that deep learning optimization methodologies and platforms provide several practical challenges and trade-offs. This work may help signal and image processing researchers and practitioners design scalable and efficient solutions. Additionally, their methods illuminate deep learning.

articleTitle: Using Densenet169 for Image-Based Classification of Solar Panel Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of the DenseNet169 deep learning model for the automatic classification of solar panel defects. We used a comprehensive dataset of over $\mathbf{1 1, 0 0 0}$ validated images encompassing six defect categories: bird droppings, dust, electrical damage, physical damage, snow cover, and pristine panels. The model achieves a high training accuracy, demonstrating its ability to learn defect patterns. Validation and test accuracy scores reveal the model’s potential for real-world applications. However, further exploration is warranted to refine the model and address subtle visual similarities between certain defect types, such as physical and electrical damage. This research paves the way for enhanced solar panel inspection techniques, promoting efficient maintenance and optimal energy production.

articleTitle: Harnessing Biomedical Signals: A Modern Fusion of Hadoop Infrastructure, AI, and Fuzzy Logic in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Health monitoring and assessment are becoming more difficult tasks for medical professionals and hospitals due to the rising number of patients and the advent of new diseases and symptoms. Indeed, many health-based sensor technologies face significant hurdles due to the analysis of large and heterogeneous data obtained by biological signals, as well as the requirement for patient classification and disease detection. As a result, an approach is developed in this paper to address the problems with physical infrastructure utilizing Hadoop-based systems. The Fuzzy Interface System Algorithm (FISA) is combined with a four-layer model, and data transfers at these layers are accomplished by using comparable health data that has been gathered at different treatment facilities. In this type of technique, an activation function is added in the center, whose performance attempts to minimize the loss of functionalities found in biological signals. A biological signal processing tool is used to simulate the effectiveness of the proposed paradigm. According to the data, FISA operates more effectively in terms of both cost and signal strength.

articleTitle: Pentagonal Fuzzy Numbers using Fuzzy Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Pentagonal fuzzy numbers provide a more versatile method for uncertainty modelling due to their distinctive asymmetrical representation. For the purpose of this research, we evaluate and understand pentagonal fuzzy numbers by means of fuzzy linear regression models. Incorporating the non-symmetrical nature and five membership degrees of pentagonal fuzzy numbers, we construct a fuzzy linear regression framework. We begin by defining pentagonal fuzzy numbers and going over some of their characteristics. Our next section will go over the fuzzy linear regression model, which has been modified to accommodate pentagonal fuzzy integers. Next, we lay out the steps necessary to use the fuzzy linear regression model with pentagonal fuzzy integers.

articleTitle: AI Based Technique for Language Translation: Breaking the Communication Barriers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Recent years have seen significant developments in language translation technology, which has made it possible to communicate with people all over the world in a seamless manner. In this research paper, a comprehensive investigation into the impact that a variety of cutting-edge technologies, such as Transformers, the Google Translate API, Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Website Translation, Document Translation, Audio Translation, and Voice Assistance, have had on language translation systems is carried out. Based on a comprehensive assessment of the relevant literature, this article provides an explanation of various technologies that have the potential to improve the capacities of translators. In addition, the approaches that can be utilized to incorporate these technologies into the translation systems that are already in place are outlined. By investigating the ways in which these technologies complement one another, the purpose of this study is to offer insights into the changing landscape of language translation and the implications that this landscape has for communication across cultural boundaries.

articleTitle: Image Analysis in Dermatology: A Comprehensive Survey of Disease Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One of the most prevalent medical conditions that people have for a long time is skin disease. The diagnosis of skin diseases is primarily based on the doctors’ experience and the results of skin biopsies, which is a laborious procedure. The detection and classification of skin diseases using photographs requires an automated computer-based approach in order to handle the lack of human experts and increase diagnosis accuracy. Accurately classifying skin problems from images is a crucial task that mostly depends on the characteristics of the diseases being studied. The visual characteristics of many skin illnesses are quite similar, making it more difficult to extract relevant elements from the image. Correctly identifying these illnesses from the images would speed up the diagnostic process, increase accuracy, and provide patients with more efficient and affordable care. This study provides an overview of various approaches and strategies for classifying skin diseases, including deep learning-based and conventional, manually constructed feature-based approaches.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Machine Learning Models for Heart Disease Prediction: An Exploratory Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Heart disease is a significant issue in today’s society, responsible for more deaths per year than any other disease. It includes a variety of cardiovascular-related issues, including arrhythmias, embryonic heart abnormalities, and coronary artery disease (CAD). This disease is increasingly common among young people, with studies attributing it to chronic stress, smoking, and poor lifestyle choices. As the number of cases continues to rise, there is a need for advanced algorithms and predictive tools for heart disease. The aim of this study is to assess whether a patient is currently experiencing heart disease or is at risk of developing it.. Hospitals can use automated diagnoses based on data science algorithms and data mining approaches to predict heart disease. This study focuses on implementing supervised ML algorithms such as Decision Trees, Random Forest, KNN, Gaussian Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression, and SVC. The DT and RF algorithms were shown to have $97 \%$ and $93 \%$ accuracy on the dataset utilized in this analysis, which was gathered via Kaggle.

articleTitle: Hybrid Edge Detection Method for Autonomous Vehicle Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Edge detection is a fundamental job in image processing that is frequently employed in a wide range of applications. The Canny edge detection technique is wellknown for its high accuracy in detecting edges, but the Sobel edge detection approach is popular due to its quick calculation time. We present a hybrid edge detection approach in this study that incorporates the strengths of both methods. We first apply the Sobel operator to the input picture to generate an estimated edge map, which we then filter using the Canny method’s non-maximum suppression and hysteresis thresholding processes. On a set of typical benchmark photos, we next compare the performance of our hybrid technique to that of the Canny and Sobel methods. Our tests demonstrate that, when compared to the Canny approach, the suggested method not only achieves excellent accuracy in edge identification but also greatly decreases computing time.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing-Driven Voice Recognition System for Enhancing Desktop Assistant Interactions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A voice assistant is a software application designed to perform tasks and provide services based on the user's commands. This involves recognizing speech patterns and responding with synthetic speech. With these assistants, users can automate various tasks, including sending emails, managing schedules, and playing media. As technology progresses, people increasingly rely on these tools, particularly computers. Traditionally, commands are input through keyboards, but voice input offers a more accessible and user-friendly alternative. This is particularly beneficial for visually impaired individuals who find it challenging to use a keyboard. Voice assistants enhance the usability of computers by understanding and processing voice commands accurately. This allows for hands-free operation, improving convenience and productivity. Their advanced speech recognition technology involves sophisticated algorithms and machine learning to understand natural language and context. Once commands are processed, the assistant executes the tasks and provides feedback through voice or other means. For visually impaired users, voice assistants are transformative, enabling them to interact with their computers without needing a visual interface. They can perform tasks such as browsing the internet, sending messages, and controlling smart home devices through voice commands alone. Overall, voice assistants represent a significant advancement in making technology more accessible and user-friendly, allowing for a more inclusive environment where users can efficiently complete tasks through voice interaction.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques in Training and Applying Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research, examines the progress and use of large language models (LLMs). The research analyses the development process of LLMs, concentrating on the many models now accessible. We will begin by addressing fundamental concepts, including the mathematical models used in the process. Large Language Models provide a robust basis for the development of forthcoming applications in artificial intelligence and natural language processing.

articleTitle: Modeling, Simulation, and Analytical Comparison of PID, ANN, and ANFIS Controllers in Two-Area AGC Systems using MATLAB Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A two-area Automatic Generation Control (AGC) model is utilized to evaluate the performance of PID, ANN, and ANFIS controllers, with a novel approach of combining all three controllers into a single model. MATLAB/Simulink version 2019(a) has been used for model development. Within the same AGC model, PID, ANN and ANFIS controllers were implemented separately for comparison. The primary data for the ANN and ANFIS training were derived from the input and output of the PID controller. The findings of this study indicate that the ANFIS controller outperforms both ANN and traditional PID controllers in terms of Settling-time, Risetime, Overshoot, and other performance metrics. The ranking of the controller’s performance is ANFIS, ANN, PID respectively. However, the performance of the combined controller’s model was found to be the least effective.

articleTitle: Enhanced Prediction of Lung Cancer Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Lung cancer has emerged as major cause of cancer-related fatalities worldwide. Therefore, early lung cancer detection, prediction, and diagnosis have become essential because such diagnosis can accelerate and simplify clinical management. The healthcare sector has implemented several machine learning-based systems to improve the diagnosis and treatment of cancers based on their accurate results. Machine learning algorithms such as ETC (Extra Trees Classifier), NB (Naive Bayes), LR (Logistic Regression), EGB (Extreme Gradient Boosting), LGB (Light Gradient Boosting) Machine, KNN-Classifier, SVM-LinearKernel, DTC (Decision Tree Classifier), LDA (Linear Discriminant Analysis), GBC (Gradient Boosting Classifier), RC (Ridge Classifier), RFC (Random Forest Classifier), ABC (Ada-Boost Classifier), DC (Dummy classifier), and QDA (Quadratic-Discriminant-Analysis) are used in the healthcare industry to analyze and predict lung cancer progression. This research examined the current machine learning schemes reported their advantages and disadvantages. By reducing the need for researchers to review multiple publications, this paper will help them apply the relevant models more quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: Comparative Sentiment Analysis of Cryptocurrency Apps Using BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has significantly advanced the ability to analyse and interpret textual data, playing a crucial role in understanding user sentiments. This study applies cutting-edge NLP techniques to perform sentiment analysis on reviews from India’s top cryptocurrency apps and Twitter data. Given the growing interest in cryptocurrencies, understanding user sentiment is vital for market insights and product improvement. We collected a diverse dataset from the Google Play store and Twitter, encompassing 7,197 reviews and numerous tweets. Utilizing the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model, known for its deep learning capabilities, we processed and analysed the data. The dataset underwent thorough pre-processing, including tokenization and the removal of irrelevant elements. Our analysis compared the BERT model’s performance with traditional classifiers such as Naive Bayes and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Findings show that BERT significantly outperformed other models, achieving superior precision, recall, accuracy and F1-scores. These results underscore the effectiveness of advanced NLP models in sentiment analysis, particularly for understanding public sentiment towards cryptocurrency apps in India. Future research will explore sentiment analysis on a broader range of platforms and fine-tuning BERT model parameters to further enhance performance and accuracy.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis and Investigation of Unicorn Startup Companies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Unicorn enterprises, valued at a minimum of $\$1$ billion, have attracted the interest of entrepreneurs, investors, and researchers. Nevertheless, the significance of the field of action in determining the success of unicorns has received relatively little focus. This study investigates unicorn businesses specifically focusing on their geographical locations, industry, investors, and financial valuations. The investigation employs a combination of quantitative and qualitative methodologies to examine the backgrounds of 1201 founders. The present work seeks to offer valuable insights for entrepreneurs, investors, and the startup ecosystem. It integrates knowledge and experiences to present a holistic outlook, providing a distinctive viewpoint on prosperous companies and stimulating additional investigation to enhance our understanding of the emergence of unicorn startups by applying data analysis and visualizations.

articleTitle: Neural Network to detect Cervical Cancer early using Pap smears Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In India uterine cervix cancer is the moment most common cancer among ladies. Cancer of Uterine Cervix in rural area women are at higher risk than the urban area women due to less awareness. Cancer of Uterine Cervix is also known as cervical cancer. The Pap spread may be a screening test utilized to identify cervical cancer. Pap smear screenings are conducted by pathologists, but there is a shortage of pathologists in India. Automatic detection method helps in the early detection of cervical cancer. Based on the literature review, segmentation, feature extraction and classification are used for classification of cervical cancer cells. In this paper Convolution Neural Network is used for the classification of the datasets into 2 classes (normal and abnormal). In this paper, Pap smear images are collected from Pathology Lab at Jaipur. First the CNN model was applied on the public available dataset and for the validation of work it was implemented on PapsmearJP dataset. Several epochs are employed for the different ratio of training and testing dataset on public dataset SIPaKMeD and PapsmearJP dataset. In this paper, we achieved a maximum accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$ with 70 epochs on $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$ training and $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$ testing dataset on PapsmearJP dataset.

articleTitle: Advancing AI-Based Security Mechanisms for 5G Networks: Overcoming Privacy Concerns
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence and machine learning are critical components in ramping up security for 5G networks - and later 6 G ones. With the introduction of 5 G, revolutionizing various sectors, the paper emphasizes the paramount importance of innovative security mechanisms to safeguard these critical infrastructures against sophisticated cyber threats. Naive Bayes, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm, Decision Trees Multi-Layer Perceptrons are all considered for inclusion and application of various machine learning techniques. It explains in detail how each of these have been used so far in detecting network intrusion. While acknowledging limitations such as the Naive Bayes model’s performance and misclassification issues, the study reviews the results and assesses the benefits and drawbacks of different machine learning algorithms, including Non-Linear SVM, Sequential Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, Artificial Neural Networks, Convolutional Neural Networks. The findings underscore the significance of traditional methods like SVMs and the need for optimization in the case of RNNs. Ultimately, this study contributes to enhancing the security and resilience of advanced wireless networks in a dynamic threat landscape.

articleTitle: Breaking Barriers: Transformer-Based Summarization and Translation of English Legal Documents to Malayalam
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Translating legal documents from English to Malayalam is significant in bridging the language gap and making information accessible to all irrespective of their expertise in English. This work looks at developing an end-toend deep learning model to summarize legal documents in English and further translate them into Malayalam. The summarization task is handled by the pre-trained model T5base transformer fine-tuned on the CUAD dataset for taskspecific modelling. It is evaluated on the BigPatent dataset of legal documents to test the efficiency of the fine-tuned model. Bleu score and Rouge score are used as performance metrics. The fine-tuned model gives around a $5 \%$ increase in summarization evaluation. The MarianMT transformer processes the summarized text to output the translated Malayalam document. Summarization and translation of text originally written in English facilitates individuals who are not proficient in the language, an easy comprehension of the technical aspects involved in the legal agreement. Additionally, it helps individuals by recapitulating difficult-to-understand terms in their native language.

articleTitle: Advanced Predictive Modelling for Bitcoin and Ethereum Price Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Over the last decade, Bitcoin and Ethereum have become cryptocurrencies that have attracted the attention of the financial world with their potential for business transactions and the use of new blockchain technology. This study is dedicated to predicting Bitcoin and Ethereum price trends from 2014 to 2024, covering the main period of growth and change in the cryptocurrency market. This research aims to develop a good forecasting model through a comprehensive analysis of historical price data, market trends, economic progress and macroeconomy. It uses techniques such as machine learning, time series analysis, and sentiment analysis to try to predict future price movements of Bitcoin more accurately and Ethereum. By revealing the fundamental principles influencing cryptocurrency prices, this research leads to a deeper understanding of the dynamics driving digital assets and their impact on the financial sector.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Road Anamoly Detection Using Smart Phone Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The quality of the conventional transport system has been significantly impacted recently by the swift advancement of emerging technologies and the rapid growth of the economy. ITS which seeks to enhance the transportation network, is gaining popularity. Additionally, one of the main goals of ITS is to enhance traffic safety, and potholes seriously compromise the safety of vehicles. Therefore, by establishing a real-time pothole-detecting system and disseminating pothole information, drivers’ safety may be enhanced. For assessing road conditions, we propose to analyze various supervised machine learning approaches employing mobile sensors and GPS data obtained from cellphones. Our research focuses on classifying three primary class labels: deep transverse cracks, potholes, and smooth roads. We test our hypothesis that employing information from the three sensors’ axes yields more accurate results than using data from just one. We also study how well deep neural networks do in classifying different types of traffic situations. Our findings demonstrate that smartphone sensor axes outperform models using only one axis. This demonstrates that vibration signals for road abnormalities contain information throughout all three axes. We also note that substantially more accurate data classification is obtained when using neural networks. The techniques discussed here can be applied more broadly to monitor road conditions that could endanger people’s safety. Commuters in addition to giving pertinent authorities maintenance information.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Generating Synthetic News Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Synthetic news production, language translation, and text summarization have all seen significant success with sophisticated text generating techniques. Although neural model-generated false news detection has advanced recently, the results are not easily transferable to the efficient identification of misinformation created by humans. The significant contrasts between fake news produced by machines and those written by humans, including style and underlying intentions, are what prevents them from successfully transferring. In light of this, we provide a brand-new framework for creating training cases that draw inspiration from the well-known techniques and styles of propaganda written by people. But these methods might be misused to spread false information. Researchers create superior news material using a unique generation technique called FACTGEN in order to gain a greater understanding the possible risks associated with synthetic news. Because most text generation techniques now in use either provide very little more information or break continuity across the inputs and outputs, the synthetic news becomes less reliable. The results of experiments conducted on real-world datasets show that FACTGEN generates news items that are bursting with data and accurate.

articleTitle: Optimization of Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Using Energy Detection and Matched Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cognitive Radio (CR) is an innovative wireless communication technology designed to intelligently and dynamically adapt to varying spectrum conditions. Unlike traditional radio systems, CR empowers devices to autonomously sense and access unused spectrum bands, optimizing spectrum utilization and enhancing overall communication efficiency. However, a main component of cognitive radio networks is sensing of spectrum, which gives devices the ability to recognize and locate open frequency bands for opportunistic spectrum access. This process plays a pivotal role in enhancing spectrum utilization and addressing the spectrum scarcity challenge. Various sensing techniques are available, including energy detection, matched filtering, which are employed to achieve reliable and efficient spectrum sensing. Hence, this work focused on optimizing spectrum sensing techniques through a synergistic combination of energy detection techniques such as: classical energy detection (CID); improved energy detection (IED); general energy detection (GED); variable threshold energy detection (VED) and matched filter detection. In order to balance computing efficiency and detection accuracy, characteristics like threshold levels and filter designs are fine-tuned during the optimization process. The performance evaluation of each technique has been evaluated by considering false alarm probability (Pfa) verses probability of detection under various scenarios for all the mentioned techniques.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Solutions for Enhancing Data Integrity and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The study emphasizes evaluating the effectiveness of blockchain-based solutions in improving data security and data integrity. By analysing the fundamental aspects of blockchain technologies, the significant roles of blockchain have been discussed in ensuring data transparency, auditability, and immutability. The study also investigates the potential business solutions across various industries along with its contribution in safeguarding sensitive information. The potential limitations and challenges of implementing blockchain-enabled solutions are effectively addressed while providing significant mitigation strategies. The analysis highlights the potential of blockehain in transforming the data landscape by enhancing data integrity and security.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning Architectures for Accurate Wind Speed and Power Prediction in Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The advanced deep learning models that are incorporated in this paper present strategies on the forecasting of Wind velocity and wind power. While metaheuristic strategies do not define the system and work to establish that the given inputs and outputs can be linked, deep learning models render a higher capacity to capture temporal and spatial dependencies in wind data. It is expected that through dealing with big data to recognize complex relations, the improvements in wind speed and power prediction would be immensely increased. Thus, this approach allows for more accurate and specific forecasting favoring the efficient functioning of wind energy and its incorporation into the electricity grid. The performance of these deep learning models is tested through New Delhi, India specific case incrementally showing that these models are very computationally efficient and have better prediction capabilities.

articleTitle: Intelligent Learning Models for Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cancer poses a significant global health and economic challenge, with $\mathbf{2 0}$ million new cases and 9.7 million deaths reported in 2022 itself. Early detection of cancer is crucial for improved survival rates, reduced mortality, making it imperative to develop advanced diagnostic tools. Intelligent Learning Models (ILMs) utilizing Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) by leveraging large datasets and complex pattern recognition are posing as the potential diagnostics solution for cancers. This paper reviews the current state of ILMs, evaluates existing models and case study for diagnosis prognosis and treatment of cancers.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic-Enhanced Multi-Sensor Hardware Module for Real-time Fire Detection and Notification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)

authors.preferredName: P J N V V S M Vinay Kumar
authors.firstName: P J N V V S M Vinay

abstract: Despite the extensive efforts devoted to fire safety campaigns, the annual incidence of fire outbreaks continues to surge. This alarming trajectory underscores the pressing need for an advanced system engineered to detect fires in their early stages and actively contribute to fire-fighting operations. Contemporary research endeavors are primarily oriented towards the refinement of multi-sensor algorithms designed for fire detection, with the overarching objective of bolstering the sensitivity of fire detection devices while concurrently curtailing the occurrence of false alarms. This intellectual work introduces a meticulously designed and implemented multisensor fire detection and notification system, employing fuzzy logic as its fundamental framework. The essential role of a microcontroller comes into play as it processes data collected from an array of sensors, including the MQ2 smoke sensor, TMP102 temperature sensor, and DFRobot flame sensor. The utilization of fuzzy logic algorithms facilitates precise determination of the prevailing fire status, further enhancing the reliability and effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: TIR-based Light Pipe Technology for Sustainable Energy Efficiency and Natural Lighting Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research paper explores the design, working principles, and applications of light pipes, which utilize the principle of total internal reflection to channel natural sunlight into building interiors. By efficiently capturing and directing sunlight, light pipes offer a sustainable solution for reducing the reliance on artificial lighting, thus contributing significantly to energy savings. The study examines various configurations and materials used in light pipe construction to maximize light transmission and minimize losses. Additionally, the integration of light pipes with heat management systems is discussed, highlighting their potential to reduce indoor heating loads by dissipating excess thermal energy. This dual functionality not only enhances energy efficiency but also improves thermal comfort within buildings. Through case studies and experimental data, the paper demonstrates the effectiveness of light pipes in diverse architectural contexts, underscoring their role in promoting sustainability and reducing the environmental footprint of the built environment. The findings suggest that widespread adoption of light pipe technology could lead to substantial energy savings and contribute to global sustainability goals.

articleTitle: Delta-γ Modeling of Wireless System Resilience in Multipath Fading and Interference Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this paper, we pursue the resilience of wireless communication systems in multipath fading and interference environments utilizing Delta- $\gamma$ modelling. Furthermore, fading phenomena such as Rayleigh/Rician/Nakagami channels can be simulated to examine the impact on important performance metrics like SNR, BER and throughput. Different types of interference scenarios, covering co-channel and adjacent channel interferences are also studied to understand impact on system capacity as well as reliability.
