This article investigates the use of adaptive modulation techniques, multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) strategies and advanced interference management schemes by extensive simulations.The results illustrate the importance of adaptive strategies in overcoming fading and interference which leads to an increase in system resilience as well as a robust communication link. Metrics for the outage probability and mean time to failure (MTTF) can inform how reliable systems are across operational scenarios. This work reconciles theory with practice to provide a systematic way of controlling the operational parameters in wireless networks under varying conditions. These lessons will be crucial in steering the design of forthcoming wireless systems that must more reliably satisfy a broader set of application requirements.

articleTitle: Assessment and Summary of Inverter and Induction Motor Efficiency in Dual Electric Vehicle Drive Systems Across Urban and Highway Driving Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Recent studies have shown that battery-powered motors and power electronic inverters are crucial parts of contemporary dual electric vehicle driving systems. Consequently, the traction engine and its accompanying drive must run at peak efficiency all the way through the driving schedule. The traction motor and drive system in a hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) typically utilize the full range of torque and speed operating conditions. With this in mind, the objective of this work is to estimate the efficiencies of the inverter and motor over common urban and highway driving patterns. The significant losses within a standard three-phase DC/AC traction inverter, including switching and conduction losses in the insulated-gate bipolar transistors and antiparallel diodes, are modelled and approximated for both urban and highway driving. Using an Automobile Simulator program, a medium-sized SUV equipped with an induction motor was simulated, accounting for copper losses in the stator, rotor, and core. The average efficiencies of the inverter drive and induction traction motor are then evaluated and summarized for both urban and highway driving conditions. Finally, the overall efficiency of the traction motor drive system is assessed based on the individual component performance analyses.

articleTitle: Noval Technology of Nano-Robot for Promising Drug Delivery System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The study of Nanorobots has gained attention lately. It is utilized in focused drug administration, operations, illness examination, and medical treatments, it offers enormous promise for use in healthcare. The proposed tiny nanorobots can travel unassisted, making it feasible to transport drugs to locations that are difficult to access. This method is contrary to conventional medicine delivery, which relies on blood flow to reach the intended location. Exogenous power (magnetic fields, light energy, audio fields, electric fields, etc.) or endogenous power (chemical reaction energy) were used to power nanorobots. To confirm the effects of nanorobots in vivo drug delivery, more biological experiments are needed. The primary topics of this study are the state of different technology behind, obstacles, and prospects for nanorobot development for drug delivery systems.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient Improved Clustering based Data Compression Protocol in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Extensive research methodologies have revealed that wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are being utilized across a diverse array of applications, facilitating wireless data collection, communication, and intelligent computing. Sensor nodes (SNs) are compact in size, battery-powered and they are incorporated with intelligent computing capabilities to detect changes in the physical environment. These SNs convert sensed data into digital format and transmit it to a central data collection node. Nevertheless, SNs face resource limitations and rely on finite battery power. On the other hand, continuous monitoring of the physical environment consumes significant energy, leading to rapid battery depletion and potential node failure. Therefore, energy preservation in WSNs is regarded as a paramount concern to sustain node functionality over extended durations. In this research paper, we proposed a model that employs a Compressive sensing (CS) in WSN which optimizes transmission rates and distributes traffic load evenly in the network. Moreover, Cluster-based strategies are also incorporated with CS for overall network energy efficiency and to effectively extend the lifespan of the network. This approach has resulted in the development of an energyefficient clustering protocol, referred to as the An Energy Efficient Improved Clustering-Based Data Compression Protocol (EEIC-DCP), proposed specifically for WSNs. Extensive simulations have validated that our proposed approach significantly improves energy conservation and prolongs the network’s operational lifespan.

articleTitle: AI Enabled Smart Teaching Assistants
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The objective of this study is to focus on AI enabled Smart Teaching Assistants (STAs) and how they may be used in schools throughout India to lighten the load on teachers. It aims to comprehend how STAs could be used in the classroom while assuring the success, happiness, and well-being of both students and teachers. Research reveals that STAs are potentially a significant aid in the context of review of examination, post-school tutorial, grading and scoring, and student achievement reporting. This is based on discussions with thirty STA users from academia and education, as well as a thorough review of the past literature and information of STAs. However, in order to prevent the learning experience from being compromised, they must be properly developed with a focus on student support. STAs like any other AI is subject to multiple loopholes pertaining to plagiarism and creativity theft. Experts wrapped up stating that STA may assist a teacher but never replace a teacher.

articleTitle: Premature Birth Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms – A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Premature birth (PB) presents a significant global health challenge, often leading to enduring developmental issues and neonatal mortality. Approximately 4-16% of new-born worldwide is born prematurely. Leveraging machine learning, a predictive model has been developed to anticipate preterm birth risk. This model evaluates maternal characteristics and other pertinent factors to provide timely alerts to healthcare providers. Through the analysis of extensive datasets, the system offers valuable insights for forecasting and classifying preterm birth risks. First and foremost, this study aims to enhance prenatal care and outcomes for high-risk pregnancies by harnessing artificial intelligence to refine the accuracy and promptness of preterm birth prediction. Employing machine learning algorithms, our study achieves a remarkable 99% accuracy rate throughout all the techniques.

articleTitle: Applying Keyword Extraction Techniques on Customer’s Feedback of a Software Product to Accelerate Agile Based Development
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Keywords or key-phrase extraction is an important task in almost all the scenarios where natural language processing is required. Present paper analyses various keyword extraction techniques for improving a softwareproduct, taking into consideration an agile based development approach. Feedback, reviews given by customers are always written in an unrestricted natural language. If we are able to extract keywords from this feedback, at predevelopment stage, quality of a software can be improved, and it would be saving efforts and time of developers. Keywords provide a quick review about sentiments, prioritize customer needs, enhance user experience, provide marketing insights and also analyse the trends. Change-request submitted in last stages of development process require a lot of reworks. Hence this work can be beneficial in agile based development process to develop an end product which incorporates suggestions given by users.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning for Sustainable Development Goals
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set forth by the UN provide a call for immediate action to end poverty, safeguard the environment, and guarantee that by 2030 everyone will live in peace and prosperity. Achieving these ambitious goals necessitates the harnessing of innovative technologies and methodologies, particularly within the realm of Machine Learning (ML). ML will play a critical role in propelling forward, the SDGs. By leveraging the capabilities of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to process vast datasets, identify patterns, and facilitate accurate predictions, these technologies offer unprecedented opportunities to address complex societal and environmental challenges across diverse sectors. A comprehensive literature review is conducted to explore the extensive applications of ML in achieving the SDGs, highlighting its potential to revolutionize traditional approaches and foster productivity. Issues about data privacy, algorithmic bias, and ethical considerations are critically analyzed to underscore the necessity for a balanced approach.

articleTitle: RSF: Smart Farming Using Machine Learning-Based Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Undoubtedly, agriculture and its associated sectors are the primary sources of income in rural areas of India. It is also an important contributor to the national GDP. The agricultural sector can grow with size and production technology supports the farmer crop cultivation on healthy soil. The crop yield per hectare is lamentable compared to global standards. In this research work, farmers propose a practical and user-friendly system, which can predict crop yield recommendation for use. Farmers access it through a proposed integrated system with machine learning and application interface. GPS: Global Positioning System (GPS) enables one to know his/her whereabouts. Hence, it is also possible to make a farm location on Google using this system. Users can input weather situations in the study area & soil health information required for predictive modelling. The model provides appropriate crops or anticipates yields on the farmer’s requests. Machine Learning approaches, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Neural Network (NN), and Random Forest (RF) are used to determine crop yield. The recommendation of the optimal machine-learning model is passed to the RSF: application interface for informed decisions about crop cultivation.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Applications in Short-term Financial Forecasting: A Comparative Analysis with Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Financial analysis and trading are very crucial in any economy. It holds a significant importance to generate income and reducing income equality, especially in developing countries where inequality and employment are major concerns. Forex analysis deals with the currency exchange and plays a major role in world economy. Accurate prediction of currency market is almost impossible as there are many unpredictable factors may instantly come to play and greatly affect the market scenario. Hence, long term predictions may not be very successful however, short term predictions or very short-term prediction may be accurate up to some extent. This work tries to predict the next day currency exchange rate (US Dollar to Indian Rupees) using machine learning models. Three machine learning models such as ANN-PSO, RNN and LSTM have been implemented to predict the next day currency exchange rate. The data set used in this work is the daily trading data downloaded from the www.investing.com for the period 1st January 2020 to 20th May 2024. Using the close price of these values the models were trained and the value for the day 21st May 2024 has been predicted. The predicted value for 21st May is $83.39,83.27$ and 83.47 by RNN, LSTM and ANN-PSO models respectively. Comparing this with the actual value of 21st May 2024, the accuracy thus calculated for the models are $\mathbf{9 9. 8 6 \%}, \mathbf{9 9. 9 8 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 9. 7 8 \%}$ by RNN, LSTM and ANN-PSO models respectively.

articleTitle: Optimizing Wind Turbine Placement for Enhanced Energy Production Using Modified Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The optimal site of wind farms is determined using an updated genetic algorithm approach, which maximizes output capacity while reducing the amount of turbines built and the area used by each farm. In particular, two examples are examined: One kind of wind is a homogeneous wind that blows in just one direction, while the other two are also possible. In the first scenario (a), 599 individuals were first split into 25 subpopulations and then evolved three thousand times. The evolution of case (b) takes place over three thousand generations, beginning with $\mathbf{6 0 0}$ individuals distributed over 19 subpopulations. Every design’s fitness, overall power generation, power output efficiency, and ideal configurations are all part of the findings. The results show that the modified genetic algorithm provides much better results compared to the conventional Genetic Algorithm method.

articleTitle: Innovative Advances: Crafting an Intelligent Controller for Home Energy Management Systems with Seamless Integration of Renewable Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research proposes an improved energy administration and optimization technique that utilizes fuzzy logic algorithms and incorporates many inputs and outputs (I/O) along with a cost-effective method. This technology is used in the administration of hybrid electric power sources, which include PV cell, turbines (wind), and grid-supportive devices. The novelty of this research lies in the precedence of solar PV, wind turbine, and storage system energy sources above the grid network. The grid network is only used in case of bad weather. This system can supply an average household with up to $\mathbf{4, 0 0 0}$ Wh of energy per day. In addition, by using an electrolyzing system, surplus unconventional energy produced during good weather conditions is used to produce hydrogen, which is well-suited for household cooking and heating purposes. Developing an intelligent economic strategy by using fuzzy technology to bolster improved energy management and optimization methods. The fuzzy logic software at the heart of this system has been written on the Arduino 2560 mega microcontroller. It is responsible for allocating events and considering all possible circumstances. This system has been developed using a flowchart that facilitates hybrid system management. In order to maintain uninterrupted housing, it is advisable to use strategies such as methodologies, a parametric search, and simulations to precisely characterize the system components that provide assistance to the power grid. The effectiveness of the recommended method is confirmed by the display of output directives generated by the electronic switches.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models in Customer Behaviour Prediction: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Understanding and predicting customer shopping behaviour is essential for enhancing user experience, optimizing marketing strategies, and increasing sales in e-commerce. This study compares various machine learning models to forecast customer behaviour patterns using a dataset of customer demographics, purchase frequency, and product preferences. K-Means clustering identified distinct customer segments, which were utilized as the dependent variable for classification tasks. We evaluated K-Nearest Neighbours, Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Classifier, and Random Forest in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. These ML algorithms have been evaluated and their performance in customer behaviour prediction is compared. The feature importance analysis identified the main factors affecting customer behaviour, enabling more effective targeted marketing strategies. This paper emphasizes the importance of selecting appropriate models for behaviour prediction and offers a framework for e-commerce analytics. Comparative analysis of customer behaviour through different ML models has been evaluated on which, the Gradient Boosting and Random Forest models has given better performance in terms of accuracy and robustness. Our results indicate significant variations in model performance, with Random Forest and Gradient Boosting demonstrating superior accuracy and robustness compared to KNN and SVC.

articleTitle: A Novel IPv6 Address Generation Method for IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the help of the Internet of Things (IoT), a vast network of billions or perhaps trillions of connected objects with the ability of self-awareness and self-configuration will be formed. These devices will communicate data with each another. Standard protocols, energy-efficient and secure wireless communication, and the assignment of distinct identities such as IPv6 addresses are all required in this diverse Internet of Things network. Sustaining device geolocation and unique identification in such a network is a major challenge for location-aware applications to function properly. In order to tackle this issue, the study presents Time-Location Based IPv6 Addressing (TLB-IPv6), a stateless spatio-temporal addressing scheme. The idea behind this strategy is that two objects cannot be in the same location at the same time. The target IPv6 address is created using the device’s time and location data, and it is subsequently allocated to the device after being confirmed to be unique via the Duplicate Address Detection (DAD) protocol. In addition to maintaining temporal and spatial information, TLB-IPV6 ensures a distinct identity for big networks. Analytical proofs show that TLB-IPV6 consistently generates unique identities, provided there are no technological constraints. An assessment of TLB-IPV6’s effectiveness in allocating distinct IPv6 addresses is evaluated on measures like Communication-Overhead and Assignment-Success-Rate (ASR). Experimental results indicate that TLB-IPV6 achieves a high ASR with reduced Communication Overhead in the network.

articleTitle: Abnormality Detection in Brain Tissue: A deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Glioblastoma, the most prevalent and aggressive form of brain cancer in adults, presents substantial challenges in both diagnosis and treatment. A crucial prognostic factor and an indicator of chemotherapy responsiveness in this context is the identification of MGMT promoter methylation within the tumour. However, the existing genetic analysis procedures for brain cancer involve invasive methods and time-intensive processes. The primary aim of this initiative is to enhance diagnosis and treatment strategies for glioblastoma patients, with a focus on reducing the reliance on invasive procedures and streamlining the genetic analysis workflow. Through the utilization of radio genomics, the goal is to develop a non-invasive approach that predicts the genetic profile of the tumour exclusively through imaging to tackle these challenges, The Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) and the Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention Society (MICCAI Society) have collaborated to host a competition focused on glioblastoma diagnosis and treatment planning. The competition revolves around the use of MRI scans to construct a model capable of accurately forecasting the genetic subtype of glioblastoma by identifying the presence of MGMT promoter methylation. The positive outcomes derived from this competition are poised to significantly contribute to less invasive diagnostic procedures and more personalized treatment strategies for individuals battling brain cancer. This abstract provides a comprehensive overview of the project’s objectives, the contextual backdrop of the competition, and the potential transformative impact on the management and survival rates of those affected by glioblastoma.

articleTitle: IoT and AI Synergy in Society: Robotics and Automation Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Internet of Things, or IoT, is a relatively new Internet revolution that is being successfully adopted by the corporate, industrial, healthcare, and economic sectors as well as other areas of the modern information society. Specifically, IoT with artificial intelligence (AI) support improves a great deal the performance in a wide range of daily applications with a focus on automation systems, robotics, transportation, and business. Smart automation in the manufacturing sector is now possible thanks to the development of Industry 4.0. The BRDT algorithm is used in this work to track how much energy appliances and machinery use, forecast behaviour, and identifies unusual conduct. When the suggested system’s efficiency is compared to current approaches, it provides an efficiency of $\mathbf{8 5 \%}$. The application of this technology raises a number of standardisation, security, resource planning, legal, and paradigm-shifting business challenge problems. The whole supply chain and all of its actors, from producers to end users, are crucial to the success or failure of Industry 4.0 deployment.

articleTitle: Video Defogging with a Sample-Based Defogging Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Increased atmospheric particulate matter has resulted in increased fog and haze, which has reduced visibility and presented a significant challenge for computer vision applications. Photos taken under these conditions typically have low contrast and poor visibility, making object detection, tracking, and recognition more difficult. As a result, improving the clarity and contrast of photos and videos—also referred to as de-fogging—is necessary. Real-time de-fogging is important, and the minimum preserving sub-sampling-based technique works well for foggy videos because of its effectiveness and suitability for a wide range of image types. This technique integrates scene change detection to preserve temporal and spatial coherence while controlling computational costs. Experimental results demonstrate that this video de-fogging approach achieves excellent spatial and temporal coherence.

articleTitle: Students Level of Trust in the Use of AI Chatbots in Higher Education: A Quantitative Analysis Adopting Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: AI chatbots are a type of artificial intelligence (AI) that is revolutionizing many fields. They can learn from conversations and interactions with others, which allows them to answer questions, provide information, and complete tasks better. This is especially helpful in the field of education, where AI chatbots can personalize students’ learning and help them solve problems. However, there are still challenges to overcome, such as building user trust by addressing concerns about experience, reliability, and ensuring that AI chatbots can understand user intent and provide accurate information. This research will explore the level of student trust in AI chatbots in higher education by adapting several variables from the TAM model. This study assessed its hypothesis by collecting data from 98 respondents via an online survey questionnaire. The collected data was analyzed using the PLSSEM method. In this study, it will be shown how students can trust an AI chatbot from the relationship between Willingness to Use, Knowledge, Concern, Perceived Ease of Use, Perceived Usefulness, Attitude Toward Use, and Actual System Use.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Predicting Heart Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Heart attacks are the leading cause of deaths worldwide. However, diagnosing them can be difficult as their symptoms can resemble those of other illnesses. There are several types of heart diseases, which makes identifying symptoms challenging. Mistaking these symptoms for something else can be very harmful to the patient. Heart disease is caused by various factors such as high bp, unhealthy diet, smoking, and lack of physical activity. New approaches are required to address heart problems since more young people are suffering from heart attacks, and current medical tools and diagnostic procedures are insufficient. This research aims to investigate the use of Machine Learning (ML) algorithms in heart attack prediction, emphasizing early detection and thereby increasing life expectancy and decreasing mortality rate. This research tries to determine the most successful models for heart attack prediction by analyzing KNN, Logistic Regression, XGBClassifier and ExtraTreeClassifier approaches. It also discusses the impact of these technologies in changing healthcare practices. The work synthesizes findings from 2016 to 2023, aiming to provide a comprehensive overview of the past works done in the field of heart attack detection and also proposes a methodology to predict heart disease using machine learning.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive ML Framework for Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to identify and stop network intrusions in their companies and to stop network breaches, security analysts and administrators must overcome numerous obstacles. Timely detection of the intrusion is essential. Principal component analysis (PCA) is used for dimensionality reduction, and ant colony optimization (ACO) is used for feature selection. Classification is done using the Extreme Gradient Boost Algorithm (XG-Boost) using the NSL-KDD dataset. To find the ideal hyperparameters and network configurations for machine learning models, numerous trial and error experiments were conducted. Performance metrics calculated are 98.2% Accuracy, 99.2% Precision, 97.1% Recall and 98.1% F1Score.

articleTitle: Low Power Optimization of Hybrid Logic Full Adder Design using FinFET 32nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents a low power optimisation strategy for designing a 32nm FinFET hybrid logic full adder (HLFA). The recommended architecture uses complementary metal-oxide-semiconductors (CMOS) and pass-transistor logic (PTL) to balance power consumption and performance. The optimisation reduces average power, power dissipation, latency, and PDP while maintaining acceptable area overhead. FinFET technology improves gate control and reduces leakage currents compared to CMOS technology for the HLFA. HSPICE simulation is used to evaluate the proposed design. Low power optimisation solutions including gate resizing, input capacitance reduction, and leakage current reduction are tested on average power, power dissipation, latency, and PDP. Due to the research, all of these indicators have improved, indicating that the suggested design is suitable for low-power digital system applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Framework for Energy-Efficient Clustering and Routing in Heterogeneous IoT-Driven Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Smart computing has been particularly notable in the development of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), which have many applications. Battery-powered, self-configuring sensor nodes are the basis of these networks. Energy and resources are limited when it comes to sensors. Unbalanced nodes in the network consume more power, which adversely affects the network’s lifespan. An improved energy-efficient cluster-based routing protocol for heterogeneous wireless sensor networks (WSNs) based on the Internet of Things is proposed in this study. Several performance metrics were used to evaluate the proposed model’s effectiveness, including energy efficiency, alive nodes, dead nodes, network lifetime, and residual energy. The results of the comparison were compared with existing methodologies, such as LEACH, PSO, and hybrid PSO. The proposed approach outperforms the existing model by a substantial margin in networks with 50 and 100 nodes, according to the simulation results.

articleTitle: Tiny ML-based Non-Invasive Approach of Cardiac Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are a leading cause of mortality worldwide, necessitating the development of effective and continuous cardiac monitoring solutions. Advances in non-invasive monitoring and Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) have enabled new possibilities for real-time, remote health assessment. This study introduces a novel cardiac monitoring system using TinyML to analyze Electrocardiogram (ECG) and Photoplethysmography (PPG) waveforms collected from wearable sensors. The collected signals undergo rigorous pre-processing, including noise reduction and robust feature extraction, to ensure data integrity. Spectral analysis techniques, such as Mel-Frequency Cepstrum (MFC) and Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC), are employed to extract meaningful features from ECG and PPG signals. The convolutional neural network (CNN) model is optimized for deploying on the resource-constrained environment of the Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense. The model achieves high accuracy in real-time heart state classification, with up to 96.4% accuracy for ECG classification and 100% for PPG classification, while maintaining low computational overhead. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of TinyML usecase for wearable devices in early diagnosis and remote management of CVDs, highlighting the potential for future advancements in Edge AIbased healthcare solutions.

articleTitle: Optimizing Real-time Task Scheduling in Cloud-based AI Systems using Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has also started to be regularly introduced in cloud-based systems as it can help improve performance and skyrocket efficiency. It is a challenge for such systems to schedule tasks in real time, and computing sources need to be allocated promptly and efficiently. The current scheduling mechanisms being relatively static under varying system conditions leads to inefficient allocation with a slight (to severe) degradation in performance. This project suggests that Genetic Algorithms (GA) be employed for real-time task scheduling optimization in AI services on the cloud. GAs are robust optimization methods based on fundamental natural selection and survival of the fittest principles, thus well suited for solving complex issues like task scheduling in dynamic environments. The LC scheduling uses a GA-based approach to form a group of shuttle schedules (candidate emergency transportation solution) where the fittest one is selected and executed using genetic operators like selection, crossover, mutation, etc. It allows the system to adjust resources more effectively for its current state, leading to better performance and scalability.

articleTitle: Fortifying IoT: A Cybersecurity Model for Secure Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The advancement of the Internet of Things (IoT) has developed many opportunities, but it has also generated new attack vectors and vulnerabilities that could jeopardise the availability, confidentiality of linked systems. The IoT is a prospective technology that links living and non-living objects globally. IoT adoption is accelerating, but there are still security gaps that leave it vulnerable to several cyberattacks. A properly secure network is essential to any network’s success; otherwise, users may be unwilling to use this technology. Creating a secure IoT environment is a difficult task that calls for a methodical, comprehensive strategy to recognise and address possible security risks. In this sense, cybersecurity research considerations are crucial since they serve as the basis for creating and putting into practice security solutions that can handle new threats. Scientists must first create strict security criteria that provide the basis for creating safe chipsets, devices, and networks in order to create a secure Internet of Things ecosystem. Consequently, the product of the effort may be called a “conclusion of the conclusions,” a more comprehensive and condensed set of data and suggestions for the scientific community. This content acts as a baseline for stakeholders utilising and implementing the recommended strategies, as well as for future study on IoT cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Sparse Heterogeneous Data and Solution Strategies Using Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research examines the issues and solutions of machine learning with sparse, heterogeneous data. Heterogeneous data includes a variety of data kinds and architectures, such as structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, which often results in sparse datasets where significant portions of the data are missing or zero. The research compares machine learning methods, including Ensemble Model, SVM, Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest, on datasets with and without sparse heterogeneous features. The research shows that the Ensemble Model performs better with sparse data, with an accuracy of 0.8912 and an F1 score of 0.8849. Models like SVM and Naïve Bayes exhibit very small gains, underscoring the limitations of dealing with sparse and diverse data. The results emphasize the need of using sophisticated approaches like feature learning, data imputation, regularization, managing missing values, and ensemble learning to successfully manage and analyse complicated data structures. This study sheds light on how to optimize machine learning models for improved predicted accuracy and resilience in the face of scarce, heterogeneous data.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems for Wireless IoT Networks: Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has altered many fields because it combines so entirety. But likely that these instruments are so smooth to hack, it has still created plenty safety worries. To hold Wi-Fi IoT networks cautious, Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) are very main. They look for and fix safety dents. This research focuses on Machine Learning (ML) systems and looks at the various types of IDPS for Wi-Fi IoT networks. There is plenty research on intrusion detection systems (IDS) over the internet of things (IoT) that is look at in this place study. It displays by virtue of what well differing algorithms, containing neural networks, decision trees, random forests, and Support Vector Machines (SVM), act. It further checks machine learning-based IoT safety models, like Support Vector Clustering (SVC) in addition to convolutional neural networks (CNNs), in consideration of label and stop hacking risks in IoT backgrounds. Reviewing secondary evidence and secondary data is part of the study process. These are used to find the basic IDPS for Wireless IoT Networks styles and questions. This research explains that intrusion detection systems (IDS) are essential for consistency the Internet of Things cautious, what plans established machine learning can help find and stop threats more effectively. This study has plenty useful information for scientists and experts that can help them devise better IDPS remedies for Wireless IoT Networks.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Plant Disease Detection and Analysis Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The identification of plant diseases plays a pivotal role in mitigating losses in agricultural yield and product quality. These diseases manifest as visually observable patterns on plant surfaces, and their timely detection is critical for sustainable agriculture. Plant pathology knowledge is required for the labour-intensive and time-consuming manual monitoring of plant diseases. To address these challenges, image processing techniques have emerged as valuable tools for automating disease detection. This thorough article investigates the methods used to identify and evaluate plant diseases by using leaf image data. Agriculture stands as one of India’s most ancient and essential occupations. Given that India’s economy is predominantly reliant on agricultural production, safeguarding food production is of paramount importance. Pests, including viruses, fungi, and bacteria, can inflict significant damage to crops, resulting in reduced quality and quantity of agricultural output. Therefore, it is essential to provide careful maintenance and early identification of plant diseases in order to protect the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Natural Language Processing in Educational Chatbots: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: AI in the classroom instruction of languages an exciting potential effect that is altering teaching strategies and student involvement. Everything is simply achievable, including chatbots and natural-language processing (NLP) technology. Therefore, in order to verify the influence of AI on language acquisition, this study will evaluate the research, concentrating on programs like ChatGPT that provide individualized and engaged educational opportunities. Inversely, AI-driven chatbots that imitate real-world interactions, such as ChatGPT, supply very adaptable and accessible language training tools. Yet, forthcoming problems with correctness, societal prejudices, and the most suitable usage of AI stress their early promise. These demand that teachers and students improve their digital skills in order to use AI technology in a responsible and effective way. With a focus on present developments and potential futures, it highlights the crucial role artificial intelligence (AI) is playing in revolutionizing language teaching.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Experience Application- Area
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Home decor plays a crucial role in creating comfortable and aesthetically pleasing living spaces. With the increasing popularity of digital technologies, home decor applications have emerged as valuable tools. This paper focuses on emphasizing the elements of interior designing but allowing customization of products for the user, improving the dimensionality of the AR based applications, and improving the user experience. The application allows users to explore various decor styles, experiment with different furniture items, and preview how different design elements would look in their own spaces through augmented reality (AR) technology. Overall, this research contributes to the growing body of knowledge on the integration of digital technologies in home decor practices and highlights the potential of AR-based applications in enhancing the user experience in interior design.

articleTitle: Enhancing Autonomous Vehicle Navigation with Real-Time Object Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles’ (AVs) capacity to identify and categorise things in real-time is crucial to their development for the sake of efficient and safe navigation. Because of its exceptional capability to learn spatial feature hierarchies automatically, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have become an indispensable tool for object identification in intricate visual recognition problems. This research offers a thorough analysis of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) used for autonomous vehicle object identification in real-time, with an emphasis on improving detection accuracy and speed. We compare the processing speed, detection accuracy, and computational efficiency of several CNN designs, such as YOLO (You Only Look Once), SSD (Single Shot Multibox Detector), and Faster R-CNN. In addition, to address the demanding realtime needs of autonomous driving systems, we suggest CNN design improvements that use hardware acceleration methods like GPU and TPU optimisations. The experimental findings show that our suggested method significantly reduces detection latency while maintaining accuracy, which makes it suitable for use in real-world AV settings. Autonomous vehicle technology advances thanks to this study’s results, which aid in building scalable and reliable object identification algorithms.

articleTitle: Big Data in Healthcare: Leveraging Analytics to Revolutionize Patient Care and Health Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The application of big data analytics is a crucial component of research that strives to improve the quality of care that is offered to patients as well as the delivery of healthcare services. There is a possibility that the process of collecting, maintaining, and analyzing the structured and unstructured data that is created by healthcare systems can now be simplified by making use of the technologies that are now accessible. Over the course of the past few years, the healthcare industry in the United States has witnessed an increase in the utilization of big data analytics as a means of assisting in the diagnosis of ailments and the administration of therapy. In spite of the fact that this is the case, the use of big data analysis in the healthcare industry and the expansion of research in this field are still in the process of making sluggish progress. This is due to the fact that the idea of big data is plagued by a number of basic issues, which is the root cause of the problem. The objective of this research is to develop a one-of-a-kind application of Apache Spark that is capable of doing analytics on enormous volumes of data. This will allow for the discovery of a solution to the challenges that have been identified. Within the realm of medical research, this approach focuses a particular emphasis on the areas that are seen as being the most creative and promising. The application of the technique that has been offered has the potential to result in an improvement in the manner in which the healthcare industry provides care. This is a possibility that exists. For the purpose of continuously evaluating clinical data in order to enhance the quality of treatment that is delivered to patients and to raise the efficiency of medical operations, the application of analytics to vast data sets may be applied.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Precision Agriculture: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Purpose Artificial intelligence (AI) is the branch of computer science where intelligent machines are being developed to imitate human intellect. Agriculture is persistently hard-pressed to produce more using a lesser amount of resource. The utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques is growing in agricultural domain for increasing the production now days. But a large number of barriers exist in this area such as technology gap between experts and farmers, unexpected diseases infections, incorrect soil management, handling high volume data for analysis and lower production. This is high time to implement responsible AI frameworks in agriculture domains for the well-being of farmers. The key advantages of AI are precision, lower outlay, higher performance and flexibility. This work carries a standard review of AI application in agriculture for coping various parameters such as crop, soil, water, weed, pest and disease. The clear representation of advantages and disadvantages of various applications has been represented in tabular form. This work contributes in presenting a standard survey of several AI based applications that helps in drawing a logical framework for precision agriculture to maximize the crop productivity. This paper put forward the most recent stage of advancement of AI in the field of agriculture including the possible impact over latest business schemes. Several new research directions are recognized for improved productivity. With the help of inferences drawn in conclusion researchers will be able to explore valuable contributions of AI applications that may be used in various agricultural activities.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Solving Challenges in Computer Vision Applications and Exploring Evolving Patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Deep learning has brought substantial advancements to computer vision in recent years by providing answers to challenging visual interpretation problems. It investigates several DL methodologies, such as self-supervised learning strategies, hybrid CNN-RNN models, enhanced CNNs, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and vision transformers (ViTs). Novel CNN architectures are designed, GANs are used for image synthesis, hybrid models are used to integrate spatial and temporal information, self-attention is used in ViTs, and self-supervised learning is used for feature extraction. The results of the study show significant improvements: the accuracy of Enhanced CNNs was $81.6 \%$, the accuracy of GANs was $14.8 \%$, the accuracy of Hybrid CNN-RNN models was $86.2 \%$, the accuracy of ViTs was $79.2 \%$, and the accuracy of transfer for self-supervised learning techniques was $76.8 \%$. These findings demonstrate the improved effectiveness and performance of the suggested techniques, highlighting their potential to resolve challenging problems in feature extraction, video analysis, object recognition, picture enhancement, and image classification. It concludes that advances in computer vision will be facilitated by the ongoing development of DL methods. These advancements will lead to more precise and adaptable applications in a range of fields, including autonomous driving, medical imaging, surveillance, and augmented reality.

articleTitle: A Scalable Solution for Pneumonia Diagnosis: Transfer Learning for Chest X-ray Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The high death rate and rapid spread of pneumonia make it a serious global health concern. The precision of traditional diagnostic techniques is often compromised, particularly in resource-limited settings. Existing studies have predominantly focused on either binary or multi-class classification, often relying on limited datasets, which affects the generalizability and robustness of models. Additionally, the interpretability and transparency of deep learning models remain challenging in clinical environments. Addressing these challenges is crucial for advancing diagnostic methodologies to combat pneumonia. This study explores the use of transfer learning to improve the reliability of pneumonia classification using chest X-ray images. An automated classification system was developed, utilizing a combination of image preprocessing techniques, feature extraction with GLRLM, and various machine learning and transfer learning algorithms. Two datasets were employed: the GWCMCx dataset with 5856 chest X-rays and another dataset comprising 9207 chest X-rays. The system was designed for both binary and multi-class classification scenarios. CapsuleNet emerged as the most effective model, achieving an accuracy of ${9 9. 0 2 \%}$ in binary classification and $90.43 \%$ in multi-class classification, significantly outperforming previous studies. Additionally, a user-friendly web application was developed to facilitate the integration of the classification system into clinical workflows, accelerating clinical decision-making. This study demonstrates the potential of transfer learning to automate and improve pneumonia diagnosis, offering a scalable solution that can alleviate radiologists’ workload and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: The New Energy Demand Equation Response Mechanisms for Consumers and Prosumers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A new energy management tool IDRPO is integrated demand response and prosumer optimization. IDRPO uses pro-consumer grid integration, consumer-centered energy management, and green energy allocation methods to stabilize the grid, boost energy efficiency, and empower energy users. This combination approach solves the current energy demand equation’s evolving issues. Method 1 maximizes energy consumption via consumer-centric energy management (CCEM). CCEM stabilizes the grid and saves money with flexible demand, real-time pricing, and consumer options. CCEM’s mathematical models help make sensible decisions like using energy off-peak and joining demand response programs. The Prosumer System Integration Model (PGIM) in method 2 determines if integrating prosumers to the energy system is feasible and inexpensive. PGIM determines customer assistance based on grid dependability, surplus energy, and power usage. This approach balances grid reliability and energy production. Method 3 shows how to transfer green energy to the grid using REAA. To ensure the project is cost-effective and environmentally friendly, REAA calculates the EII and CBR. The options reduce pollutants and boost the economy, improving green energy. The IDRPO’s strategy promotes grid safety, low prices, long-term solutions, consumer choice, and energy flexibility. It claims to solve all energy sector issues by respecting the law and improving the market.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Optimized Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing Services
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Resource efficiency becomes increasingly critical as cloud computing services alter. This article uses bitcoin and machine learning to optimize resource utilization. We study PRDA, BSCA, and DRAA algorithms and propose “Blockchain and Machine Learning for Optimized Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing Services.” We employ blockchain, machine learning, and smart contracts to make resource sharing safer, clearer, and adaptable to cloud contexts. A comparative test demonstrates our resource allocation strategy works. PRDA reliably predicts resource usage using real-time data and prior patterns. This greatly reduces expenses and waste. The BSCA ensures safe and transparent delivery via guidelines. In multi-tenant cloud systems, DRAA optimizes resource consumption via reinforcement learning. This fixes underuse, exorbitant pricing, and speed loss. With this strategy, cloud service providers can remain open, keep rates low, and serve customers promptly.

articleTitle: Evaluating 10Gbps Wireless Optical Communication Using NRZ Modulation: Analyzing BER, Signal Quality, and System Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Free space optical (FSO) communication is a fast and wireless data transfer technique that serves as a viable alternative to traditional fiber-optic systems. This study illustrates how FSO can effectively address the growing demand for rapid data transmission and suggests its potential applicability in various scenarios. FSO can be employed to establish connections between buildings within a corporate campus without the need for physical wiring, or it can provide high-speed internet access in locations where installing cables is challenging. We used Optsim software to assess critical parameters such as Bit Error Rate (BER), eye diagrams, power, and signal quality. The results offer valuable insights into enhancing the efficiency and reliability of FSO systems. FSO can find applications in cellular networks to interconnect network equipment, as well as in high-definition video surveillance. These findings highlight the areas in which FSO can advance communication technology and provide valuable insights for future developments.

articleTitle: Advanced Hybrid Intelligence Framework for Scalable and Robust Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The phenomena of data explosion in different areas of life require enhanced methods to performing big data analysis. This paper proposes the Hybrid Intelligent Machine Learning System (HIMLS) which work through the combination of multiple machine learning approaches to improve the efficacy of big data analysis. HIMLS applies the benefits of both supervised and unsupervised learning, integrates deep learning models and ensemble methods to solve the difficulties which are from high-dimension learning and heterogeneous data. As a result of combining feature selection with the process of dimensionality reduction HIMLS moderates the curse of dimensionality which enhances the models’ predictive capability while lowering the computational requirements. It is proved that the system works on actual big data implementation, exhibits a better solution in terms of the accuracy of the model, size, and stability aspects in contrast to the conventional machine learning approaches. This research also analyses the effects that different techniques of hyperparameters optimization select and the involvement of distributed computing systems for speeding up analytics. Thus the study infers HIMLS as a suitable solution to the shortcomings characterized by current big data analytical techniques, giving an efficient method for harnessing big data solutions.

articleTitle: IoT Revolutionization using Federated Learning and Decentralized AI on Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research proposes a novel strategy for addressing the limitations of centralized architectures in IoT data processing. Traditional systems experience significant bandwidth use, privacy difficulties, and scalability issues. To address these difficulties, the proposed approach combines Federated Learning (FL) with Decentralized AI on Edge Devices (DAI-ED). By decentralizing processing duties and utilizing FL methods, data is kept local to edge devices, lowering latency and improving privacy. Deployment entails choosing AI-capable edge devices and configuring them for seamless integration. Secure communication techniques provide privacy throughout FL operations. Model optimization approaches help to improve efficiency even further. Compared to centralized systems, the results show higher model accuracy, decreased communication overhead, and increased resource utilization. The proposed system has an overall accuracy of $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$, with edge device accuracy at $\mathbf{9 4. 5 \%}$ and central server accuracy at $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$. Communication overhead during the training and inference phases is greatly minimized, with the proposed system requiring 150 MB per device against $\mathbf{4 0 0} \mathrm{MB}$ in centralized systems. The proposed system has low memory consumption and computational complexity, but it is very scalable.

articleTitle: Problems and Optimal Methodologies Agile Project Management Solution in Publicly accessible Sector: A Comprehensive Evaluation of the Literature
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Agile technique use in the public domain is not new. Governments all throughout the globe have been adopting Agile development in recent years, particularly in light of the Pandemic, which calls for swift decision-making. Agile implementation is still challenged, meantime, by the distinctions between the public and private sectors, such as the adherence to the hierarchy of authority concept. The purpose of this work is to investigate the difficulties and provide remedies for implementing Agile project oversight in the public domain by use of a PRISMA-based systematic literature review (SLR). Four papers databases-Scopus, ACM, IEEE Explore, & Emerald Research Insight-provided the material employed in the SLR. An aggregate of 43 difficult topics were identified from the analysis of 18 appropriate publications out of 595 that were found. The answer for every problem is found using the mapping findings from the SLR articles with PMBOK 7th version Guidebook. Each of these problems is grouped according to 8 project accomplishment areas of PMBOK 7th edition. Results revealed that, with eight shortcomings apiece, the Development Approach, Lifecycle, & project-related category segments had the greatest problems. Next the team with seven problems, the stakeholder with six, the delivery with five, the measurement with four, the scheduling with three, and uncertainty with two. Academics and practitioners might find this study helpful as a reference for tackling the difficulties of introducing agile project administration in the public sphere.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Data Imbalance on the Predictive Performance of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Examining how data imbalance affects machine learning model prediction accuracy is the focus of this study. Here, the emphasis is squarely on a comprehensive architecture that integrates many classifiers with hybrid sampling methodologies. Machine learning has significantly transformed data analysis in several domains, with a special emphasis on healthcare, by improving the precision of diagnoses and decision-making processes. Imbalanced datasets, characterized by a large underrepresentation of one class relative to another, offer considerable issues. This often results in models that exhibit a bias towards the majority classes and perform poorly on the minority classes. To address this issue, our study utilizes a unique hybrid sampling technique that combines GASMOTE (Genetic Algorithm-based SMOTE) and SMOTE-PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization-enhanced SMOTE) with ENN under-sampling. This approach successfully addresses the problem of data imbalance. We use this framework to analyze health data obtained from Kaggle, combining it with XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and a hybrid model of RF and XGBoost is not uncommon. A combination of these preprocessing procedures substantially improves the model’s performance, as shown by our study’s findings. No preprocessing was necessary with regard to hybrid RF+XGBoost model to achieve an accuracy of 0.97. Nevertheless, the model’s accuracy improved to 0.99 after preprocessing. Gains in accuracy were accompanied by enhancements in recall, precision, and F1-score. The study provides a standard structure to enhance the robustness and reliability with machine learning algorithms during circumstances with uneven data and highlights the pressing requirement for particular techniques to combat data imbalance.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Object Detection Methods: Current Status and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Object Detection has evolved significantly since its inception in the early 2000s when Object Localization was regarded as a challenging task. The transition from Localization to object detection has seen rapid advancements in state-of- the-art techniques. The evolution of object detection can be broadly categorized into Traditional Methods and Deep Learning (DL) Methods. In this paper, we examine both approaches, highlighting the rise of YOLO (You Only Look Once) as a dominant force in Object Detection. We provide a comprehensive survey of all YOLO versions, alongside an overview of pre- YOLO object detection methods. Our discussion also explores optimizing object detection through architectural improvements and data enhancements, while considering future opportunities for increased efficiency.

articleTitle: Solar Powered EV Charging Electric Farm Vehicles for Sustainable Agriculture Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In agricultural environments, electric vehicles (EVs) are becoming more and more important, especially for tractors, as a means of reducing the environmental effects and running costs of conventional diesel-powered systems. The proposed system introduces solar-powered charging stations designed specifically for farm equipment, addressing the drawbacks of relying too much on fossil fuels. The innovative approach makes use of solar energy that is renewable to improve sustainability, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and maximize operational effectiveness. Its feasibility is demonstrated by in-depth evaluations of solar potential, system design, incorporation of intelligent energy management, and practical testing. Solar-powered EV charging is positioned as a game-changing solution for sustainable agriculture by comparison analyses that show superior energy efficiency, with the proposed system achieving 4.0 km/kWh compared to 2.5 km/kWh of existing systems, significant cost savings (${\$}$6,500 annually vs. ${\$}$12,000), and significant reductions in environmental pollutants (3,000 kg CO2 emissions annually vs. 15,000 kg).

articleTitle: MRI-Based Brain Tumour Detection Utilizing Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Advance identification of brain tumors is necessary. Brain tumors can be categorized by biology and can be treated by conclusive brain surgery only. Computer-aided approaches can assist doctors to categorize brain tumors. Here, some machine and deep learning techniques are accustomed to detecting three types of tumors and also including healthy brain, using boom imaging. brain MRIs so doctors can diagnose tumors. and very accurate in the first stages. Here we consider a collection of data containing 3264 MRI scans with different types of tumors was included in research. Primarily, pre-processing and optimization algorithms used on MR scans of the brain. Then, build a 2-D convolutional neural network (CNN) and autoencoder network, which were pre-trained by our established Meta Algorithms. So, a 2D CNN has many convolution layers. Every layer from hierarchical network is $\mathbf{2 x 2}$ kernel functions. The network contains of four merging and eight rotating layers, and after all the rotating layers, buffer layers are used. The advance autoencoder network is a convolutional autoencoder network and a convolutional network for categorization, which utilize last layer of the output encoder of the primary stage. In addition, $\mathbf{6}$ machine learning methods used to clarify brain tumors were distinguish in this research.

articleTitle: Advancing Brain State Classification through Electroencephalogram (EEG) Analysis: Exploring Diverse Models for Improved Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The combination of electroencephalography data and machine learning technologies provides a promising path for secure and transparent solutions to various problems, including authentication. The outcome of the current work provides an alternative to passwords and biometrics: the use of EEG as a method for identifying brain states such as stress and emotion. The data was extracted with the help of monitors from individual subjects at different stress and emotion intervals. Following that, CNN and Extreme Gradient Boosting were utilized for the classification task. As demonstrated, XGB outperforms CNN with high recall, accuracy, and precision. Visualizing the frequency components and mean values allows one to imagine how the data behaves. Current research has showcased that EEG-based authentication has great potential for a broad range of applications and points to future avenues for investigation, such as multimodal authentication systems or real-time authentication. To make the EEG robust and inclusive, a follow-up study could also include more in-depth feature studies, hyperparameter optimization, or possible demographic effects on the signals.

articleTitle: Integrating Renewable Energy Sources into Smart Grids with an Aggregator-Based Energy Management System for Efficiency and Resilience
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Integrating renewable energy sources (RESs) into smart grids (SGs) is challenging due to the intermittent and unpredictable nature of the sources, which are often the sun or wind. Additionally, it is important to think about how to get customers involved in the electricity sector so that we can lower energy prices globally. According to this article, an energy management system (EMS) may help the SG run more efficiently. The EMS aggregates distributed energy resources to make SG market participation easier. Integrating demand-side management (DSM) with active management strategies (AMS) has financial and environmental benefits as it increases the use of renewable energy sources while decreasing consumer energy costs. By incorporating their preferences and costs into market processes, energy supply/demand and distribution system operators (DSOs) may respond to real-time price signals. This has the potential to make the grid more adaptable and resilient. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed EMS, a 23-bus, $11-\mathrm{kV}$ transmission network is used.

articleTitle: Neural Networks and Deep Learning: Innovations and Applications in Soft Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Paper explores different aspects of deep learning techniques and neural networks in the fields of healthcare, time-series forecasting, agriculture, and other relevant sectors through soft computing. The objective of the report is to examine the significant potential and applications of neural networks. While machine learning techniques called neural networks (NN) are utilized for audio, picture, and the processing of natural languages, it has huge implications in robotics where several machine learning algorithms are significantly required. Improvements in deep machine learning are also investigated in the article specifically in the fields of drug construction, genetics, recognizing faces, farming, biological medicine, biological informatics, medical treatment, natural language, multimedia analysis of data, and mobility prediction. However black box challenges and privacy concerns with data are often ignored in this research. The paper also outlines deep learning-driven data mining techniques for precisely predicting, displaying, evaluating, and classifying data. The report has also emphasized on addressing the potential privacy concerns and challenges associated to information representation. By reviewing recent literature sources about neural network techniques, the study proposes innovation strategies and potential improvement areas for the development of advanced technologies like deep learning and neural networks while addressing the key privacy concerns in data processing.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Real-Time Health Monitoring System Using IoT Sensors and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Real-Time wi-fi Monitoring System Design & Implementation with IoT Sensors and System Learning Algorithms for Clinical Improvement - The motive is to decorate the healthcare enterprise with an advanced era. It collects patients’ we-fitness parameters like heartbeat, blood pressure, and body temp in real time with sensors of Net of things (IoT). The accumulated records are then despatched to a cloud server for addition processing and evaluation of the usage of the system gaining knowledge of algorithms. The system provides a user-friendly interface for healthcare professionals to receive the data and monitor patients remotely. It also sends a real-time alert notification if an abnormal reading is detected so that corrective actions can be taken quickly and possibly prevent major wireless issues. The machine learning algorithms employed in the system will be able to learn from all the data gathered, resulting in personalized and precise we-fitness tracking. The device design is scalable and can easily fit into current healthcare systems. It also has stable security features to ensure the pirates and confidentiality of patient records. This machine has so much potential and if applied correctly, it could change the way healthcare operates affecting a lot more people around the globe wireless powerful healthcare services to them, Wi-Fi -ally in remote & served parts of our planet. universal, Wifi-enabled tracking system in real-time has the potential to significantly improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.

articleTitle: Review on Data Balancing Approaches for Skewed Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Addressing the skewed data set is a significant concern nowadays. In machine learning, using such data to learn distributions poses a significant challenge. This problem arises when there are significantly more samples of one class, also known as a majority class, than of the other classes. The more important class is known as a minority. As a result of its use in so many real-world applications, researchers’ interest in it is increasing. This issue of class imbalance has been studied using a variety of methods over the past few years, including methods such as data resampling, ensemble techniques, cost-sensitive analysis, hybrid methods, etc. With an emphasis on binary-class and multi-class problems, the goal of this study is to discuss the current state of the art on various strategies to comprehend the state of machine learning strategies for enhancing classification output and addressing class imbalance issues.

articleTitle: Analysis on Application of Image Processing in Monitoring of Crop Growth
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Enhancing agricultural operations through the use of image processing tools has become a potential option. By conducting a thorough analysis of the body of research, developing and implementing image processing algorithms, this study investigates the usefulness of image processing in agriculture. Agricultural fields are the source of spectral and spatial data that are collected by remote sensing technologies as well as by digital cameras. To improve the quality of obtained images, preprocessing procedures such as atmospheric correction, radiometric calibration, and image registration are used. Meanwhile, feature extraction and classification techniques are applied to quantify pertinent crop characteristics and classify land cover classes. The study assesses crop health, phenology, and production using image-derived information, evaluating its accuracy and dependability through field-based validation and comparison analysis.

articleTitle: Harnessing Machine Learning for Enhanced Agricultural Efficiency through Advanced Data Analysis and IoT Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The agricultural sector is poised to benefit greatly from the improved data processing and decision-making capabilities enabled by machine learning, which is significantly impacting economies worldwide. To alleviate the urgent worldwide food shortage, this study investigates the potential of incorporating machine learning algorithms to maximize harvest yields while decreasing food waste. The paper analyses the present state of these algorithms in farming, finds important problems and possibilities, and finds out how changing data labels affects the accuracy of the algorithms. The results show that farmers may increase crop yields and decrease waste by making more educated decisions about planting, watering, and harvesting using big data from farms and data collected in real time from the Internet of Things sensors. The comparative analysis of five classification algorithms for agricultural data highlighted the Naive Bayes Classifier with the highest accuracy ($\mathbf{9 9. 5 3 \%}$), while Random Forest showed balanced performance across all categories ($\mathbf{9 8. 8 1 \%}$). Each algorithm demonstrated strengths depending on the specific prediction task. These findings indicate that there is potential for improvement in terms of production rates, cost savings, and farm resilience. Future farmers may also be able to use this study’s findings to improve crop production efficiency, spot diseases earlier, and reduce food shortages.

articleTitle: Leveraging XGBoost for Predictive Analytics in Healthcare: Enhancing Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this study, we look at how XGBoost (Extreme Gradient Boosting) may be used in healthcare predictive analytics to improve the speed and precision of illness detection. Thanks to its built-in regularisation algorithms that avoid overfitting and its capacity to handle big datasets, XGBoost has proved useful in a broad variety of prediction applications. It is a scalable and high-performance machine learning algorithm. In order to improve patient outcomes, healthcare providers must ensure that patients are diagnosed with chronic and life-threatening conditions including cancer, heart disease, and diabetes as soon as possible. To test how well XGBoost performs in comparison to more conventional machine learning techniques, the research makes use of healthcare datasets collected from the actual world. The effectiveness of the model in predicting illness outcomes is evaluated using critical metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Based on the findings, XGBoost is the best classifier for real-time healthcare applications because to its quicker processing efficiency and greater predictive ability. Additionally, the article delves into the model’s interpretability and how it may be integrated into clinical decision support systems. By demonstrating how XGBoost may improve diagnostic accuracy and bolster individualised treatment plans, this study adds to the expanding area of AI-driven healthcare.

articleTitle: Enhancing Smart Grid Efficiency Through Innovative Data Management And Analytics For Demand Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The smart electrical grid allows data and power to flow in both directions, connecting generators and consumers. This allows for more efficient, reliable, and environmentally friendly power flow optimization. With this system in place, micro-energy producers and users may participate more actively in the power market and in DEM. Finding ways to get people involved so that smart grid (SG) users can help bring down electricity costs is the biggest obstacle. But accurate predictions of load and renewable generation are crucial for DEM to work. Because of this, there is a pressing need for smart approaches and solutions to harness the massive amounts of data produced by the proliferation of smart meters in real-time. To optimize the functioning of SGs, it is crucial to have strong data analytics, HPC, effective data network management, and cloud computing approaches. This study’s overarching goal is to provide insight on the difficulties encountered by the DEM used in SG networks due to huge data. Along with that, it lays out the most popular data processing techniques utilized in the literature and suggests a good path forward for study in the area.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cancer Diagnosis with Deep Learning: A Case Study Using U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The U-Net architecture is a convolutional neural network model that is well-known for its skills in biomedical image segmentation. This study investigates the revolutionary potential that the U-Net architecture presents in the context of cancer diagnosis. We guarantee that the input is of high quality by using sophisticated preprocessing methods, which we do by constructing a robust $\mathbf{U}$-Net-based system that is specifically designed for the segmentation and classification of tumour regions in medical imaging data. An exhaustive examination that makes use of criteria such as the Dice similarity coefficient, precision, recall, and $F 1$ score indicates that our model performs substantially better than conventional techniques when it comes to identifying and distinguishing malignant tissues. Case studies that cover a wide range of cancer types provide further validation of the flexibility and practical application of the system.
