These studies also highlight the significant influence that deep learning has on increasing diagnosis accuracy, lowering the risk of human error, and overall patient outcomes in the field of cancer treatment.

articleTitle: Advanced Ray-Tracing Saleh-Valenzuela Channel Modelling and Characterization for Indoor Terahertz Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the growing demand for advanced wireless communication networks, there is an urgent need for highspeed wireless technologies. The Terahertz (THz) frequency band, ranging from 0.3 to 10 THz, attracts significant attention due to its unique properties, such as high temporal resolution and low absorption, making it promising for telecom advancements. This paper introduces an ultrawideband (UWB) channel model for THz frequency propagation in indoor environments, starting from 0.3 THz. The study examines the propagation path loss by considering factors such as transmitter size, molecular absorption, and attenuation across varying frequencies and distances. The model includes power delay profiles, MIMO, and DFT-s-OFDM-based channel responses, employing a hybrid approach combining the Saleh-Valenzuela model with Raytracing (RT-SV) techniques. This method provides a detailed analysis of line-of-sight path loss, power distribution, and other physical characteristics in THz indoor channels. The simulation results show that this hybrid model improves THz system performance, outperforming traditional stochastic models by better handling temporal and spatial variations that affect frequency loss.

articleTitle: Investigating Physical-Layer and Cross-Layer Security Technologies in Modern Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As attacks get more sophisticated, traditional network security hole fixes don’t always work. We need advanced, all-around security solutions to protect contact and data transmission in complex settings. This study proposes a comprehensive solution. This study includes physical-layer encryption (PLE), quantum key distribution (QKD), cross-layer intrusion detection systems (IDS), machine-learning-based hazard detection, and cross-layer protocol design. PLE reduces noise and encryption by ensuring secure communication, whereas QKD increases security via coupling and key changes. To secure networks, cross-layer IDS detects borders and unusual activity. Using machine learning, systems get smarter by categorizing threats and anticipating their occurrence. To ensure interaction safety, the cross-layer protocol employs quantum entanglement, updated keys, and translations. An ablation analysis shows how important each technique is, and detailed comparison studies with tables and figures show that this combined strategy does better than traditional methods in terms of throughput, latency, encryption strength, false positive rate, accuracy of detection, energy efficiency, protocol effectiveness, security score, and the number of false positives. This novel, low-cost technology protects networks and lets systems adapt to new threats, improving speed and reliability.

articleTitle: Advanced Blockchain Techniques for Secure data Sharing through Ownership Authentication in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain Technology has established itself as an effective solution to warrant the transparency and security of data sharing in Cloud Computing. The objective of this research paper is to analyze the possibilities of using Blockchain Technology and upgrading the security of the cloud-based data sharing by utilizing multi-factor authentication. We introduce an improved system using smart contracts, token-based security and smartphone authentication to build a secure framework. This system could eliminate nearly all unauthorized cloud computing access - drastically reducing security breaches. A literature survey was performed to investigate the identified limitations and challenges in cloud security and data sharing. Then we develop and offer an efficient and better scalable solution for protecting sensitive and important information in this digitally growing landscape.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on using Genetic Algorithm with DEAP framework on Different Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Evolutionary Algorithms (EAs) are the solution approaches for solving optimization problems using the classical generate-and-test method. These algorithms are widely used by the practitioners for solving the optimization problems and are studied by the researchers for their advancements. Few highlighted advancements in the domain of EAs are distributed EAs, ensemble EAs, modular EAs, and tuning free EAs. Nevertheless, for the practitioners to get the clarity on the working principle of EAs, the literature is lacking with a comprehensive article reporting their performance on different problems. The research study presented in this paper is an attempt to alleviate this shortcoming. This paper aimed at presenting in detail the working principle of Genetic Algorithm (GA) on different problems which are generally used as reference problems for design and analysis of algorithms. The problems considered in the study are one-max problem, 0/1 Knapsack problem and N Queen problem. The experimental setups are carefully designed, for these three problems, and are solved by implementing GAs on the DEAP (Distributed Evolutionary Algorithms in Python) framework. The performance of the GAs is studied based on the quality and speed performance metrics and the inferences are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: An Efficient Algorithm for Black Hole Attacks Detection in VANET
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Significant progress in wireless technology, smallness, and the Internet of Things (IoT) has led to notable advancements in vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs). VANETs, in conjunction with Internet of Things, participate a crucial role in today’s intelligent transportation systems. However, VANETs face considerable security risks due to their dynamic nature, decentralized structure, open-access environment, and concerns related to protocol design. Among these security challenges, one of the most significant threats which maliciously disturb the communication of data packets is Black Hole Attack (BHA), thereby reduce the honesty of a previously secure path or link. The act of dropping data packets severely impacts both the performance and security of VANETs, potentially resulting in road accidents, fatalities, and traffic congestion. To address these security concerns, this study proposes a novel solution named An Efficient Algorithm for Black Hole attacks Detection in VANET (EABHD). Proposed algorithms try to improve the safety in vehicular sensor networks by detecting the black hole attack in the starting phase while discovering the route. EABHD is based on the calculation of the threshold value dynamically. This algorithm is evaluated using the Network Simulator 2 and compared against number of algorithms. The output of the proposed algorithms shows the improvement in packet delivery ratio, and throughput and decrease in end-to-end delay and routing overhead by ${3. 1 7 \%}$, ${6. 2 4 \%}$ increase and 6.23% and 3.8%, decrease respectively.

articleTitle: Image Matting Using Objective Decomposition and Cascading Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this work we focus on the comprehensive review of Image Matting using concepts of Deep Learning algorithms. To achieve the objective, we have mainly focused on Neural Network based technique of Image Matting called objective decomposition (MOD Net) and Cascading Residual Network (CRN). The merging of these algorithmic approaches is performed to achieve the same goal. MOD net is used in extracting foreground objects with soft boundaries from the background image. Whereas CRN enhances the resolution of an imaging system. Till now, we have achieved the Statistical analysis on both the working models and performed experimental procedures including testing on challenging scenarios like different resolution images, low-light images, motion blurred images etc. We also worked on modifying the program by adding the logistics for foreground and background multiplication of the generated matte image which sanctioned us to change the background image of any generated matte.

articleTitle: Lean Six Sigma in Healthcare: A review of essentials in implementation and outcomes for Health Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Quality excellence and sustenance are key measures for organization success when comes to an important sector like healthcare. In today’s context when post pandemic and ever rising complexities things are changing it is pertinent to ensure at no step there are chaos and non-adherence. Hsu application of lean six sigma as an operational intervention to assure and maintain quality outcome can act as a facilitator.The primary objective is to analyse the impact of Lean Six Sigma on improving efficiency, quality, and patient outcomes within healthcare organizations. The study investigates the challenges faced during implementation and strategies for overcoming obstacles.The findings offer practical insights for healthcare organizations aiming to implement these for improvising healthcare environment.

articleTitle: Addressing Scalability and Latency Issues in Blockchain-Based IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain technology holds significant potential for IoT applications with blockchain’s decentralized security system and transparency measures. The study outlines the increasing challenges of scalability and latency for blockchain applications in IoT. By investigating the key reasons for the evolving issues of latency and scalability within the specific context of Blockchain-based IoT operations, the study evaluates the potential solutions for improving IoT applications. Through a comprehensive review of blockchain in IoT based on its performance, the significant areas for optimizations have been explored in the study.

articleTitle: Comparing Traditional vs Agile Methods for Software Development Projects: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Paper compares traditional vs Agile Software Development approaches to evaluating them as performance in Managing objectify Project. The goal of this paper is to explore the challenges in oral communication and confidence that arise during project management & offering solutions for overcoming them. The findings highlighted issues of interaction and confidence in managing projects & study indicates where Agile project management techniques are more effective because they foster greater teamwork and communication. Furthermore, the study’s findings indicate that subsequent studies should focus on developing solutions to the difficulties of interaction and confidence in project management. The study has a narrow focus, so the findings may not be applicable to other sectors or project types. The study found that agile methodologies are difficult in IT project groups. However, interaction and confidence in project supervision are critical to ensuring the successful growth of IT projects. The research’s usefulness lies in its identification of interpersonal and trustworthy difficulties in project management, as well as how to overcome these challenges. The study’s recommendations for improving the efficacy of project development are aimed at entities in the information technology sector.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Breast Cancer for Precision Oncology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cancer is one of the most dangerous diseases to humans, for which no proven cure exists. Breast cancer has become one of the most common types of disease and is an important cause of cancer-related death and disease worldwide; it needs accurate diagnostic and treatment techniques. The relative research paper contributes to genetics and histopathology imaging of breast cancer are examined in this study and indicate their potential for unity, which emphasizes the genetic and molecular causes of cancer. Genomics provides details on risk assessment, prognostic indicators, tailored treatment, and mutation detection. The development of next-generation sequencing, followed largely by RNA sequencing, has revolutionized the understanding of the genetic makeup in breast cancer and given rise to the possibility of personalized medications and detailed risk analysis. Histopathology provides crucial information that is required for tumour staging, grading, and final diagnosis through microscopic examination of cellular morphology and tissue architecture. It uses methods like Hematoxylin and Eosin staining and immunohistochemistry. Histopathology remains the principal means of both the initial diagnosis of cancer and the assessment of the surgical margin. This review paper provides a detailed study of histopathology imaging and genomics, Our goal is to give an in-depth view to improve patient outcomes and advance breast cancer care by examining the connections and conflicting knowledge that is used for cancer diagnosis and prognosis.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Prediction Models for Cardiovascular Disease Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: More precise and personalized risk assessments for cardiovascular disease (CVD) have been achieved because of recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI). This work introduces a novel AI-powered prediction model that is designed to improve the accuracy and reliability of CVD risk assessments. Using a deep learning framework, the program analyzes extensive datasets that include demographic, clinical, and lifestyle data to identify complex patterns that indicate a risk of cardiovascular disease. The model demonstrates exceptional performance metrics, including an extraordinary Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.95 and an impressive $\mathbf{9 2 \%}$ accuracy, because of rigorous validation on a diverse array of datasets. In the identification of patients who are at high risk, the AI algorithm surpasses the Framingham Risk Score and other well-established risk ratings. Consequently, programs that advocate for early intervention and personalized treatment may receive additional funding. The results of this study demonstrate the potential for AI to transform cardiovascular health care, resulting in more personalized prevention measures and enhanced patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Student Feedback and Assessment with Graph Attention Networks in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The current approaches to student feedback and evaluation in higher education frequently fail to effectively capture and evaluate the varied and intricate feedback data. This study aims to tackle this problem by introducing an innovative approach that utilises Graph Attention Networks (GATs) to improve the analysis and assessment of student comments. The suggested system adopts a methodical approach, commencing with the gathering of data from extensive educational datasets obtained from Kaggle. By carefully analysing the data and selecting relevant features, the system creates graph representations that accurately depict the complex connections between students, courses, and feedback. The GAT model is subsequently applied and trained on these graphs, utilising a dynamic updating technique to consistently enhance performance. A comparative investigation reveals that the GAT-based system exhibits superior performance compared to standard models like Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The findings demonstrate a significant enhancement in accuracy (92.7%), precision (91.3%), recall (93.2%), and F1score (92.2%) when compared to RF and SVM. This sophisticated analytical framework improves the precision of student performance assessments and also offers more profound insights into educational outcomes, presenting a more efficient and adaptable option for higher education institutions. This study establishes a new standard in the sector by showcasing exceptional performance indicators and a thorough methodology for managing student feedback data.

articleTitle: Real-time Multimedia Analytics for IoT Applications: Leveraging Machine Learning for Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Real time multi-media analytics is currently high in trend in businesses as it is helping the companies to track the real time data and develop useful insights. The process of Real-time Multimedia Analytics includes collection analysis and also usage of the data in real time in order to make better informed decisions. The major aim of the study is to explore Real-time Multimedia Analytics for IoT Applications: Leveraging Machine Learning for Insights. Along with this, the study also focuses on Real-Time Multimedia Analytics. The coming together of the IoT and ML has been analysed in the research. Also, the classification process of the IoT data analytics has been analysed according to technological facilities. A complete exploration of the IoT Data Analytics and its uses has been discussed. The research has studied the aspects using the data collected from books and journals. The previous journals on similar topics have been analysed and studied to develop the findings of this research. The research followed the strategy of empirical research and thus a secondary data collection process has been used. In the findings, it has been found that real-time data analytics are of greater help for the business. It can be divided into two aspects which are prescriptive and predictive data analysis. These two processes place a higher value on current time reactions than described and diagnostic analysis. Also, the coming together of IoT and ML can result in better management, enhanced computing and communication success, and improved choice-making. IoT data modelling is widely used in various aspects of businesses like farming, intelligent automobiles and smart medical. Lastly, the challenges and future directions of IoT applications have been studied to improve the process.

articleTitle: Map Reduce Techniques for Machine Learning in Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One of the most groundbreaking approaches to the processing and analysis of large datasets has been created as a result of the combination of MapReduce techniques and machine learning algorithms within the framework of big data analytics. The problems of traditional data processing in terms of handling the volume, velocity, and variety of big data are addressed by the distributed computing architecture introduced by MapReduce. This research investigates the ways in which MapReduce may be used to simplify the process of machine learning, with a particular focus on the capabilities of the framework to manage enormous volumes of data and to parallelize operations. By contrasting the performance of MapReduce with that of more traditional methods, the study solves the problems of scalability and computing efficiency that are brought about by massive amounts of data. Through an in-depth analysis, the paper highlights the optimization potential of MapReduce as well as its implications for next-generation machine learning applications across a variety of industries.

articleTitle: Ensuring Dataset Accountability in Machine Learning: Insights from Software Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine learning is facing a crisis of accountability. On some tasks, deep learning can match or surpass human performance. The study focused on several problems related to software engineering tasks, including performance evaluation metrics, software metrics, failure prediction, and problems with data quality. The paper draws attention to many methodological problems and difficulties associated with these software fault prediction tasks. Feature extraction and classification are commonly used to explore the excessive dimensionality of data and data class imbalance linked to software quality issues.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Approaches to Securing Multi-Cloud Architectures: Best Practices and Emerging Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With an emphasis on multi-cloud networks, this research paper offers a synopsis of cloud computing techniques. It covers the fundamentals of cloud programming, the difficulties that cloud computing faces, and the ways that multi-cloud systems, such as cloud hybridization, federation clouds, cross-clouds, and multi-clouds, might help solve these problems. The opportunity of multi-cloud structures in combination with modern technologies such as Big Data and also Machine Learning (ML) is explored as well in the study, leading to some fascinating breakthroughs. To assist researchers, grasp the difficulties and generate enthusiasm within the community for the upcoming pairing of multi-cloud services with additional cutting-edge technologies, the aim is to present a contemporary perspective on multi-cloud technology and solve outstanding concerns.

articleTitle: Optimizing Real-Time Medical Diagnostics with Adaptive AI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Early diagnosis and treatment of disease are key in concentrations done for medical diagnostics. Technology is moving fast and with that, there are always new methods for diagnosing patients being created, the improvement of accuracy and speed even in medical diagnostics. Unfortunately, the abundance of data collected by these tools makes it prohibitively difficult to accurately interpret and analyse real-time results. This is where Adaptive AI (Artificial Intelligence) algorithms are useful. This flexibility of adaptive AI systems makes them well-suited to the real-time medical diagnostics that are required. In addition, through the use of machine learning techniques these algorithms are capable to process and analyse large scale datasets at a speed that is orders faster than any human expert. They can also detect patterns and feature outliers within the data that traditional diagnostic methods may overlook. Using adaptive AI algorithms is anticipated to optimize the diagnostic process of medical conditions and increase accuracy thus allowing faster diagnosis. It could mean finding diseases earlier, and therefore treating they better as well as costing healthcare less. These algorithms are able to constantly learn from new data which allow them not only to improve with time, but also adapt in order effectively combat changing disease patterns.

articleTitle: Melanoma Skin Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Skin cancer, known as melanoma, is very dangerous in case of when it is not diagnosed at an early stage and has a positive prognosis when it is treated within the time frame. This work goes deep into the field of deep learning techniques to enhance the automation of melanoma detection. Using a dataset including 735 dermatoscopic pictures and two profound deep learning models were put to the test: A CNN model with ResNet-50 as the backbone and a Faster R-CNN model with MobileNet v3 as the backbone. The ResNet-50-powered CNN brought a precision rate of 85.06%, which proves that it is viable for accurately differentiating melanoma sores. To take identification accuracy to a higher level, the Faster R-CNN model was introduced, combining sore characterization with bounding inside the pictures. Finally, this integrated approach produced a quite impressive accuracy of 90 percent. This is good for clinical applications, as indicated by its 03% rating. From the disclosures made in the review, it is possible to infer that deep learning models, particularly those that have been augmented with district-based methods, hold the potential for early identification of melanoma. These mechanical headways can enhance patient results by integrating with adequate diagnosis and treatment, potentially saving lives and enhancing the quality of patient care in dermatology and oncology practices.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines for Soil Quality Assessment in Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to understand the soil’s health, fertility, and crop appropriateness, soil quality assessments are an important part of sustainable agricultural techniques. Using their accuracy and resilience in dealing with complicated, nonlinear datasets, Support Vector Machines (SVMs) are investigated in this research as a potential tool for soil quality evaluation. Our study presents a comprehensive methodology for using SVM to analyze soil properties, including pH, nutrient content, moisture levels, and organic matter. We employ a dataset encompassing diverse soil samples from different geographical regions and farming conditions. The proposed SVM-based model is trained and validated using this dataset, demonstrating high predictive accuracy and reliability in classifying soil quality. Additionally, we compare the performance of SVM with other machine learning techniques such as Random Forest and k-Nearest Neighbors, highlighting the advantages of SVM in terms of precision and computational efficiency. The results indicate that SVM can serve as a powerful tool for farmers and agronomists, facilitating informed decision-making and promoting sustainable agricultural practices. In conclusion, this research underscores the potential of SVM in soil quality assessment, contributing to the advancement of precision agriculture. Future work will focus on integrating SVM with remote sensing technologies and expanding the dataset to include more diverse soil types and environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Proposed Framework for Modifications to Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (Ai/Ml)-Based Software as A Medical Device (SAMD)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The rapid adoption of software as a medical device (SAMD) driven by artificial intelligence and machine learning has brought about a fundamental shift in the medical industry. This shift has the potential to greatly improve clinical outcomes and the quality of care provided to patients. This shift has been responsible for a number of key achievements made in recent times. When seen in this context, the proposed legal framework for revisions to the AI/ML-SAMD appears as an essential response to the malleability of these technologies. To successfully navigate the tough process of modifying AI/ML-SAMD with the assistance of this framework. It does this by taking into consideration the need for rapid regulatory scrutiny and making an attempt to combine the promotion of innovation with the simultaneous preservation of patient safety. In other words, it ensures that patient safety is protected while also encouraging innovation. This abstract provides a summary of the fundamental components of the framework, as well as a discussion of the significance of those components with regard to fostering the development of moral AI/ML-SAMD within the context of the healthcare ecosystem. The healthcare sector is undergoing a change as a direct result of artificial intelligence and machine learning, which are improving patient outcomes, diagnostic accuracy, and treatment options. The research emphasizes the significance of specific AI and ML applications as well as the sector’s embrace of this paradigm-shifting technology. In addition, the regulatory framework that has been presented is an important step towards guaranteeing the safe use of AI and ML in the medical field.

articleTitle: Integration of IoT Based Sensor System for Smart Agriculture Monitoring and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) Technology has created opportunities for developing intelligent systems in different segments. Agriculture is the most significant beneficiary potential of IoT. IoT-based sensor systems in agriculture help monitor parameters affecting plant growth and health. This data can assist in making better decisions around essential parts of agricultural procedures, like when to rinse or not, what pest needs attention, and where you have already fertilized. This research paper aims to develop an IoT-based system for monitoring and optimization in intelligent agriculture. Wireless sensors collect data on soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and light intensity. Then, sensor nodes are connected to a central gateway that gathers and processes the data. The processed data is sent to the cloud server for storage and analysis. This system also has an interface where farmers can access this data and see their crops’ conditions (present location). It also suggests how adjustments should be made regarding irrigation and fertilization according to the data collected. This will enable farmers to save time and input costs by applying the exact amount of water or fertilizers per their requirements.

articleTitle: Hate Speech Detection using MLP and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Social media platforms are essential parts of today’s communication because they help people of different countries to exchange information. However, due to the fact that these venues are unmonitored, hate speech has risen and this is a problem for both those to meet online and the general society. Because of the excessive involvement of social media in society, racisms both in old and new form have been observed. It is discovered that racism exists in several forms on social media, explicit and implicit. It can be observed by memes, and posting statements by racists with the intention of inciting hatred, violence, terrorism and fear in the society. Even though racial prejudice and discrimination are often associated with such expression still, there are indefinite and insulting statements on race, gender. Many countries regard sexual orientation as a threat to their political, social, and cultural stability, and to international security. The racist ideas propagate fast on social media, therefore social media must be closely monitored, and racist remarks must be promptly seen and set a ban on it. In this work, we present an approach involving deep learning and machine learning for classifying as well as detecting hate speech in the social media platforms. By utilizing a dataset of labelled tweets we preprocess the data, extract relevant characteristics, and train the model to categorize particular samples of hate speech, offensive language, and neutral content. We apply state-of-the-art deep learning methodology based on multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks, and machine learning technique which is random forest. We demonstrate that our algorithms are properly recognizing hate speech based on parameters such as accuracy and loss. This study supports the continuous efforts to prevent hate speech on social media and for general development of the safer and secure environment for the consumers.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning with Binary Integer Programming for Optimal PMU Placement in Dynamic Power Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: PMUs or synchronized PMUs are rapidly becoming essential in today’s power systems acting as monitors in the advancement of mainstream grid supervisory, protective, and controlling systems. This paper presents an improvement of the existing methodology for PMU placement by incorporating Machine Learning algorithm coupled with binary integer programming in order to feed real-time grid conditions and demand forecasts into the algorithm. Addressing four primary constraints: 1) observability in fully and partially observable cases; 2) conventional measurements across various cases; 3) network robustness against single PMU or a communication line; and finally, 4) flexibility with regards to increasing or decreasing failure rates, this augmented approach includes, but does not limit to, machine learning-based predicative analysis for a dynamic power grid management. Employed on IEEE 14-bus, a 21-bus $400-\mathrm{kV}$ real power system, as well as the IEEE 30-bus system, strategy helps in creating a cost-effective, secure and smart monitoring system.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for IoT-Based Smart Traffic Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The increasing complexity of urban traffic networks demands more intelligent and adaptive solutions for traffic management. This paper presents a novel approach utilizing Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) in conjunction with Internet of Things (IoT) technology to develop a smart traffic management system aimed at optimizing traffic flow in real-time. IoT devices, including sensors, cameras, and connected vehicles, provide comprehensive, high-resolution traffic data, which is processed by a DRL-based algorithm to dynamically control traffic signals and manage congestion. The proposed system continuously learns from evolving traffic patterns, adapting its decision-making to optimize key metrics such as vehicle throughput, travel time, and energy consumption. Compared to traditional traffic management systems, the DRL-based approach exhibits superior performance in handling dynamic traffic environments, reducing bottlenecks, and minimizing delays. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the integration of DRL with IoT enhances the system’s ability to manage complex, real-world traffic scenarios more efficiently. This research contributes to the growing body of work in smart city development, offering an innovative framework for the deployment of intelligent traffic management systems. The study highlights the potential of DRL and IoT technologies to transform traffic management, promoting sustainable urban mobility and improving overall traffic efficiency..

articleTitle: Intelligent Gates Exploring the Massiveness of Random Access Points in NGMA
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the rapid progress of Next-Generation Mobile Architecture come several obstacles in improving user experience and network performance. Active methods frequently face issues in allocating network resources correctly. Consequently this can lead to mismanagement or poor resource utilization affecting how users experience the network. As access requirements increase with the growth of architecture complexity protecting personal data is becoming more challenging. To tackle these issues the Dynamic Access Point Management (DAPM) framework shows great potential as it delivers a creative strategy for resource allocation and network optimization. This model modifies standard resource management practices to become sharper and more adaptable. Thorough examination is needed to confirm DAPM’s superiority over standard methods regarding the resolution of these problems comprehensively. This research will examine the gains in network efficiency and security outcomes from the sophisticated models of DAPM. The detailed methodology seeks to construct a network framework that is both dependable and secure and will boost NGMA’s operational effectiveness and durability.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Internet of Things with Blockchain for Enhanced Security and Data Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper introduces a paradigm that might transform the Internet of Things. Blockchain technology makes this system workable. Five approaches comprise the framework. Each is crucial for a powerful, automated, and scalable Internet of Things ecosystem. The framework has five techniques. Making a permanent record is the first step. This record is unchangeable. The second program handles steps. The third way secures messages. The fourth program prioritizes customer privacy. The fifth technique addresses expansion and interoperability. Comparison testing and graphic presentations reveal that the technique outperforms all key qualities. The reason is: Since reviews are detailed, the technology is supposed to transform data management and security in the fast-growing Internet of Things. This modification will likely be major.

articleTitle: Enhanced Node Localization in IoT Sensor Networks via Deep Learning and Virtual Node Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the deployment of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, numerous innovative and practical applications are being developed. IoT enables these applications through the use of resource-constrained fixed and mobile nodes. Using the whale optimization algorithm (WOA), we develop a deep learning technique that overcomes traditional DV-Hop localization challenges. In our approach, deep neural networks (DNNs) are used to estimate distances between nodes that have not yet been determined (non-coordinated) and anchor nodes that have been determined (coordinated) at low costs for IoT infrastructure. In contrast to DL methods that typically require substantial training data to achieve high accuracy, this problem can be solved by implementing a data augmentation strategy (DAS). DNNs are improved by creating virtual anchors around actual anchors to increase the dataset size and enhance their performance. Simulation results indicate that our deep learning-based DV-Hop localization method significantly surpasses other localization techniques, especially in terms of positional accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Strategy for Real-Time Regulation of PEV Charging in Response to Fluctuating Renewable Energy Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this work, we set out to simulate and manage the performance of integrate electric automobiles (PEV) during concurrent charging. Finding a way to regulate the aggregate charging capacity of PEVs in response to highly variable sustainable energy resources is the primary goal of this study. The main presumption is that the grid can send out a universal command signal that allows it to directly regulate PEV charging power in real time. For the combined charging of PEVs, we create a partial differential equation model dependent on the transport-based demand modelling paradigm. We run the model using actual driving data and compare its results with a Monte Carlo simulation framework of PEVs. Then, based on the principles of sliding mode supervision, we construct a robust system-wide regulator to measure output. Regardless of fluctuations in the total number of PEVs on the electrical network, the controller strives to mitigate the real-time disparity among power source and demand. To evaluate how well the controller works, we run simulations based on a real wind power direction.

articleTitle: Advanced Traffic Flow Prediction Using LSTM Networks and Big Data Integration for Urban Mobility Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As urbanization expands at a rate faster than ever before we experience traffic jams which call for sophisticated predictive methods in order to improve the traffic systems. Hypothesized from the heuristic analysis of big traffic data, the present paper outlines a new traffic flow prediction model. The proposed methodology uses big real-time traffic data and historical big data with a machine learning approach that can detect and analyse temporal and spatial dependencies. The model incorporates DL concepts like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks which capture the sequential dependencies and the complex correlation in traffic flows. Moreover, we also have Feature Selection mechanism to filter the traffic data indicators and thus decrease the data dimensions and increase the prediction accuracy. The integration of big data analytics is helpful in real-time adjustments to changes in traffic and is more accurate. By testing the method on different traffic datasets, the authors show that the proposed method outperforms the traditional models. The findings of this research are novel and significant because this framework can be easily applied and implemented for the traffic flow prediction across various cities, helping in management of traffic and thereby limit traffic congested areas.

articleTitle: Neural Network Interpretability: Methods for Understanding and Visualizing Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Neural networks, which are a type of deep learning model, are massively criticized due to their ‘black box’ approach, which does not allow interpreting their decisions. In this research, several post-hoc interpretability techniques, which seek to explain the behavior of such models, are discussed. Specifically, this paper aims to evaluate the application of activation maps, feature importance, and attention mechanisms for explaining CNN and LSTM architectures within two distinct datasets namely Fashion MNIST and IMDB. Thus, the work has a focus on showing that these interpretability methods are not only useful for understanding deep learning models, as well as for reducing bias, fairness, and trust in AI systems. It emphasizes that the complexity and interpretability of models used in socially important tasks should be more thoroughly researched in order to develop effective means of improving artificial intelligence systems while maintaining explanatory power and non-discriminatory approach.

articleTitle: Bridging the Gap with Sensor Networks and Cloud Computing in the Geospatial Web for Optimized Data Services
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Implementing cloud computing and data networks for local internet services is a priority. This research addresses the issue by introducing a novel approach to enhance the quality of regional internet data services. The proposed technique, Geographical Data Fusion with Dynamic Cloud Resource Allocation (GDF-DCRA), enhances map analytics by combining geographical data fusion with dynamic cloud resource allocation. GDF-DCRA enhances the speed of geospatial analytics by reducing sensor data, efficiently allocating cloud resources, and integrating spatial and temporal data. It consistently outperforms six industry benchmarks in terms of speed, latency, scalability, data accuracy, bandwidth efficiency, fault tolerance, and resource utilisation. Despite the increasing difficulty of working with real-time location data, the proposed approach has the potential to address these challenges.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence aware Knowledge Graphs and Deep Learning-Based Diagnostic Prediction Model in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Diagnostic prediction experts use a patient’s medical history to anticipate their future diagnosis. Attention mechanisms and recurrent neural networks are typically utilized for this purpose; however, data shortages often cause complications. Additionally, healthcare information can help diagnostic prediction algorithms. This study links healthcare ideas using AI-aware, intelligent healthcare ontologies and patient visit records as an intelligent graph. Next, utilize a graph convolution module to collect geographical attributes that show patient visit healthcare code linkages. Using a multihead attention technique, visit information and healthcare knowledge are compared to predict the patient’s future health. On two open-source healthcare datasets, the suggested solution outperforms state-of-the-art diagnostic prediction algorithms and better uses IMG data.

articleTitle: Applications of Soft Computing in Environmental and Ecological Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The growth of soft computing methodology and its uses is the main emphasis of this paper’s exploration of the growth of soft computing services across various industries. It looks at how to solve complicated setup designs and problems using artificial neural networks, fuzzy logic, and evolutionary algorithms. The study applies soft computing methods in the field of ecology and the environment. It looks at the success stories, the topic of investments used, the efficacy of soft computing across sectors, and the applicability of the findings to actual situations.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Communication: Integrated Satellite-Aerial 6G Networks for Point-to-Point Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Upcoming mobile networking will require wireless applications with global coverage and better data rates. Current diverse cellular systems like wireless and satellite systems are not able to satisfy these demands on their own in particularly remote places with mountains and seas. This paper uses transdisciplinary expertise, including domain knowledge of 6 G satellite communication, advanced NLP technology, and patent retrieval and analytic approaches, to identify the potential technological landscape and trends. Depending on the abovementioned objectives, this study offered an exhaustive evaluation of ISAC innovation for 6G ISTNs in this study. Initially, this investigation provided an outline of the main technologies, assessment criteria, and past development history of the ISAC. After that, a thorough discussion of the state of ISTN development was held, emphasizing integrated network topologies. Finally, we outline the key technologies and scenarios that could be implemented in the next generation of satellite-terrestrial ISAC.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Chatbots for Mental Health Support
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Globally, the prevalence of mental health conditions is rising, making it one of the biggest issues facing healthcare in the 21st century. These mental illnesses have long-term effects that endure a person's entire life, requiring constant care from both patients and medical professionals. The ‘World Health Organization’ has focused particularly on digital health interventions as a way to achieve universal health coverage and enhance public healthcare services. The focus of ‘digital health intervention’ changed in recent years from traditional areas like eHealth or mobile health to the boundaries of cutting-edge computational sciences, which include big data analytics, genomics, including artificial intelligence (AI). The application of artificial intelligence (AI) to healthcare has gained significant momentum, covering critical aspects such early disease identification, disease progression interpretation, treatment regimen optimization, and the development of innovative intervention tactics. The use of AI-powered chatbots for digital assistance in healthcare has increased due to advancements in voice recognition, natural language processing (NLP), and artificial intelligence (AI). These highly developed computer algorithms are carefully designed to mimic and process spoken or typed human discussions with efficiency. As a result, consumers have the exceptional chance to communicate with technology in a way that remarkably mimics having a discussion with a real human. This research study aims to discuss the potential of AI-powered chatbots for improving the mental health of individuals. This study has discussed the positive impacts of chatbots on mental well-being and how different technologies are used by chatbots to identify mental factors. Moreover, the future challenges and issues related to AI-power chatbots for improving mental health have also been covered in this research.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Detection System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Heart failure is a complex condition impacting a large population globally. Early detection is critical. The early identification of heart disease is a major priority in healthcare. The first method utilizes a weighted Naïve Bayes approach for predicting heart disease. A third approach involves using an enhanced SVM, optimized through duality, to automatically identify heart failure. Furthermore, the paper examines a clinical choice bolster framework (CDSS) that leverages a heart malady expectation show. The point of this ponder is to prepare clinicians with apparatuses for the early determination of heart illness, empowering more compelling treatment and the anticipation of genuine wellbeing issues. The ponder compares four machine learning models, centering on progressing the precision of heart malady conclusion through the utilize of XGBoost and different choice tree classification calculations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Microgrid Stability: Optimal BESS Sizing via Modified PSO for Frequency Control and Cost Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: When constructing a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) to be incorporated in a microgrid, the main objective is to minimise the risk of microgrid stability and system failure. An improper or careless sizing of the BESS may lead to system losses, excessive capacity, and high installation costs. Consequently, this study suggest a novel technique for managing the frequency of the independent microgrid using an improved particle swarm optimisation (PSO), which aims to find the optimum size of the BESS while minimising its total cost. Our research focuses on finding the most cost-effective way to deploy BESS in microgrids for a period of 15 years. We will also recommend the optimal measurements of BESS to minimise microgrid volatility and system failure in the case of utility grid outage. We will use the PSO approach for frequency regulation. The next step is to examine a standard microgrid and evaluate BESS in comparison to other existing storage systems in terms of their economic performance. By comparing the optimum size of BESS- modified PSO method to both the conventional size of BESS and the ideal size of BESS-based empirical approach, the findings show that the latter may improve the dynamic system effectiveness. In a typical microgrid, the polysulfide-chromium BESS is predicted to be cheaper throughout the 15 years of deployment compared to the chrome redox BESS, when evaluating the financial health of the two storage techniques. Findings indicate that microgrid planning flexibility, grid security, and power system stability may all be greatly enhanced using the suggested PSO method-based frequency management. Simultaneously, it is able to meet the needs for frequency control economically.

articleTitle: A Categorization and Evaluation on Industry Specific Machine Learning Models and Their Acceptability
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is a powerful technology that is revolutionizing several industries, including medicine, finance, and transportation. This research offers a thorough examination and assessment of machine learning methods used in various fields, with a special emphasis on their effectiveness and versatility in tackling industry-specific obstacles. ML models including XGBoost, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting have shown outstanding performance in healthcare by accurately predicting cardiovascular illnesses and diabetes. Among these models, XGBoost has achieved the greatest accuracy and recall. Within the realm of finance, a combination of algorithms such as XGBoost and Random Forest proved to be more effective than conventional models in detecting fraudulent activities. This ensemble method demonstrated increased precision and a decline in the frequency of false positives. The Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (T-GCN) has been identified as the most efficient model in the transportation industry for forecasting Norwegian air passenger traffic. It surpasses other models concerning error and accuracy metrics. This work demonstrates how machine learning may be used to enhance decision-making and highlights the importance of selecting the right model depending on application needs, efficiency, and prediction accuracy in several industries. The findings provide helpful information on the effectiveness of various machine learning models and their applicability to actual situations, therefore facilitating future progress and utilization of machine learning technology.

articleTitle: Multimodal Neural Network Model for Intelligent Diagnosis of Melanoma Skin Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A melanoma skin disease cure is more likely with early identification. Melanoma skin diagnosis by dermoscopy-based manual visual inspection has $75 \%$ to $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$ accuracy but low efficiency. Doctor skill and experience are crucial to this treatment. Image input and metadata are used to create an Intelligent Model for multimodal neural networks in the study. Metadata includes perceptron learning model feature vectors with patient information, lesion collection locations, image resolution, and quantity. Image data is CNN-derived feature vectors. Disease categorization by fusing and mapping these two feature vectors allows early auxiliary melanoma diagnosis. 58,457 2019 and 2020 ISIC sample records were compiled and organized. Training and testing data were split 4:1, and experiments compared the convolutional neural network technique to the multimodal Model. Based on the results, the suggested strategy may improve melanoma auxiliary diagnosis classification models by $1 \%$.

articleTitle: Enhanced Keypoint-Based Approach for Identifying Copy-Move Forgery in Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Copy-move forgeries often exploit homogeneous regions in images with large-scale attacks to either highlight or conceal target objects. These manipulations are simple to execute but challenging to notice. Forgery detection techniques like Copy-Move Forgery Detection (CMFD) cannot detect these forged documents because they are unable to identify a sufficient number of effective keypoints in homogeneous areas, leading to inaccurate and inefficient results. SURF stands for Speeded-Up Robust Features and is used in this paper along with A-KAZE and Scale-Invariant Feature Transforms. According to our experiment, A-KAZE offers superior detection performance under diverse attacks, especially when it comes to large-scale attacks targeting homogeneous regions. A-KAZE is found to be more accurate than SIFT, SURF, and A-KAZE when applied to the NB-CASIA dataset, achieving detection accuracies of $\mathbf{8 9. 2 \%}, \mathbf{9 3. 9 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 8. 9 8 \%}$.)

articleTitle: AI-Based Bolt Loosening Diagnosis with Deep Learning from Laser Ultrasonic Wave Data
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Large-scale production of steel requires an exceptionally strong bolt connection. Throughout functioning, loosening of bolts and preload losses can lower a structure’s capability to transport loads while maintaining security and longevity. Among the most intriguing areas in this subject is applying Artificial intelligence algorithms like deep learning (DL) to non-destructive assessment. This investigation intends to contribute to this work by examining the adoption of DL methods for a bolt-loosening diagnosis from laser ultrasonic wave data. Ultrasonic Wave Propagation Imager (UWPI) was used to construct a 3D ultrasonic wave dataset. Various methods for signal processing were then used to produce the processing statistics. The determined variance was computed for assessing the efficiency of a convolutional neural network (CNN) on various processing data sets employing a regression framework depending on a VGG-like framework. To further illustrate the durability of the suggested method, comparisons were made with different AI algorithms for regression. It was discovered as a result that the suggested strategy has possibilities for integrating DL methods and laser-generated ultrasound. Furthermore, it has been demonstrated that DL efficiency for the automated looseness estimates is significantly influenced by the signal analysis method.

articleTitle: Pioneering AI in UAV-Assisted 6G Networks for the Advancement of Mobile Robotics in Industry 5.0
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: New methods are needed to keep up with the fast growth of Industry 5.0 when UAVs are added to 6G networks. This study talks about new ways to make tracking, communication, security, resource sharing, and finding problems better in 6G networks that use unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Using exploration-exploitation loops, the Bellman equation, and dynamic adaptation, the Reinforcement Learning for UAV Navigation method makes decisions that are flexible. Machine Learning is used in Dynamic Network Adaptability to make communication methods better in real time. This makes UAV networks more flexible and efficient. Using AI algorithms to design a secure communication protocol gives great security. Important data is sent safely in 6G networks with UAVs using encryption driven by AI. The Scalable Resource Allocation using Genetic Algorithms Algorithm also offers a fresh way of allocating resources, which makes it flexible and scalable for a range of task situations. Anomaly detection in real time is needed for Industry 5.0 apps, and the Real-time Anomaly Detection using Deep Learning Algorithm makes security better. A full test of comparison shows that the suggested options do better in terms of accuracy, dependability, freedom, and openness. The pictures support the idea that the suggested options are better than the current ones. A research paper on Reinforcement Learning for UAV Navigation focuses on the exploration-exploitation, dynamic adaptation, and Bellman equation use of the method. Overall, these options give you all the tools you need to make UAV activities better over 6G networks in Industry 5.0. They make it easier to use UAVs in many situations by encouraging flexible choices, smart use of resources, safe contact, and instant discovery of strange events.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation Using the Hybrid CNN & LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The present study offers a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture with tumor segmentation using a hybrid CNN & LSTM model. The study makes use of a split dataset, where the training data is utilized for the training test information is utilized for model assessment of methods after preliminary processing. Utilizing the training dataset, together with additional models based on Gaussian Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression, the proposed hybrids CNN & LSTM model was trained. These additional models—Gaussian Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression serve as benchmarks for comparing and assessing the efficacy of the proposed hybrids CNN & LSTM model applying a variety of performance metrics. The F1score of $\mathbf{9 7. 6 6 \%}$, accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 4} \%$, precision of $\mathbf{9 6. 3 4 \%}$, recall of 97.9% & recall of 97.9% are impressive findings that show the efficiency of the suggested hybrid CNN & LSTM approach. These results surpass the performance of previous models, highlighting the effectiveness of the hybrid CNN & LSTM architecture considering tumor segmentation. Additionally, a VGG UNet architecture is employed for segmentation purposes, enhancing the accuracy of the segmentation process.

articleTitle: Computer Vision and Its Algorithmic Evolution in Image Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As computer vision systems have improved, mostly through machine vision progress, people’s views on pictures have changed a lot. In response to this change, the Dynamic AdaptNet project is making an advanced system for analysing pictures that uses data from the surroundings. The manuscripts goals is to offer a full range of features, such as dynamic convolutional neural networks (CNNs), adaptable segmentation, and temporal attention. Standard, Baseline, Enhanced, Advanced, Optimised, and Specialised are some of the choices for the system. Standard is the easiest and most important to use. This study compares and contrasts different methods by checking how well they work based on several factors, such as success, adaptability, and resilience. Independent reviews and comparisons show that Dynamic AdaptNet is a complete tool for real-time picture analysis. This shows that it has the ability to make computer vision better.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Identity Management: Enhancing Privacy and Security in Digital Identity System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Privacy and security are major concerns when it comes to digital identities, particularly in centralized systems where data can be easily hacked or where people engage in identity fraud. These issues can be addressed using blockchain technology since it allows for the creation of a decentralized digital identity that is both secure and tamper-proof. This study employs Kaggle dataset to document the transactions and the devices involved to make the distinctions on how blockchain can boost privacy and security. Predominantly, various machine learning algorithms are used to analyze blockchain applications, and the results emphasize the fact blockchain systems greatly enhance transaction viability and diminish fraudulent actions. Therefore, the study argues that blockchain-based identity management systems offset the shortcomings of the centralized model by enhancing data ownership and combating fraud. Subsequent analysis expanded on the discussion of elaborating the scalability, interoperability, and application of algorithms to blockchains as well as how it can fundamentally change the way that certain industries, particularly identity management, would work with consumers at the center of reliable and secure blockchain solutions.

articleTitle: An Identification Technique for Diseases of Medicinal Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Disease detection in medicinal plants is critical to ensuring the quality and efficacy of herbal drug treatments. Early and accurate diagnosis can prevent disease spread to other vegetation and keep species’ genetic range. numerous strategies for detecting illnesses in medicinal plants have been advanced in recent years, consisting of morphological observation, histological evaluation, molecular biology techniques, and imaging methods. The purpose of this abstract is to review the cutting-edge state of the art in disease detection in medicinal plants and to highlight the benefits and boundaries of numerous strategies. The emphasis is on the usage of modern-day technology to enhance the speed, accuracy, and performance of disorder detection, which includes high-throughput DNA sequencing, real-time PCR, and non-invasive imaging strategies. The capacity of these techniques to improve our understanding of plant disorder mechanisms and aid in the development of effectively managed measures is also discussed. universal, this abstract emphasizes the significance of ongoing work to ensure the long-term viability of medicinal plant manufacturing and the availability of herbal medicines.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning in Photovoltaic System Fabrication and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Although solar power is a sustainable resource, there are still issues with its high cost of manufacture, lack of consistency, and wastage. Thanks to developments in computing capacity, tools, and data production, machine learning (ML) approaches have become more popular in the photovoltaic (PV) industry. The PV industry’s operating procedures and contemporary ML manufacturing technologies have yielded spectacular results with greater accuracy and precision. ML techniques for PV production and operating processes have been studied, however there is little end-to-end study from manufacture to deployment. A comprehensive introduction of solar energy machine learning (ML) is provided in this work. It creates new materials, makes them more efficient solar cells, puts them into action, and then incorporates them with features like finding defects, oversight, management, dimension, prediction, and site adaptability. We looked over 30 research publications, several of which were published within the last Five years. The ANN, LR, RF, and XGBoost algorithms are the most often utilized in our research on machine learning (ML) in solar cell manufacture. XGBoost predicts optoelectronic features better than RF, ANN, and LR algorithms, which predict electrical characteristics. So far, perovskite solar cells have been the focus of present machine learning research in this field, according to our data. Problems, solutions, and future uses of AI in PV evaluation are also included in this research.

articleTitle: Landslide Detection and Mapping using Remote Sensing U-Net Model In Leh-Ladakh Region
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Landslides pose significant risks to communities and infrastructure, making detection, monitoring, and prediction crucial for effective risk management. Remote sensing techniques (RSTs) play a vital role in this regard by offering tools to observe, monitor, and predict landslides. Observation of Earth from space provides a broad perspective, allowing for the detection of changes in terrain morphology that may indicate landslide activity. Satellite imagery and data can be analyzed to identify areas prone to landslides and monitor changes over time. Laser scanning, also known as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging), offers high-resolution elevation data that can be used to create detailed terrain models. These models help in identifying slope instability and potential landslide risk areas. Ground-based interferometry involves the use of sensors deployed on the ground to measure ground deformation with high precision. This technique can detect subtle movements in the Earth’s surface, providing early warning signs of potential landslides. By integrating data from these remote sensing techniques, scientists and authorities can develop effective strategies for landslide risk assessment, early warning systems, and disaster mitigation measures. This holistic approach is essential for safeguarding lives and infrastructure in landslide-prone areas. This paper’s output provides an overview of landslip debris utilizing satellite imagery techniques and deep learning techniques based on the UNET model.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Real-Time Data Validation in Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Using machine learning and blockchain technology in peer-to-peer energy trade has made huge strides in making sure that real-time data is correct. This new way of doing things solves the problems of data quality, trust, and security in the energy business. The purpose of this study is to find out if these technologies can work together to make the approval process better. This would make energy transfers more reliable and efficient. For this study, three main areas of interest have been picked out. As a way to build trust, blockchain technology: The autonomous and unchangeable record of blockchain technology is very important for building trust in the peer-to-peer energy trade network. It makes data gathering clear, auditable, and impossible to change, which builds trust among players. Intelligent systems for finding things that aren’t normal: One common way that machine learning methods are used is to look at data about how much energy is being used in real time. When we compare our method to common methods like statistical analysis, rule-based validation, data duplication checks, expert review, threshold-based validation, and past data comparison, we can see that it works better and faster. The suggested method guarantees an average performance of 0.85, cuts validation time to $\mathbf{1 2 0}$ milliseconds, and raises accuracy to $\mathbf{9 5. 2 \%}$ compared to the usual methods. In the end, P2P energy trade driven by blockchain, and machine learning is a strong solution to the issue of validating data in real time. It provides a safe, quick, and open way to buy and sell energy, and it greatly lowers the chances of data mistakes and scams. Our plan will change the energy business. Trust, long-term success, and money benefit everybody.

articleTitle: Transportation Planning Decision-Making Using Intuitionistic Fuzzy Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this research, we use intuitionistic fuzzy programming to bring insight into transportation planning decision-making processes, namely multi-objective optimization (MOO). Considerations for transportation time and prices are made in the case study, which entails moving things from one location to another. In order to improve the model’s capacity to deal with uncertainty, the supply and demand parameters are represented using crisp parameters. With the goal of simultaneously minimizing time and overall cost, the study interacts MOO with crisp data. Our solution is shown to be feasible by means of a hypothetical numerical issue. With linear membership as well as non-membership functions in particular, the transportation planning problem is tackled and solved. As a result of offering decision-makers with thorough solutions that successfully balance many objectives, the results highlight the effectiveness of the intuitionistic fuzzy programming technique in addressing real-world transportation planning difficulties.

articleTitle: Chord Protocol: Distributed Hash Table for Peer-to-Peer Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Chord DHT (Distributed Hash Table) is a robust solution to a basic problem encountered in peer-to-peer (P2P) applications: efficiently locating the node that stores specific data items. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive analysis of Chord's capabilities and contribute to the P2P landscape. In Chord DHT, we connect all the nodes such that they form a ring, and we explore its ability to map keys onto nodes effectively, facilitating data location within the network. Chord's simplicity helps in supporting a single operation—key mapping to a node—data management, which is quite straightforward, by associating keys with data items and storing them at corresponding nodes. Chord DHT also demonstrates remarkable adaptability to dynamic network conditions, where it seamlessly accommodates node joins and departures while remaining capable of answering queries amidst ongoing system changes. Through theoretical analysis, simulations, and experiments, we found that Chord's scalability emerges as a standout feature and is designed to make node state maintenance scaling and communication costs logarithmic with the network's size. Additionally, this paper showcases a practical implementation of Chord DHT in Java. For a better user experience, we made a sophisticated GUI, which was developed using Java AWT and Swing libraries. Our graphical interface enhances usability and interaction with the Chord DHT system. Further, we highlight its practical applicability in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Techniques in Business Analytics: Lessons from Agile Project Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A potent technique for drawing conclusions from data and advancing corporate analytics is machine learning (ML). Although successful ML project implementation calls for more than simply academic know-how; it also calls for agile approaches, efficient project management, and strategic planning. This study examines the relationship between agile project management and machine learning adoption, offering suggestions for how to include ML throughout business data analysis projects. In the larger context of business analytics, we point out important factors, obstacles, and tactics for streamlining the value of machine learning initiatives by referencing agile methodology principles and best practices. This paper seeks to provide enterprises with the expertise and resources needed to effectively employ machine learning (ML) for business analysis and gain a competitive edge by outlining efficient implementation methodologies.

Author Keywords: agile project management and implementation strategies

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Power System Reliability through Advanced Data Quality Assurance with PowerDataQ Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the case of big data implementations in electric power industry, there is increasing need for establishing good frameworks for the quality and soundness of the big data that feed key processes and initiatives. As a new and unique system, PowerDataQ has been tailored exclusively for evaluation of the quality of the numeric values associated with the electric power. It uses advanced machine learning algorithms and the most complex techniques used in data mining to address issues to do with accuracy, consistency, completeness and timeliness of data. PowerDataQ has been structured to have a multilayered architecture with an embedded real-time data validation and anomaly detection and data cleaning modules to deal with issues that are characteristic of big and heterogeneous data coming from many sources. There is emphasis on domain-specific ontologies for improving semantic comprehension of quality metrics, which in turn are made more context specific. Heavily supported by real-world experiments, the good performance of PowerDataQ is shown in terms of catching data quality problems and enhancing the accuracy and robustness of following power system studies.

articleTitle: Improving Visual Recognition with Enhanced Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The study focuses on evaluating the performance of enhanced Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture on the CIFAR-100 dataset for image recognition tasks. The proposed CNN architecture and all four models, namely ResNet50, DenseNet121, EfflcientNet-B3, and one, were trained and evaluated. The performance of the proposed CNN architecture is undeniably superior to that of the other models evaluated, with an accuracy of 99% and precision of 98% In terms of performance, DenseNet121, EfficientNet-B3, and ResNet50 all achieved commendable results, with an accuracy of 90% and precision of 91%. The effectiveness of the proposed convolutional neural network architecture in categorizing images in multiple dimensions demonstrates the potential for discrete visual recognition tasks. The results underscore the importance of custom CNN designs in real-world applications that require high precision and accuracy. The results of the paper offer valuable insights for future efforts to enhance visual recognition systems and push forward the field of computer vision.

articleTitle: Advancing Residential Energy Management: Integrating Renewable Resources and Vehicle-to-Grid Systems for Optimized Electrical Grid Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The term “smart grid” describes the future generation of electrical power networks, which are very complicated systems. It must take into account all aspects of the electrical system, increasing its intelligence and adaptability. In response to shifts in the electrical market, this idea is put out with the intention of controlling the rising demand while guaranteeing higher service quality and enhanced safety. This research presents an urban scenario that incorporates dispersed energy sources into a smart grid. The research incorporates renewable energy sources like solar panels and tiny windmills into the system, as well as battery storage and grid-connected vehicles that can power the electrical grid by drawing electricity from the storage device. So, to maximize the energy production and absorption systems as well as the recharging and discharging time for a home user’s electric car, a mixed integer linear programming is proposed. Additionally, a number of case studies are provided by changing important variables using the Taguchi technique of design of experiments in order to identify the best solution and demonstrate how each influences the system’s complexity.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Performance Scale and Model Validation in Machine Learning
