publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research examines the performance and validation techniques of various machine learning models, including Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Linear Regression Non-Linear Regression, Neural Networks, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), with a focus on their effectiveness with and without model validation. The study follows a thorough process that includes data collecting from many sources, diligent dataset compilation, and rigorous model validation. Data cleansing, missing value management, feature scaling, categorical variable encoding, and cross-validation implementation are all critical aspects of data preparation. The performance criteria examined were accuracy, precision, recall, and $F 1$-score. The results show that model validation considerably improves model performance. Models validated using approaches like as Hyperparameter tweaking and crossvalidation outperform those not verified. When KNN and Linear Regression are verified, their accuracy and other performance metrics increase significantly. This research highlights the importance of model validation in boosting the generalization and efficacy of machine learning models.

articleTitle: Predictive HR Analytics: Using Machine Learning to Forecast Workforce Trends and Needs
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The present research paper aims to analyze the use of predictive HR analytics integrated with machine learning algorithms for the anticipation of workforce demand and requirements. Thus, based on Kaggle’s IBM HR Analytics and Employee Satisfaction Index datasets, the study uses Decision Trees and Random Forest approaches to develop the model and predict essential HR parameters, including attrition rates, job satisfaction, and performance levels. This paper illustrates that with the use of machine learning, it is possible to extract valuable information from the data concerning employees and apply them to the field of Human Resource Management to improve the efficiency of decision-making. The results identify the future opportunities of predictive analytics by illustrating its application for HR functions to reduce the efforts toward proactive management, enhance the methods for recruitment, and enhance the approaches to retention of employees. Thus, the findings of this study enrich the body of knowledge regarding the application of machine learning in improving the field of human resource management, specifically in identifying the best approaches for connecting HR efforts with the strategic objectives of organizations.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Energy Consumption Forecasting in Smart Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Energy consumption forecasting is crucial in smart buildings so as to effectively manage energy usage and minimize the expenses. The conventional methods of machine learning are not always efficient to achieve generalization when applied on as-built buildings of different types because of architectural or occupancy differences or environmental indices. The major focus of this paper is to discuss the possibility of using transfer learning in improving energy consumption forecasting in smart buildings given the fact that huge datasets are available to pre-trained models. Real data containing a wide range of buildings’ characteristics and random occupancy profiles is used in addition to simulated data to extend the real-world data and to further adjust models for certain cases. The proposed work includes testing of some new transfer learning algorithms that target at adaptability of the models and quality of their predictions. To compare their efficiency in various scenarios, these algorithms are assessed via several measures, thereby indicating the opportunities for enhancing the performance of forecasts with the help of transfer learning in various types of buildings. The work’s results show that the proposed transfer learning method acts as a very solid solution for energy forecasting in smart buildings, opening the door for more dynamic and efficient energy management in these contexts.

articleTitle: ML-Based Analysis on a Live Video Feed
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This work offers the growth and also application of an item discovery as well as a tracking system utilizing a Raspberry Pi with a mini electronic camera. Utilizing artificial intelligence methods especially the YOLO (You Just Look Once) design the system accomplishes real-time discovery as well as tracking of numerous items within online video clip feeds or live video feed. The system supplies an easy-to-use user interface permitting individuals select particular things for discovery and also see the real-time video clip feed with highlighted discoveries. Screening results show the system’s precision rate along with reliability showcasing its viability for applications such as safety security and also independent cars. The future job consists of discovering optimizations such as design trimming as well as quantization incorporating side computer gadgets for minimized latency as well as boosting the interface for enhanced use. Overall, this work adds to the advancement of real-time item discovery systems and opens up opportunities for additional study and advancement in the area.

articleTitle: Leveraging Transformer Networks for Enhanced Conversational AI
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive study on leveraging transformer networks for enhanced conversational AI, show casing their superiority over traditional models such as LSTM, GRU, and GRU BiRNN decoders. The architectural enhancement, improvement by RBF kernel and the proposed transformer model used by the OpenSubtitles 2018 dataset, contextually and legibly suitable replies generated by significant advancements. Critical developments demonstrate incomprehension of 4.58, appreciably descending from 7.568 earned by the GRU BiRNN decipherer with ELU activation, and training time diminishing substantially. The prototype’s Sparse Categorical Cross-Entropy (SCCE) training costs are Streamlined to 0.14 and 0.192, appropriately. Proved by its originality and efficacity, both acoustic-aware modes and textual modes are handled by the system effectively. There are different types of conversational AI applications, but this study indicates the potential transformer-based architectures to surpass traditional RNN-based models and clear the way for upcoming improvements concerning real-time adaptive learning, personalized user interactions, and multimodal inputs.

articleTitle: Applying Convolutional Neural Networks for Disease Detection in Crop Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Ensuring agricultural production and food security relies on the early and precise identification of crop diseases. It may be tedious, error-prone, and time-consuming to use traditional approaches to identify diseases. In this study, we investigate how Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) may be used to improve and automate the process of identifying diseases in crop photos. Our approach use deep learning to swiftly and reliably identify and classify a broad variety of agricultural diseases. We trained our CNN model on a diverse dataset that included images of crop leaves in various states of health. The dataset covers a broad variety of common illnesses and numerous kinds of crops, which guarantess that our model is resilient and can be applied to other situations. To avoid overfitting and boost the model’s performance, we used sophisticated data augmentation methods. The CNN model surpasses traditional machine learning methods in terms of accuracy, as shown by a significant reduction in false positives and false negatives. The model’s capacity to process and analyse images in real-time makes it beneficial in the field of disease management. This research emphasises the possibility of incorporating convolutional neural networks (CNNs) into precision agricultural methods, giving farmers a formidable instrument for early disease detection and prompt response to reduce crop losses. Improving the model’s scalability for largescale agricultural applications, adding more disease kinds to the dataset, and increasing the dataset are all areas that will be the focus of future effort.

articleTitle: Synergizing Blockchain with Big Data for Improved Data Integrity and Transparency
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research offers a novel and complete technique to merge blockchain and big data, solving accuracy, security, and scalability issues. Five algorithms—integrating a decentralized storage solution, automating smart contracts, reaching an agreement (proof-of-work), sharding for scalability, and securely encrypting data for privacy—are advocated. The Decentralized Storage Solution Integration technique secures the system’s basis by building up a decentralized storage system, employing cryptographic hashing to ensure stability, and ensuring acceptance through proof-of-work. The technique uses sharding technologies for scaling, parallel processing, redundancy, and fault tolerance. The autonomous storage system and Smart Contract Automation algorithm automate compliance inspections. Clearer deals reduce transaction costs. This strategy is crucial for efficient, transparent, and cost-effective contractual negotiations. The agreement (proof-of-work) approach protects financial transactions with computer problem-solving. Thus, the blockchain remains trustworthy, data is consistent, and interactions are visible. The proposed technique has been extensively investigated, and the findings reveal how each program is interconnected and vital to the system. Tables and figures indicate that the recommended strategy outperforms current combinations in all critical areas. The solution is essential because it is extensible, works with other systems, uses resources well, is easy to check, helpful, and cheap. Blockchain technology and big data are proposed as a better solution. It covers the essentials and ensures blockchain systems are secure, open, scalable, and privacy-protecting.

articleTitle: Load Balancing and Task Scheduling Methods in Cloud Computing – A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Nowadays, Cloud computing is an evolutionary method which gives on-demand flexible and scalable properties by pay-per-utilize model. Several companies are constructing extra data centres and moving their operations to the cloud because of the cloud flexibility. To assure optimal resource usage and reduce resource waste, these businesses required appropriate load-balancing. Requirements for optimal resource allocation include effective load-balancing and task scheduling. Effective scheduling combined with load-balancing maximizes the Quality of Service (QoS) metrics and divides resources in a balanced manner. The most effective approach to load-balancing is task migration. The research work will introduce a hybrid optimization method to improve the existing challenges and problems. The proposed work will define remarkable enhancements in response time as well as resource utilization parameters, etc.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Optimization: Machine Learning Applications in Inventory Management for E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study looks at how machine learning (ML) methods can be used in e-commerce inventory management to make demand forecasting and inventory optimisation more accurate and efficient. The literature review shows how important it is for online stores to keep track of their goods well and how machine learning algorithms might be able to help with this problem. Several machine learning techniques are talked about, such as supervised learning, reinforcement learning, and unsupervised learning, along with how they can be used in inventory management. The study makes up the suggested architecture for ML-based inventory management: importing data, preparing data, finding features, storing data, and the ML system. Real-world examples, like how Amazon uses AI in its forecasting, show that ML can be used in e-commerce product management and show its benefits. Real-world examples show that decision tree models and deep learning methods like recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are useful for predicting demand and optimising supplies. But problems are pointed out, such as bad data, a lack of computing power, and models that are hard to understand. In the future, researchers will look into how to fix problems with machine learning algorithms, how to use new technologies like bitcoin and augmented reality, and how to make sure that AI is used in an ethical way and that customer data is kept safe. The study finds that machine learning has a lot of potential to change how e-commerce inventory is managed, which could lead to more efficiency and better decisions in the digital market.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approaches for Natural Language Processing and Sentiment Analysis in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the recent decade, there has been a rise in social media and various companies are using it as a primary tool for marketing. In order to better understand the emotion and views of the customers, social media sentiment analysis has been used. Machine learning is a rising technology which helps in sentiment analysis in the social media which helps to easily categorize the views and opinions of the customers in certain categories. The major objectives of the study include exploring Machine Learning Approaches for Natural Language Processing and Sentiment Analysis in social media. In this research, the methods of sentiment analysis in online social networks using ML and techniques for grouping have been studied in detail. A secondary research approach has been followed for the research. The major benefits of sentiment analysis on social media have also been presented as a part of the report. In the research it has been found that there are two major types of clarifying sentiments which are supervised and unsupervised learning. The research also reveals that the best learning model for evaluating the Twitter dataset is determined to be CNN using Word to Vector and under instruction.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Power Designs and Strategies for Next-Generation Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Energy-efficient design and operation are essential for next-generation sensor networks to persist and require less maintenance. This paper describes a novel energy-efficient sensor network. It uses superior data routing and aggregation. Three novel algorithms-EARA, DFAA, and Adaptive Data Sampling-make this strategy practicable. EARA sends data with little energy, DFAA collects all data to eliminate duplicates, and ADSA adjusts sample rates based on relevance and variability. Each piece of software sends, manages, and changes sample rates with minimal energy. This innovative energy-saving strategy is tested against static-duty cycling, non-adaptive data aggregation, fixed-rate data sampling, high-energy data transmission, centralized data routing, and unoptimized sensor node location. The recommended solution outperforms network lifetime, energy usage, data accuracy, latency, scalability, and dependability. Energy savings, ease of use, affordability, adaptability, long-lastingness, and network lifespan are usually better with the proposed response. Scatter plots illustrate how much better the proposed method saves energy and works properly. The EARA, DFAA, and ADSA algorithm-based techniques offer great potential for energy-efficient sensor networks. This strategy stabilizes and prolongs sensor network configurations by optimizing data pathways, aggregating data, and adaptively sampling data. The results show that it works, making it a novel strategy for the future generation of sensor networks that demand higher performance and less energy.

articleTitle: Emotion State Detection via Speech using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Oral communication is the most efficient and common way to interact with someone. Due to this, voice signalling has attracted researchers for its potential in computer-human communication. Identifying emotions through speech is complex due to various factors like feature selection and vocal diversity. This study uses the RAVDESS and SAVEE datasets and employs techniques including Multilayer Perceptron, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, k-Nearest Neighbours, Logistic Regression, Gaussian-Neural Network, and Convolutional Neural Network. The identified features encompass the MelFrequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC), Chroma, and Mel spectrogram. To conduct a comparison of accuracy rates, we employed seven classifiers across two datasets. Consequently, CNN model demonstrated superior performance in both the RAVDESS and SAVEE databases, with accuracy rates of $\mathbf{9 6. 7 5 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 2. 3 6 \%}$ respectively, surpassing other classifiers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Disease Prediction through Random Forests in Healthcare Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research investigates the application of Random Forest algorithms to enhance disease prediction within healthcare analytics. Using large healthcare datasets, the research compares Random Forests to other machine learning algorithms, such as Neural Networks and Support Vector Machines, and assesses their ability to forecast different illnesses. According to the findings, Random Forests have the ability to reliably forecast diseases since they provide greater accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. In addition, healthcare providers may benefit greatly from the model’s feature significance metrics, which help them understand which aspects have the most impact on illness outcomes. This study emphasises the revolutionary power of Random Forests to improve healthcare diagnoses, personalised treatment regimens, and patient care overall.

articleTitle: Fashion Forward: Exploring the Influence of AI on Modern Fashion Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Fashion has always been a forward-thinking phenomenon that adopts new technology as they become available. Fashion includes design, manufacturing, and consumption, all of which rely on technology to increase product quality and availability in retailers. Artificial intelligence moves as fast as fashion. For almost a decade, artificial intelligence has been utilized to analyse consumer preferences and fashion trends. Its influence on fashion, including the advent of the Fast Fashion movement, is clear. As the garment sector’s digitalization moves toward industry 5.0, the application of artificial intelligence will become more frequent in a wider range of processes. This study will investigate the uses of artificial intelligence in the fashion and business sectors. This research will look into the applications of artificial intelligence in the fashion and business sectors. The paper will also cover modern AI models used in the fashion industry, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN), StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs).

articleTitle: Enhancing Smart Home Security Systems through the Integration of IoT Devices: A Comprehensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Technology has taken center stage in today’s fast-paced world, where it powers nearly every aspect of daily life. The concept of remotely connecting and monitoring physical items (things) via the Internet is known as the Internet of Things (IoT). The need to safeguard our loved ones and possessions has increased due to the rising crime rate. These circumstances can be resolved by taking advantage of the newest features that modern technology has to offer, such as IOT, which enables seamless data connection, and remote-control capability, which facilitates the automation of security procedures. Security can be automated by creating an application for the Raspberry $\mathbf{P i}$ and ATmega 328 microcontroller that uses various sensors, including motion and PIR (passive infrared) sensors, to detect any intruders in the home. When an intruder is detected, an alarm is set off, and the homeowner and notification messages are sent. This idea can be appropriately applied to our home to make it safer, smarter, and more automated. The overall design of a wireless, low-cost home automation system (HAS) is shown in this project. The system’s smart home idea raises the bar for living at home. The PIR motion detector sensor in front of the house detects the presence of people, sends a message to the owner, and allows him to observe the person through the front camera. The web portal allows access to the camera and allows control over the light, fan, door lock, and alarm. The system’s user-friendly interface, affordable construction, and simplicity of installation made it ideal for controlling household electrical appliances and devices. The owner can control the electrical appliances based on their priorities. Depending on the owner’s priority, those who successfully authenticate can use the house appliances and unlock the door by typing their password on the keypad. Our proposed method achieved an impressive accuracy of $98.7 \%$, demonstrating superior efficiency compared to current leading methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Blockchain Scalability: Innovative Solutions for Optimized Performance in Decentralized Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A substantial number of people are presently making use of decentralised cryptocurrencies that are built on blockchain technology. These crypto currencies have garnered a lot of interest over the course of the last few years and are currently being used by their users. Being the first use of blockchain technology, Bitcoin has been a resounding success, which drives further research and improvement in the sector concerned with blockchain technology. Bitcoin was the first usage of blockchain technology. Bitcoin, on the other hand, is susceptible to significant performance issues due to the fact that it has a high transaction latency and a limited throughput. The operations of the cryptocurrency are considerably impacted as a result of these concerns. As a result of the fact that other cryptocurrencies that rely on proof-of-work also carry over its deficiencies, there has been an increase in the number of concerns about the scalability of blockchain technology. The fact that this is the case makes scaling blockchain technology more challenging. All during the course of this investigation, an effort is made to analyse and classify the various scaling mechanisms that are now being used for blockchains. In addition to this, we are going to look at a variety of various approaches and present a list of possible solutions to the issue of scalability that the blockchain technology is now dealing.

articleTitle: VoiceSense: Designing A Robust Emotion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Detecting emotions from speech is an excitingarea of research that can improve how we interact with computers and understand mental health. In our study, we explore how to build a system that can understand different emotions using speech and psychological information. We gather data from various sources like TESS, Crema-D, RAVDESS, SAVEE, and our own custom dataset to create a diverse collection of emotions. To build our system, we use different types of neural networks like CNNs, RNNs, and transformers. After testing our system extensively, we find that it can accurately detect emotions about 77% of the time, which is pretty good. We also look into how our system learns about emotions, which can help us better understand how humans process emotions. Our work not only improves emotion detection technology but also has important implications for making computers more empathetic in how they interact with people.

articleTitle: A Framework for Optimizing Energy Allocation and Sustainability in Cloud-Edge AI Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud-edge computing and artificial intelligence proliferation make it necessary to learn how to properly manage energy in the environment. This paper will aim to design and assess a power trading framework on the possibility of adequately optimizing power allocation for cloud-edge AI systems. The problem that the paper seeks to address is the critical problem of energy acumen in cloud-edge AI. With the growing number of edge devices and the unpredictability of AI workload, power allocation must be effectively done. Therefore, the paper’s scope will include designing a power trading system that will effectively and dynamically allocate power resources in the AI to optimize and secure efficiency, effectiveness, reduce costs, and completely eliminate or reduce latencies. The research approach is wide and thorough. I conducted a collected theoretical framework, developed algorithms, acquired actual and credible real-world data, and analyzed big data. During this process, I conducted real-world simulations and deployed the framework in different case studies involving various cloud-edge AI environments. The results showed that power trading framework sufficiently optimizes power allocation, which has increased pyre efficacy, relatively reduced costs, and low latency. Implementing the framework will also secure sustainability ambitions, especially in reducing carbon emissions and depending less on nonrenewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Real-Time Scheduling for Energy Optimization: Smart Grid Integration with Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Reliable power system operations, cost reduction, demand and supply balance maintenance, and efficient load scheduling all depend on real-time energy optimisation. Nevertheless, the unpredictability of electric loads and renewable energy sources (RES) makes real-time energy optimization difficult. As a result, the Energy Management Controller (EMC) was developed, which can automatically react to DR signals and resolve energy-related issues. In light of this, EDGE, a hybrid algorithm combining elements of genetic algorithm (GA) and enhanced differential evolution (EDE), is devised in this work. The EDGE algorithm is used to train the EMC to automatically react to DR signals and schedule the 3 classes of household loads—hybrid, non-interruptible, and interruptible—to handle energy management issues. The results show that in terms of power cost reduction, minimizing carbon release, PAR relief, and client discomfort maximization, the suggested EDGE algorithm performs better than benchmark methods.

articleTitle: Integrating Multi-Omics Data for Advanced Diabetes Prediction and Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Diabetes is a major global health issue, requiring new approaches to understanding its complex etiology and improving predictions of effective management and treatment. Current methods typically use centralized models, which have privacy concerns and cannot fully capture correlations in multimodal datasets. To address these problems, we introduce a new model using integrated learning and causal theory. Our system uses three datasets: the Pima Indian Diabetes Dataset (PIDD), 130 U.S. Appl. Clinical Diabetes Dataset, and physiological summaries. For analysis in our proposed method, we use various machine learning methods with ensemble method. Here we achieve an accuracy of 93% for PIDD 92% for US 130 clinical datasets and 90% for physically collected datasets. By integrating genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic data, we better understand diabetic mechanisms and potential therapeutic targets. Our model addresses the limitations of current methods, improves prediction accuracy, and data privacy, and provides insight into the aetiology of diabetes. This approach provides a strong foundation for future study.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Advanced Pattern Recognition in Biometric Security Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain and machine learning allow biometric security systems to recognize complex patterns. This study analyzes how two unique technologies may improve fingerprint system safety and reliability. To demonstrate blockchain and machine learning in biometrics. The main reason for this study is that fingerprint protection is becoming more important in today’s digital world. There needs to be strong name verification right away because there is more sensitive data and privacy issues. Traditional biometric systems have come a long way, but there are still problems with data security, privacy, and being able to grow. This study suggests important worries about how blockchain technology and machine learning might be able to improve pattern recognition, make security measures stricter, make data unchangeable, and reach the level of scalability needed for widespread use. Upon careful study of related approaches and works, biometric security could be improved by combining the decentralized and unchangeable record of blockchain with the pattern recognition abilities of machine learning. Ten important ways are looked at, and each one has its own pros and cons. A trio of CNNs, SVMs, and RNNs are used in the method we suggest. The suggested blockchain and machine learning fusion is shown to be better in a detailed analysis. The study ends with compared tables that show the parameters and performance evaluations of $\mathbf{1 0}$ similar systems.

articleTitle: Edge Computing in Network-based Systems: Enhancing Latency-Sensitive Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Relocating data storage and processing to the network’s periphery has revolutionized latency-sensitive applications with edge computing. This study examines how edge computing may boost network-based application performance. For applications with severe latency requirements, we explore how system loads, resource allocation mechanisms, and bandwidth limits across edges affect application response times. We introduce the Enhanced Capacity Edge Cloud Network (ECON) and compare it to a baseline scenario to evaluate its efficacy in different network scenarios. To optimize resource allocation for latency-sensitive applications, we mathematically describe and simulate a city-scale hybrid edge cloud system’s capacity. The study’s results may help build and implement edge computing technologies to enhance real-world application performance.

articleTitle: Advanced Computational Frameworks for High-Resolution Biospeckle Image Analysis: Integrating Machine Learning and Optical Coherence Techniques for Enhanced Biological Tissue Characterization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This work provides a novel computer vision technique for high-resolution biospherical imaging based on cutting-edge machine learning and optical coherence technology. Our approach improves the accuracy and ease of identification of living cells when compared to previous methods. We conducted extensive ablation research on the framework’s components. This demonstrated how different deep learning layers pick up distinct information and how optical coherence facilitates image comprehension. Systems that operate continuously and in real time, using minimal computational resources, can use the proposed approach. The study discovered that the structure is robust and useful for researching biological tissues. Furthermore, a hyperparameter sensitivity study indicated that the model required fine-tuning to function more effectively. This novel design expands the scope of biological tissue analysis and establishes the foundation for future advancement by offering a comprehensive and adaptable solution for high-resolution biospeckle imaging.

articleTitle: Applications of Machine Learning and IoT in Business Management, e-commerce and Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine learning is a part of AI technique which has algorithms associated with it. These algorithms help to study human behaviour and approaches. The Internet of Things, or IoT, is also expanding in today’s world at a faster rate and for its higher reach this technology has been widely used by the existing companies in the industry. The research aims to study how Machine learning and IoT can be applied in business management, e-commerce and finance. The major objectives of the research are to understand about the Internet of Things and MI and analyse various methods for machine learning and AI. The study also analyses the applications in banking, electronic commerce, and company administration. This empirical research will include a qualitative analysis of data collected from the secondary data sources. The study reveals the higher importance of using IOT and Machine learning as it can be useful in revenue generation, profit optimisation and sales forecasting. Also, these advanced technologies can be extremely helpful in providing better safety, recognizing fraud, and handling portfolios are some of the major uses. It is expected that in the near future the use of IoT and Machine learning will increase and businesses will be more benefited from it.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based Service Chains Scheduling for Medical Emergency in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study analyses the weekly scheduling challenge of health and medical information network service function chains to meet medical emergency categorization and grading needs. Emergency services are divided into four sorts by urgency and service area, with priorities and weights. The health and medical information network architecture, service model, and operation method are built accordingly. To reduce weighted completion time, a service function chain scheduling model is created. The function chain scheduling scheme is solved by matching game and Q -learning reinforcement learning algorithms for different issue scales. Finally, simulation studies demonstrate that this approach can accomplish graded medical emergency service, build health and medical information networks, and progress smart healthcare.

articleTitle: AI-driven Dynamic Workload Balancing for Real-time Applications on Cloud Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The specification provides a new, resource-efficient method of Dynamic Workload Balancing in AI-driven Real-time Applications over Cloud Infrastructure. The real-time application keeps processing data at high speeds, and it is too difficult to get or make this type of arrangement using our traditional cloud setups as the system employs artificial intelligence methods responsively reallocate resources between virtual machines in accordion with demanded quality of services slabs in behalf-to-capacity ratio. It is scheduling jobs to resources efficiently and delivering results in a timely fashion, which is necessary for real-time applications like video processing or stock trading. It uses machine learning models based on historical data to predict the resources required for upcoming tasks. These predictions are subsequently utilized to smartly assign resources across VMs, factoring in network latencies and inter-dependence. It allows the system to modify queues in real-time according to changes in workload patterns, performing a dynamic load balancing.

articleTitle: Enhanced Deep Learning Algorithm for Skin Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Skin cancer is a highly severe kind of cancer that poses an important threat to worldwide health. Nevertheless, there is a significant possibility of decreasing the fatality rate if skin cancer is identified in its first phase. Traditionally, the identification of skin cancer has predominantly depended on the visual examination conducted by dermatologists. This approach, although frequently used, frequently lacks accuracy. Deep learning-based technologies have been implemented for improving the diagnosis precision. The primary objective of these sophisticated approaches is to assist physicians in achieving more accurate and timely identification of skin malignancies. A cloud-based implementation of a model-driven architecture leverages deep learning algorithms as its fundamental component. This method builds prediction models that have enhanced accuracy in detecting skin cancer. The article provides a detailed explanation of the process involved in creating these models and showcases their practical use in categorizing images of dermal cells. The deep learning models developed in this study are assessed using established datasets. Impressively, they attained a metric called area under the curve (AUC) of 99.77%, which signifies outstanding performance. Practitioners can utilize this model-driven architecture to quickly create their deep-learning models, enabling more precise forecasts of skin cancer. This technological breakthrough signifies a substantial progression in medical diagnostics, providing optimism for enhanced patient results utilizing early and accurate identification.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Approaches for Real-Time Anomaly Detection in IoT Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) systems has led to the generation of vast amounts of data, increasing the need for effective anomaly detection mechanisms to ensure system reliability and security. Traditional methods often fall short due to the high dimensionality and dynamic nature of IoT data. This paper presents a deep learning-based approach for real-time anomaly detection in IoT systems, leveraging the power of neural networks to identify patterns and anomalies within complex datasets. By employing deep learning algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, this framework can efficiently detect abnormal behaviors in real-time, offering a significant improvement over conventional methods. The proposed system is trained on labeled datasets collected from IoT devices, allowing it to distinguish between normal and anomalous activity. Furthermore, the model adapts to new data, enhancing its detection capabilities over time. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach achieves high accuracy and low false-positive rates, making it suitable for deployment in real-world IoT environments. The framework’s scalability and adaptability highlight its potential for enhancing the security and reliability of IoT networks, particularly in critical applications such as smart cities, healthcare, and industrial IoT.

articleTitle: Enhancing Diabetes Prediction: A comparative analysis of Train-Test Split and Stratified 10-Fold Cross-Validation with SMOTE Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Diabetes is a metabolic disorder identified in a human being by an increase in blood sugar levels, which poses a significant global health challenge. As the risk of diabetes is continuously increasing, it is crucial to predict diabetes in earlier stages. This study explores the use of two different data-splitting techniques employing five different ML algorithms, Train-Test Split and Stratified 10-fold cv. The main aim of this study is to improve model accuracy and to learn about the different splitting techniques present. The Random Forest Model attains an accuracy of 91.78% in train test split and 86.18% in Stratified 10-fold cv, which comes out to be the best model in terms of accuracy in both splitting techniques. Moreover, to remove any bias present in the model or to improve models’ performance, the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) is applied post the initial developments. Comparatively, Random Forest and XGBoost consistently demonstrate superior performance compared to other ML models employed in this study.

articleTitle: Advancing Image Segmentation, Analysis, and Feature Extraction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study centers on review, feature extraction, and image segmentation, integrated through the Dual-Path Convolutional Neural Network (DP-CNN). The DP-CNN is designed to accurately identify objects in images, even in the presence of intricate lines and discontinuities. The MAMAM technique efficiently prioritizes critical image regions, expediting the review process and enhancing accuracy in image analysis. Additionally, feature extraction is refined using the Adaptive Feature Selection (AFS) method, facilitating precise and adaptable image processing. Each component of this approach is systematically developed to meet the research objectives. The combined methodology demonstrates robustness and versatility, proving effective across diverse and challenging data scenarios, thereby presenting a promising solution for rapid and accurate complex image processing tasks.

articleTitle: Integrating Power BI with Machine Learning Models for Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Predictive analytics techniques in the past frequently relied on single-machine memory-bound assembly and classical statistical models, serving only as static reporting tools with no real-time assistance and interface with newer machine learning (ML) tools. As a result, these techniques produce less accurate forecasts and take longer to respond. The study provides a novel method that combines Power BI with a variety of difficult machine learning models, including Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Random Forest (RF). The proposed system enhances predictive analytics through realtime operation and interactive graphic display, resulting in better forecasting capabilities. The results are impressive: ARIMA, LSTM, and RF models outperform traditional systems with higher accuracy forecasts (ARIMA: 85.1%, LSTM: 89.3%, RF: 87.4%) and lower prediction error rates (LSTM: MAE 2.7, RMSE 3.8, MAPE 6.5%). Furthermore, data integration generates insights on its own, providing businesses with both data-driven information and practical decision-making tools.

articleTitle: Utilizing Random Forests for High-Accuracy Classification in Medical Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In recent years, medical diagnostics has increasingly relied on machine learning techniques to improve accuracy and efficiency. Among these, the Random Forest algorithm has emerged as a powerful tool for classification tasks due to its robustness and ability to handle complex datasets. This paper explores the application of Random Forests in medical diagnostics, specifically focusing on enhancing the accuracy of disease classification. By analyzing large, heterogeneous medical datasets, we demonstrate how Random Forests can outperform traditional classification algorithms, offering high precision in identifying and classifying diseases. Key features, such as decision tree ensemble methods and bootstrap aggregation, are utilized to minimize overfitting and improve model generalization. The research compares Random Forests to other machine learning models, such as Neural Networks and Support Vector Machines, and finds that Random Forests perform better in terms of dependability and classification accuracy. We further emphasise that the technique can scale to big datasets and that it can manage missing data. The findings show that Random Forests might be a useful tool for accurate and early diagnosis when incorporated into clinical procedures. The findings of this study highlight the promise of machine learning, and Random Forests in particular, to revolutionise healthcare diagnostics and enhance patient results.

articleTitle: The Role of Edge Computing in Enhancing Cloud Performance and Reducing Latency
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The flexibility of implementing edge computing over cloud infrastructures has become essential for responding to the need for reducing latency and improving data processing in a distributed environment. This research aims to determine the use of edge computing in enhancing the effectiveness of cloud utilization through conducting machine learning investigations utilizing Random Forest in the determination of the optimum contribution of resources. The work also set up and applied real-world datasets from Kaggle to illustrate that edge computing can alleviate the latency issue mainly by offloading computationally intensive tasks to edge nodes away from the central cloud. The results show that edge computing with the help of Machine learning is the best solution for cutting-edge cloud environments as it is fast and does not aggravate the problems of excessive use of resources. Therefore, this research will be a great addition to the existing literature on the integration of cloud and edge computing and is hoped to offer useful information for future developments in the field of cloud computing.

articleTitle: Smart City Insights: Impact of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Smart city is planned to accommodate the increasing population density by effectively using and adopting contemporary information and communication technology (ICT). It effectively helps in managing the city’s increasing urbanisation and energy consumption, preserving the environment, raising the economic and living standards of its residents, and maintaining a green environment. The concept of smart cities is significantly depended on ICT technology for the development, decision-making, execution, and delivery of final productive services. In this article, the technological interventions for the smart city development are discussed. The idea of the “smart city” has become widely accepted in recent decades. Its main objective is to use intelligent applications to raise the living standards of its residents. The results of the study show that creative solutions positively and significantly affect the efficacy, efficiency, calibre, and speed of decision-making in the management of smart cities. The respondents believed that these solutions significantly improved the city’s decision-making process, and the study illustrated the importance of intelligent solutions in administering smart cities.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Cloud Computing: Synergies And Innovations for Data-Driven Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper aims at discussing the interaction between cloud computing and machine learning in analyzing the data since they boost the analytical ability of insights through boosting the predictability and operational ability. The study employs Cybersecurity Attack data set from Kaggle together with Cloud data set and employs Random Forest and ARIMA algorithms together with cloud computationally intensive resources to analyze and interpret large and complicated datasets. It covers data preparation, building, and deploying of models that can analyze data in real-time with cloud support. Findings show that integrating machine learning with cloud computing has immensely improved threat detection, predictive analytics, and actions. This brings in to perspective the potential of such technologies in enhancing the performance of data processing and, forecast future research on the advanced machine learning algorithms and real-time data.

articleTitle: Enhanced Detection of Weak Signals in Chaotic Systems Through Hybrid Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The identification of weak signals in chaotic environment can be problematic because of unpredicted and complex characteristic of chaotic dynamics. This research presents a new method based on an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) to improve the ability of detecting weak signals obscured by noise. In other words, the proposed approach utilize the ANFIS potential in implementing both static and dynamic models of learning for chaotic systems and clearly distinguish weak signals in contrast to noise. Since it allows a non-linear mixture between signals and noise power and the learning mechanism is adaptive, it forms a rather strong basis for identifying signals that cannot be identified in standard approaches. This work confirms the efficiency of the approach under consideration using a number of simulations on standard chaotic systems showing a higher detection accuracy and higher SNR. Combining fuzzy logic with neural network’s allows the system to process weak signals, which exhibit certain degree of ‘fuzziness;’ making it an excellent tool for use in systems that involve chaos or weak signal analysis in areas like communication systems, biomedical engineering, or other form of fault diagnosis. The obtained results affirm and spotlight the rationale of ANFIS as a bringing innovation in the field of the chaotic signal analysis.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Computational Models for Enhanced Interpretation of Biospeckle Images Leveraging Deep Learning and Fourier Transform Techniques in Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study looks at advanced computational techniques that enhance the understanding of biospeckle images in biological contexts. Our models use Fourier transform and deep learning techniques to achieve improved specificity, recall, accuracy, and precision. The Fourier transform may provide a more accurate description of frequency domain data as biological processes evolve over time. Deep learning algorithms recognise patterns in biospeckle images, facilitating analysis, memory, and response. The analysis research delineates the several components that influence the outcome and provides evidence of their respective roles. This research shows how helpful the models are and offers suggestions on how to make them better. Non-invasive biomedical testing uses these computer models to illustrate the temporal evolution of biological cells. Our techniques improve the interpretation of biospeckle images, potentially revolutionising non-invasive biomedical imaging. Future researchers may evaluate these models using different datasets and testing conditions. This guarantees their adaptability and power in biological contexts.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Predictive Analytics for Website Performance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the contemporary digital landscape, the efficacy of websites as vital platforms for businesses cannot be overstated. They serve as primary interfaces for interaction with customers, facilitating transactions, brand representation, and engagement. However, optimizing website performance to ensure maximal user engagement and satisfaction presents a formidable challenge. Traditional methods of website optimization often rely on retrospective analysis of Past data, which might not fully convey the subtle dynamics of user behaviour and market trends. This paper poses an innovative approach to address this challenge by integrating AI (Artificial Intelligence) - based predictive analytics into website optimization strategies. With the utilization of machine learning algorithms, our approach aims to analyse extensive datasets encompassing user interactions, website metrics, and external market dynamics. By leveraging predictive analytics, we anticipate user behaviour, predict future trends, and create data-driven decisions for the optimization of website content, layout, and features in real-time. This proactive method allows organizations to stay ahead of the curve, anticipate user needs, and deliver personalized experiences tailored to individual preferences and behaviours. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated through a series of experiments, showcasing improvements in key website performance metrics such as user engagement, conversion rates, and overall effectiveness. By empowering organizations to anticipate user behaviour and adapt their strategies accordingly, our method holds promise for revolutionizing website management practices in the digital age.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Balancing for Enhanced Resource Utilization in IaaS Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Efficient load balancing is vital in cloud computing to optimize resource use, enhance performance, and maintain application availability. Traditional methods often underutilize the scalability of IaaS models. Hence, a dynamic load balancing system is crucial for real-time traffic distribution among IaaS servers based on demand and resource availability. High traffic challenges in web hosting can degrade load times. Dynamic server load balancing is pivotal here. Our approach integrates ASA genetic algorithms with process scheduling. It queues and assigns requests randomly to virtual servers, verifying connections. A genetic algorithm optimizes schedules via selection, crossover, and mutation, iterating for the best schedule. This strategy markedly reduces load times and maximizes system performance.

articleTitle: Intelligent Multi-Cloud Orchestration for AI Workloads: Enhancing Performance and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper delves into the synergy between cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI), presenting Intelligent Cloud Orchestration (ICO) as an innovative framework for optimizing AI workloads within cloud environments. ICO, powered by sophisticated AI algorithms, dynamically orchestrates, and enhances the deployment, execution, and management of AI workloads, tackling challenges related to scalability, efficiency, and reliability. Beginning with a comprehensive overview of ICO’s foundational AI-driven principles and architectures, the paper elucidates its core components and functionalities. It further explores ICO’s AI-specific applications, including intelligent resource allocation, predictive workload scheduling, adaptive auto-scaling, real-time performance monitoring, and fault tolerance, showeasing its ability to analyze real-time data and system metrics for proactive decision-making and adaptive adjustments. The discussion extends to the integration of ICO with existing cloud orchestration frameworks and management systems, illustrating how ICO seamlessly enhances AI capabilities across popular cloud platforms and services through case studies and practical examples. Emphasizing ICO’s transformative potential, the paper underscores its role in revolutionizing AI workload management and optimization in cloud environments, offering organizations unprecedented levels of performance, scalability, and reliability for their cloud-based AI applications, and paving the way for the next generation of intelligent cloud computing solutions.

articleTitle: Enhanced Framework for Multi-Label Text Classification Using Beta Ant Colony Optimisation (BACO) Ensembling Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One of the most significant issues associated with enormous amounts of data is effectively categorizing text that has a high number of categories. This is especially true in healthcare and online buying and selling. The Beta Ant Colony Optimization (BACO) technique is proposed in this research within a multi-label text categorization system. This research makes use of an ensemble technique to enhance the accuracy of feature selection and classification. BACO is able to change pheromone updates to minimize dimensionality in an effective manner while simultaneously increasing label assignment. This is accomplished via the use of beta distributions and the collective intelligence of ant colonies. On a large number of high-dimensional datasets, BACO is tested in comparison to the most advanced approaches currently available. By enhancing the categorization of text with multiple labels, the results suggest that BACO may be able to enhance classification in complicated settings.

articleTitle: Elevating Digital Experiences by Enhancing Service Delivery through Revolutionary Cloud Services and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research introduces an approach named “Cloud-Driven Personalized Experience Enhancement” to satisfy the escalating demand for enhanced digital connectivity. Via cutting-edge cloud services and applications, the CPExE framework provides a groundbreaking solution for digital platforms. The framework is built upon three core components: Together with the Quantum-Inspired Data Analytics and Evaluation (QIDAE) and Personalized Content Recommendations (PRA), Dynamic Resource Allocation and Adaptation (DRAA) completes the framework. By leveraging quantum-inspired approaches, QIDAE analyzes vast datasets with outstanding effectiveness and exactness improving processes for data handling and personalization. This strategy allows for swift detection of patterns while making certain that data-driven understandings are both on time and precise. By changing cloud resources according to user requests the DRAA module guarantees uninterrupted access to computing power and data storage. By managing resources effectively in real-time it decreases latency and improves service speeds. By using complex algorithms to assess user habits and choices the PRA system boosts the digital experience. PRA uses both content-focused filtering and collaborative screening strategies to provide users with engaging content that matches their unique preferences. By applying sophisticated analytics and resource management methods with content personalization CPExE boosts the user experience and develops cloud technology efficiency. This framework signifies an important progress toward developing dynamic and tailored online environments.

articleTitle: Analyzing HR Management and its Impact using Machine learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: AI is a discipline that combines computer science with wide-ranging datasets to empower problem-solving capabilities. Application of AI in Human resource management increases the efficiency and performance of HRM. AI will reduce the burden of mundane works associated with HRM. Efficient HR management tools have the capacity to automate routine tasks, reducing the administrative burden on HR professionals. This not only saves time but also enables organizations to redirect their focus and resources towards core business objectives. By automating processes related to recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and more, these tools enhance overall operational efficiency, allowing organizations in the IT industry to adapt swiftly to the evolving landscape and capitalize on emerging opportunities. AI will help to take strategic decisions which made a huge impact on every organization here it is used [1].

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Real Time Image Retrieval System for De-Noising Space Images in Chandrayaan 3 Lunar Mission Using Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the context of the Chandrayaan 3 Lunar Mission, this research paper introduces a real-time image retrieval and denoising system powered by autoencoders, designed to tackle the challenge of noisy space imagery. Leveraging advanced deep learning techniques, our system employs autoencoders to extract essential features from the noisy lunar images and subsequently retrieves and integrates similar, noise-free reference images from a comprehensive database. By doing so, it achieves real-time denoising, ensuring that the mission’s acquired lunar images are of high quality, thus facilitating more accurate scientific analysis. The paper details the architecture of the autoencoder-based denoising system, its training process using a meticulously curated lunar image dataset, and its seamless integration into the mission’s image processing pipeline. Experimental results underscore the system’s remarkable noise reduction capabilities, thereby playing a pivotal role in enhancing the Chandrayaan 3 mission’s scientific contributions, ultimately advancing our understanding of the lunar environment and bolstering the success of lunar exploration endeavours.

articleTitle: Advancements in Animal Behaviour Monitoring and Livestock Management: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Wildlife and animal behaviour tracking and recording is a discipline that has received a lot of attention mainly because of the growing environmental changes and human activities that are influential in many ways to wildlife and their habitats. Former methods of data collection by direct observation, and handwriting, are now either supplemented or substituted by complex technological tools. This review paper also discusses different ones like deep learning models such as YOLOv8 for the constant monitoring of animal behaviour, hybrid models that combine VGG-19 and Bi-LSTM for real-time animal detection and alertness, as well as the multitask learning framework for efficient animal activity recognition using low-cost embedded systems. Such technologies provide potential strategies for tracking, identifying, improving the quality of life, and reducing the risk of potential incidences between humans and wildlife. Furthermore, the paper also enlightens the possibilities of applying CNN for sheep breed recognition, which plays a part in how machine learning helps enhance livestock use. The various accomplishments discussed in this paper reflect clear progress in the area of smart farming and wildlife protection and the technologies presented can be described as viable, practical, and feasible for implementation on a large scale.

articleTitle: The Role of IoT in Circular Business Models: Opportunities and Challenges for Sustainable Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research paper seeks to evaluate the IoT in circular business models for sustainable innovation in an attempt to establish its opportunities and limitations. It reviews the available literature and conducts analytical research to investigate how the IoT enables organization to optimise resource use, ensure high operational reliability through condition-based maintenance, and increase supply chain visibility. Some of the preliminary investigations show that IoT has the potential of bringing about controlled costs, less resource wastage, and longer product life, thus promoting the principles of circular economy within organizations. It also points out several challenges that hinder the implementation IoT as a solution: high initial capital outlay, security, and lack of standardization. The paper uses numerous examples of the best practices of companies that have adopted IoT and discusses multiple real-life cases, so it is useful for organizations that want to adopt IoT. Based on the discussions in this paper, future research directions are then postulated to focus on IoT technology integration and cooperation among academia, industry, and policy makers. As this research has shown IoT can be used as a tool for enhancing sustainable business practices and this research presents a clear path on how businesses can optimize the use of IoT to address the environmental and economic challenges of the future.

articleTitle: Deployment Schemes of In-Band Management Mode Based on Industrial SDN Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to properly manage and monitor their networks in industrial environments, industrial Software-Defined Networking (SDN) networks need to have an in-band administration mode. This research investigates a wide variety of alternative deployment options for in-band management mode in industrial SDN networks in order to increase the performance of the network, as well as its dependability and level of network security. We study how the performance of the network differs depending on whatever coupling of in-band management and industrial SDN architecture we choose. We analyse a range of potential pairings of in-band management with industrial SDN design. We also discuss the advantages and disadvantages of each deployment technique, providing insights into the creation and management of robust Industrial SDN networks. It provides useful recommendations for increasing the efficacy and security of particular network infrastructures, which might be valuable to both corporate groups and network administrators. The adoption of SDN technology and the installation of tailored management modes are becoming more and more significant as industrial settings continue to expand. This is of the utmost significance in order to guarantee the highest possible standards of both operational excellence and safety.

articleTitle: Efficient Resource Management for Real-time AI Systems in the Cloud using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The advent of artificial intelligence (AI) has driven an emergence in applications demanding online responses to immense amounts of data. Typically, the cloud-based deployment of these applications requires resource management to be optimized for high performance while meeting cost efficiency. However, conventional static resource allocation methods may only partially apply to the context of real-time AI applications as they are dynamic, unpredictable, and require more efficient & adaptive ways of allocating resources. To address this challenge, and as a solution in this research, we introduce an RL-based method for online resource management of cloud-based AI systems. Reinforcement learning ($\mathbf{R L}$) is a machine-learning algorithm that allows systems to learn how best to perform tasks in changing environments based on feedback from those interactions with the environment. The third way our proposed approach utilizes the weapon of RL entails allowing for dynamic resource allocation so that resources are allocated when needed rather than from a static method as set at design time.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multi-Resolution Framework for Scalable and Efficient Big Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The increasing applicability of the big data in different domains require the formulation of effective data collection and analysis framework that can accommodate complex and large datasets. This paper proposes the new DRAF that enhance both data aggregation and mining for large datasets. The Dynamic Resolution Adaptive Framework (DRAF) takes advantage of using multiple levels of representation of data, which makes it easy to expand the workload or scale down depending on the needs of the user. This proposed framework employs methods like hierarchical clustering, branching multi-level indexing and Adaptive Resolution Switching in order to optimize the trade-off of data accuracy and computational cost. Moreover, high level of detail is maintained in the DRAF, which supports mining necessary data and model details at multiple resolutions, making the DRAF specifically appropriate for operational environments where data come from numerous different sources and types. Substantial experiments in the book prove the efficiency of the DRAF-based algorithms in terms of speed and accuracy in comparison with other existing methods. The study establishes potentiality of the DRAF toward the application of big data problems in areas of high level of resolution and immediacy of decision making.

articleTitle: Innovative Strategies for Ensuring Data Protection and Maintaining Integrity in Digital Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Data security is difficult in the ever-changing digital world. Existing techniques may not provide comprehensive security, real-time hazard monitoring, and usercentred access management. Our response must be forceful and adaptable. The study led to the development of a five-part data safety technique. AEA, DTD, SIM, UCAC, and AAP are all part of this organisation. AAP makes identification fast and secure; AEA protects data; DTD detects hazards in real time; SIM tests security on a broad scale; and UCAC regulates access. Ablation can reveal systemic roles. New methods outperformed previous ones in some key aspects. Visual tools emphasise privacy, freedom, user experience, and connection to aid decisionmaking. In ever-changing digital situations, one may employ a powerful and adaptable data security solution.

articleTitle: Scalable Cloud-Integrated Analytics and Visualization for Real-Time Smart Grid Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The installation of new smart technologies has been growing exponentially, resulting in the creation of a large quantity of diverse data which require sophisticated tools for analysis. This paper presents CloudVIZ-GRID as a new cloud-based visual analytical framework that was developed to accommodate the severity of the big data issues in smart grids. CloudVIZ-GRID combines simple web-based grid accounts with up-to-date visualization tools and high-processing power to give a real time snap shot and ‘finger on the pulse’ of grid performance and operations, or deviations in energy usage. Using distributed data processing engines, CloudVIZ-GRID can process high velocity data feeds, and with limited latency deliver analytics output. Moreover, the application of the machine learning algorithms within the framework strengthens the predict ability and thus pre-empts the management of the grid. This study lays emphasis on the importance of addressing the issues of computation, which is even more challenging in case of complex systems such as smart grids; use of cloud based solutions enable the conversion of huge amount of data available in smart grid into valuable insights that can be helpful for grid operators and players in the energy sector. Due to having a modular structure, the CloudVIZ-GRID has the ability to change to fit future possible grids and additions, making it an essential part of the growing smart grid applications.

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing in E-Commerce Enhancing Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cognitive computing has been posturing itself as the disruptive innovation that advances the supply chain management in e-commerce. This research aims at identifying how cognitive computing system can be incorporated in the supply chain in various areas including demand forecast, inventory replenishment, and customer relations. Through the use of analytical capabilities, artificial intelligence (machine learning), and natural language processing, cognitive computing improves decision-making accuracy, eradicates redundancies, and dynamics timely improvements based on market trends. The study illustrates that cognitive computing not only leads to an enhanced structure of e-commerce supply chains but are also more responsive and flexible, thus leading to effective customer satisfaction and company advantage.

articleTitle: An Improved Particle Swarm Approach for Energy-Aware Location-Aided Routing in Mobile Ad-Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A network with no infrastructure, multiple hops, and dispersed nodes called a MANET. Nodes can communicate directly or through intermediaries without the need for permanent infrastructure. In dynamic networks like MANETs, routing procedures enhance the overall appearance of the network by ensuring Quality of Service (QoS). A routing protocol may use a composite routing measure to determine the best path for transferring data. Optimal location-based routing for MANETs based on energy-awareness is presented in this paper. Optimal routes are selected using this fast algorithm. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used instead of location-aided routing to select the normal data transmission route. Last but not least, the network is tested by simulating its packet delivery ratio, its energy level, its delay, and its overhead.

articleTitle: Exploring the Use of Big Data in Financial Risk Management and Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The banking and financial sector produces large volumes of data every thirty seconds, which makes it a datarich business. This data is classified as big data, defined as vast amounts of complicated, varied, and ever-expanding data. Financial organizations may use this data to get a better understanding of their clientele, product efficacy, and market trends. Nearly half of individuals have begun using electronic gadgets due to the advent of digital banking, which makes it simpler for consumers to do novel tasks, interact with companies, and evaluate goods and services. Banks may use this data to generate client profiles, which they can then examine to forecast customer behaviour and tailor services. This paper explores the use of big data within finance today, as well as the opportunities and problems that still need to be solved. The Random Forest model is considered to evaluate the processes of identifying fraudulent activities and managing risks by using Big Data. The predictive model potentially maintains the accuracy of the analysis.

articleTitle: The Role of IoT in Transforming Education: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Directions for Smart Education Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Analysing the educational segment and its connection with the Internet of Things (IoT) reveals benefits and issues. The following study examines how IoT contributes to improving education since learning becomes more engaging, individualized, and effective when using IoT technology. The study adopts survey data and data from IoT devices as quantitative data sources and interviews and focus group data as qualitative data sources. An analysis of the results shows a high degree of positive relationship between IoT implementation, students’ performance and attendance. The qualitative analysis reveals critical themes like improved learning outcomes, tailored learning, and others like privacy and lack of access to technology. This paper recommends that research focus on security, fairness in technology distribution, teacher education, IoT solutions that are adaptable for large-scale education, and cross-disciplinary study. By addressing these areas, the stakeholders will be able to harness the full potential of IoT in offering efficient, effective and engaging education for all the stakeholders. The findings of this research can be useful and serve as a platform for further research as it presents the roadmap of implementing IoT in the educational system.

articleTitle: FinTech Edge: Utility Computing & Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Smart Financial Acquisition & Blockchain in the Financial Industries
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The study ventures into the changing environment of blockchain, artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud computing as key components of financial technology (FinTech). This research examines how these technologies are transforming the financial system, with a focus on intelligent finance investment including blockchain’s disruptive potential. It begins with a brief description of cloud computing, explaining how it promotes extensibility, formability & cost-efficiency inside financial Institutions. The focus then shifts to AI applications, including the impact of robot advisers, trading using algorithms as well as statistical research on the reinvention of investing processes. The tale probes further into complex architecture of blockchain technology, giving light on its ability to increase the security and openness of the financial system. It reveals linkages that open the path for novel methods and significant developments, emphasizing the convergence of cloud, AI & blockchain. As we explore these FinTech territories, the paper acknowledges the inherent obstacles and dangers while also providing thoughts on legislative and ethical implications.
